halomcc-i-m-sorry-dave-c5354b9fe4.name: Ngiyaxolisa, Dave
halomcc-i-m-sorry-dave-c5354b9fe4.description: Halo: Reach: Thola isiginesha kanambambili efihliwe.
halomcc-i-m-sorry-dave-c5354b9fe4.guideDescription:
Ukuze uvule impumelelo ye-"Ngiyaxolisa, Dave" kokuthi Halo: Reach ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), udinga ukuthola iqanda lephasika elithile elihlonipha u-David Candland, umqondisi we-UI womdlalo. Nawu umhlahlandlela onemininingwane wokuthi ungayithola kanjani:

1. Qala noma yimuphi umsebenzi womkhankaso noma imephu yabadlali abaningi kokuthi Halo: Reach.
2. Thatha isikhali **esingenaso** isici sobubanzi bokusondeza. Izibonelo ezijwayelekile zihlanganisa i-Assault Rifle noma i-Plasma Pistol.
3. Cindezela inkinobho yokusondeza (ngokuvamile induku engakwesokudla kumakhonsoli noma ukhiye oqokiwe ku-PC) ukuze "zoom in" ngesikhali sakho esingasikiwe.
4. Bhekisisa*ekhoneni elingezansi kwesokunxele** lesikrini sakho. Uzoqaphela uchungechunge lwekhodi kanambambili luvela kafushane.
5. Le khodi kanambambili ihumusha egameni elithi "Dave" ekumeleleni kanambambili kwe-ASCII.

Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo futhi ubheke ikhodi kanambambili, uzovula impumelelo ye-"Ngiyaxolisa, Dave".

halomcc-balaho-s-most-wanted-03c5a591ce.name: Okufunwa Kakhulu KaBalaho

halomcc-just-a-taste-9a52606cd4.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule impumelelo ye-"Ukunambitha Nje" kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), uzodinga ukuqoqa imikhankaso engu-500 noma izindondo zohlu lwadlalwayo. halomcc-the-guardians-are-coming-f21d333.name: Bayeza Abagada
halomcc-the-guardians-are-coming-f21d333.guideDescription:
Impumelelo ye-"Bayeza Abagada" ku-Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC) ingavulwa ngokuhlangabezana nesiphetho esingajwayelekile: ukubulawa ngendlela edida injini yegeyimu. Uma lokhu kwenzeka, igeyimu ivamise ukubonisa umlayezo, "You were killed by The Guardians." Nansi indlela eqondile yokuzuza le mpumelelo:

1. Kumenyu enkulu yokuthi Halo MCC, khetha umkhankaso othi Halo 2.
2. Hamba kumishini khetha.
3. Setha ugebhezi lwe-scarab njengolusebenzayo.
4. Layisha i-mission yokuqala nanoma yimuphi omunye umsebenzi owuthandayo.
5. Dlala uze uthole isikhali.
6. Dubula phansi.
7. Impumelelo ivuliwe!

Uma ulandela lezi zinyathelo, uzoba ne-"Bayeza Abagada" eqoqweni lakho.

halomcc-my-buddy-chips-b7c213043b.name: My Buddy Chips
halomcc-my-buddy-chips-b7c213043b.description: Halo CE: Yilwa eduze no-Chips Dubbo futhi ulalele amazwi akhe okuhlakanipha.
halomcc-my-buddy-chips-b7c213043b.guideDescription:
Ukuze uthole impumelelo ye-"My Buddy Chips" kokuthi Halo: Combat Evolved ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection, udinga ukuhlangana nomlingisi u-Chips Dubbo phakathi nomkhankaso Halo: Combat Evolved. Angatholakala emisebenzini ehlukahlukene, kodwa abadlali abaningi baye baphumelela ku-mission "The Pillar of Autumn."

Gcina osolwandle bakho bephila, ikakhulukazi phakathi nesigaba lapho amabutho eSivumelwano egibela khona umkhumbi wakho, futhi ulalele inkhulumomphendvulwano ehlukile ye-Dubbo. Impumelelo kufanele ivuleke ngemva kwalokhu kuhlangana.

Kuyaqapheleka ukuthi ukubukeka kweChips Dubbo kungaba okungahleliwe ngandlela thile, futhi uma unenkinga yokumthola, zama ukudlala kabusha umkhankaso futhi uwuthathe kancane, uqinisekise ukuthi uhlala namasosha akho futhi ulalele yonke inkhulumomphendvulwano1 yabo.

halomcc-bite-the-hand-cc4675d512.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Luma Isandla" kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), ulayini wokulinganisa abadlali abaningi futhi ubulale izimbangi ngesikhathi sokufana okuvamile. halomcc-sacrifice-1348414136.name: Umhlatshelo
halomcc-sacrifice-1348414136.description: Halo CE: Yenza kusebenze iTheminali 2 ku-Halo.
halomcc-sacrifice-1348414136.guideDescription:
Njengoba uthuthukela kuleveli, uzofika endaweni lapho u-Cortana ephawula khona, "This cave is not a natural formation." Uzobe ushayela i-Warthog yakho ngenethiwekhi yamathaneli. Naka kakhulu njengoba uzulazula kule ndawo. Ufuna indlela encane eseceleni ephambuka emzileni omkhulu.

Le ndlela ifihlekile ngandlela thize, ngakho-ke kulula ukuyigeja uma ushesha. Yehlisa ijubane futhi uhlale ubheke imbobo encane ngakwesokudla somhume. Itholakala ngemuva kwesakhiwo esikhulu, esikhanyisiwe esigqama endaweni ezungezile. Uma usuyibonile i-alley, shayela kuyo bese wehla ku-Warthog yakho.

Itheminali ibekwe lapha, ilinde ukwenziwa isebenze. Sondela kuyo futhi uhlanganyele ukuze uvule impumelelo.

Ukuze wandise inqubekelaphambili yakho, gxila ekubulaleni izitha ngokushesha nangempumelelo, uhlose ukubulala okuningi nokubulala izindondo ze-spree. Ukudlala ngobunzima obulula emkhankasweni kuyanconywa, njengoba kukuvumela ukuthi uqongelele izindondo ngaphandle kwenselelo eyengeziwe yobunzima obuphezulu.

halomcc-no-picnic-a42a690adf.name: Ayikho Ipikiniki
halomcc-no-picnic-a42a690adf.description: Halo: Reach: Buka isigcawu se-grizzly eNew Alexandria.
halomcc-no-picnic-a42a690adf.guideDescription:
Ukuze uvule impumelelo ye-"Ayikho Ipikiniki" kokuthi Halo: Reach ngaphakathi kwe-Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), landela lezi zinyathelo:

1. Qala umsebenzi ka-Eksodusi.
2. Njengoba uqala umkhankaso, wehla ngokushesha ngerempu uqonde kunhloso yakho yokuqala.
3. Thola ubhaka webhere phansi phakathi kwezidumbu ezansi kwegquma eduze nomnyango wokuqala ohlangana nawo.
4. Chitha imizuzwana embalwa ubuka ibhere. Lena "grizzly scene" okudingeka uyiqaphele.
5. Ngemva kokuhlola i-teddy bear, impumelelo ye-"Ayikho Ipikiniki" kufanele ivele!

Khumbula, ayikho ezingeni i-New Alexandria, ngaphandle kwencazelo edukisayo. Empeleni iku-Eksodusi. Ngakho-ke, hlala ubhekile lowo bhaka webhere le-teddy! 🐻

Sebenza ngomkhankaso noma ngabadlali abaningi njengoba ubujwayele ukwenza, futhi uhlose amaqembu ezitha ezibuthakathaka uma ufuna ukwakha isibalo ngokushesha.

halomcc-reviewer-ea86d5dfc4.name: Umbuyekezi
halomcc-reviewer-ea86d5dfc4.description: Halo 2: Yenza kusebenze iTheminali 12 ku-High Charity.

halomcc-monitored-5d7bb13885.name: Igadiwe
halomcc-monitored-5d7bb13885.description: H3: ODST: Thola Ilogi Yomsindo Yeshumi.
halomcc-monitored-5d7bb13885.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Igadiwe" kokuthi Halo 3: ODST ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), hamba ku-Mombasa Streets futhi ubheke amakhiosks akhanyayo, amafoni, nezinye izikhumulo eziphethe Amalogi Omsindo. Landela ividiyo uye kutheminali ongakaze uyisebenzise, ​​bese usebenzisana nayo. Le mpumelelo ivula kulogi yakho ye-10 eqoqiwe.

halomcc-big-time-gamer-31b3b9fd03.name: Umdlali Wesikhathi Esikhulu

Ungashintshanisa phakathi kwabo. Dlala kabusha ohambweni lomkhankaso omfushane noma hlala ekufaniseni ngemiphumela ukuze ukuqedwa ngakunye kuqoshwe.

halomcc-skulltaker-halo-3-iron-9858fda8c.name: I-Skulltaker Halo 3: Insimbi

halomcc-exterminator-a93e602cf8.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Exterminator" kokuthi Halo 3 ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), qala i-Floodgate nge-Scoreing enikwe amandla futhi uhlose ukushaya amaphuzu angu-25,000. halomcc-cold-fusion-c81ec66fe1.description: Halo 2A MP: Bulala omelene naye ngokuqhumisa ikhoyili ye-Fusion.
halomcc-cold-fusion-c81ec66fe1.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Cold Fusion" kokuthi Halo 2: Anniversary ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), bulala omelene naye ngokuqhumisa ikhoyili ye-Fusion. halomcc-skulltaker-halo-ce-iron-cb518961.name: I-Skulltaker Halo: CE: Insimbi

Shintshela kuzithombe ezenziwe kabusha ukuze uzibone. Ngaphambi kokushiya i-cryo bay, hlola ngemuva kweziqukathi ezingemuva. Landela indlela ekuvidiyo futhi usebenzise umyalo wokuthatha lapho ufika kuyo.

halomcc-tank-beats-everything-bd1455a635.name: I-Tank Ishaya Konke
halomcc-tank-beats-everything-bd1455a635.description: Halo: Reach: Qedela Iphakheji Yenganekwane nge-Scorpion iphelele.
halomcc-tank-beats-everything-bd1455a635.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule i-"I-Tank Ishaya Konke" ku-Halo: Reach ngaphakathi kwe-Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), qala Iphakheji Lenganekwane futhi ugcine i-Scorpion injalo kumishini. Sebenzisa ububanzi bethangi ukuze ukhiphe okuphokophelwe esindayo kusenesikhathi, ulipake endaweni ephephile kuyilapho ususa izindawo eziyingozi ngezinyawo, futhi uligcine lingenzi umonakalo omkhulu.

halomcc-skunked-c3a732af39.name: Skunked
halomcc-skunked-c3a732af39.description: Halo: Reach: Uwine umdlalo owenziwe ngokulingana Wokuhlasela esigabeni sokuqala.
halomcc-skunked-c3a732af39.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Skunked" kokuthi Halo: Reach ngaphakathi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kulayini Halo: Reach Invasion. Uma uvikela esigabeni sokuqala, hlukanisa iqembu lakho phakathi kwamaphuzu amabili okuthwebula futhi uhlale uphila kuze kube yilapho abahlaseli bephelelwa isikhathi ngaphandle kokuthatha noma yiliphi iphuzu.

halomcc-taste-test-b1f7a19ccc.name: Ukunambitha Test
halomcc-taste-test-b1f7a19ccc.description: Halo 4: Qedela umdlalo okungenani ezinhlotsheni zegeyimu ezi-4 ezihlukene kubadlali abaningi.
halomcc-taste-test-b1f7a19ccc.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukunambitha Test" kokuthi Halo 4 ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), dlala umdlalo ozoqeda ngezinhlobo ezi-4 ezihlukile zabadlali abaningi, njenge-Slayer, Capture the Flag, Oddball, ne-King of the Hill lapho itholakala khona. Landela umkhondo wemodi kunegama lemephu ngaphambi kokubeka umugqa olandelayo.

halomcc-negative-ghostrider-8920a4e4a9.name: Negative, Ghostrider
halomcc-negative-ghostrider-8920a4e4a9.description: Halo: Reach: Thola i-Skullamanjaro kugeyimu ye-Headhunter eyenziwe ngokulingana.
halomcc-negative-ghostrider-8920a4e4a9.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Negative, Ghostrider" kokuthi Halo: Reach ngaphakathi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), ku-Headhunter eyenziwe ngomentshisi, buthelela izingebhezi eziyi-10 ngaphandle kokuziwisa. Sebenzisa ikhava endleleni eya endaweni esebenzayo yamaphuzu bese ufaka konke oku-10 ndawonye kwe-Skullamanjaro.

halomcc-do-you-remember-when-we-met-ce6c.name: Uyakhumbula Uma Sihlangana
halomcc-do-you-remember-when-we-met-ce6c.description: H3: ODST: Dlala igeyimu yokuthi Halo 3: ODST ngomhla ka-22 wanoma iyiphi inyanga.
halomcc-do-you-remember-when-we-met-ce6c.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Uyakhumbula Uma Sihlangana" kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), ngomhla ka-22 wanoma iyiphi inyanga, ngena ngemvume bese uqala umdlalo esihlokweni se-Halo esidingekayo esivela ku-The Master Chief Collection. Inhloso yomkhankaso wokuvula ikunikeza indlela esheshayo yokudlala igeyimu elungile ngaleyo dethi.

halomcc-boot-camp-hero-44af93ac8d.name: Iqhawe le-Boot Camp
halomcc-boot-camp-hero-44af93ac8d.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Iqhawe le-Boot Camp" kokuthi Halo 3 ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), vula Uhlu lwadlalwayo Lomkhankaso lwe-Halo 3 bese ukhetha uhlu lwadlalwayo olulodwa. Qedela yonke inhloso ohlwini lwadlalwayo ngalunye olukhethiwe ngaphandle kokushintshela kokuthi Ukukhetha Kwemishini. Izinhla zokudlalayo ezinetimu emfushane ziyindawo enhle yokuqala.

halomcc-rex-sword-749d214667.name: Rex Sword
halomcc-rex-sword-749d214667.description: Halo 2: Bamba inkemba yamandla ezingeni Lengaphandle.
halomcc-rex-sword-749d214667.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Rex Sword" kokuthi Halo 2: Anniversary ngaphakathi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), dlala i-Outskirts bese ugibela phezu kophahla eduze nendawo yokuvula. Landela umzila ophakeme oya ekamelweni elifihliwe elimakwe ngesibonisi se-REX bese uthatha i-Energy Sword ngaphakathi.

halomcc-i-dabble-in-slaying-d1643cce19.name: Ngiyazifela Ekubulaleni
halomcc-i-dabble-in-slaying-d1643cce19.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ngiyazifela Ekubulaleni" kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), vula Izinhla zokudlalayo Zomkhankaso bese ukhetha uhlu lwadlalwayo oluhlukahlukene. halomcc-like-peanut-butter-and-chocolate.name: Njengebhotela Yamantongomane kanye Noshokoledi

Shintshanisa izibopho ngokuhlangana ngakunye ukuze umdlali okwazi ukudubula abe nombono wokuhlosiwe, futhi niqedele izinga ndawonye.

halomcc-those-left-behind-44afac1d95.name: Abasele

halomcc-lore-master-f414ffc6cb.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Lore Master" kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), yenza kusebenze Amatheminali omkhankaso kulo lonke iqoqo. Landela ngomkhondo izimpumelelo zeTheminali ngomdlalo futhi usebenzise imihlahlandlela ngayinye yemishini yanoma yikuphi okugejile. Shintshela ezibukweni ezibuye zaqiniswa ze-Halo: CE Terminals.

halomcc-aficiando-079c841600.name: Aficiando
halomcc-aficiando-079c841600.description: Halo 3: Gcwalisa izinhla zokudlalayo ezintathu Halo 3.
halomcc-aficiando-079c841600.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Aficiando" kokuthi Halo 3 ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), vula Izinhla zokudlalayo Zomkhankaso ze-Halo 3 bese ukhetha izinhla zokudlalayo ezintathu ezihlukene. Qedela yonke inhloso ohlwini lwadlalwayo ngalunye olukhethiwe ngaphandle kokushintshela kokuthi Ukukhetha Kwemishini. Izinhla zokudlalayo ezinetimu emfushane ziyindawo enhle yokuqala.

halomcc-pacifist-0dca677c00.name: I-Pacifist
halomcc-pacifist-0dca677c00.description: Halo CE: Qedela Umdwebi Webalazwe Othule ngaphandle kokudubula, amabhomu, i-melee, ukufa noma ukuqala kabusha.
halomcc-pacifist-0dca677c00.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Pacifist" kokuthi Halo: Combat Evolved Anniversary ngaphakathi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), qala I-Cartographer Ethule ku-Easy futhi usebenzise i-Warthog ukuze ufinyelele esiteshini sezokuphepha kanye noMdwebi wamabalazwe. Gijimani izitha ezedlule futhi nifinyelele ekukhishweni ngaphandle kokudubula, ukujikijela amabhomu, usebenzisa i-melee, ukufa, noma ukuqala kabusha.

halomcc-feet-first-a0627d5182.name: Izinyawo Kuqala
halomcc-feet-first-a0627d5182.description: Halo 4: Qedela zonke izahluko Spartan Ops.
halomcc-feet-first-a0627d5182.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Izinyawo Kuqala" kokuthi Halo 4 ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), vula Spartan Ops kokuthi Halo 4. Qedela zonke izahluko ezinhlanu zesiqephu ngasinye kweziyi-10. Sebenzisa imenyu yesiqephu ukuze uthole noma yiziphi izahluko ezishoda ngokusobala.

halomcc-like-a-broken-record-96d049ddc6.name: Njengerekhodi Eliphukile
halomcc-like-a-broken-record-96d049ddc6.description: H3: ODST: Thola inkomba yomculo efihliwe.
halomcc-like-a-broken-record-96d049ddc6.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Njengerekhodi Eliphukile" kokuthi Halo 3: ODST ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), thola inkomba yomculo efihliwe. Landela ividiyo kusuka endaweni eseduze noma indawo yokuhlola. Linda endaweni isikhathi eside ngokwanele ukuze ithrekhi iqale.

halomcc-trophy-collector-c5e82d06f8.name: Umqoqi Wezindondo
halomcc-trophy-collector-c5e82d06f8.description: Halo 2: Thola futhi ufune zonke izingebhezi ku-Halo 2.
halomcc-trophy-collector-c5e82d06f8.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule impumelelo ethi "Umqoqi Wezindondo" ku-Halo 2: Anniversary ngaphakathi kwe-Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), landela uhlu olukuvidiyo ukuze uqoqe ugebhezi ngalunye lomkhankaso. Vula i-Mission Select ukuze udlale kabusha amazinga onezinto ongakazitholi. Qala ngaphambi kwendawo ugebhezi olufihlwe kuyo, bese udlala ngezinga lobunzima elithi Legendary.

halomcc-grand-theft-halo-acf75eecbb.name: Grand Theft Halo
halomcc-grand-theft-halo-acf75eecbb.description: Halo 2A MP: Komdlalo owodwa, ntshontsha isamba sezimoto ezi-5 ezigcwele kwabamelene nawe.
halomcc-grand-theft-halo-acf75eecbb.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Grand Theft Halo" kokuthi Halo 2: Anniversary phakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), emdlalweni owodwa Halo 2: Anniversary, sondela ezimotweni zesitha ezihlala abantu, sebenzisa umyalo wokugibela ukuze uhlale esihlalweni, futhi ushiye imoto ukusetha enye imoto. Phinda ukuthatha okuhlanu okuyimpumelelo.

halomcc-chol-von-s-not-gonna-like-this-4.name: UChol Von Ngeke Athande Lokhu
halomcc-chol-von-s-not-gonna-like-this-4.guideDescription: Ukuvula "UChol Von Ngeke Athande Lokhu" ku-Halo: Reach ngaphakathi kwe-Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), susa ama-Skirmishers angu-1000. Namathela ku-Halo: Reach kulesi sibalo. Dlala kabusha umkhankaso wangaphambi kwesikhathi Halo: Reach ngama-Skirmisher. Qhubeka ususa izitha ezifanelekile njengoba usebenza ngezinye izimpumelelo.

halomcc-monumental-thirst-bba3cbaeae.name: Ukoma Okuyisikhumbuzo!
halomcc-monumental-thirst-bba3cbaeae.description: I-H2A: Kutholwe futhi kwacekelwa phansi i-BLAST soda can ku-Remnant.
halomcc-monumental-thirst-bba3cbaeae.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukoma Okuyisikhumbuzo!" kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), layisha iRemnant ku-Halo 2: Anniversary yabadlali abaningi. Landela ividiyo ukusuka endaweni yokuzalela kuya ekani elifihliwe le-BLAST, bese uyithwebula ize inqamuke.

halomcc-keep-your-foot-on-the-pedrogas-3.name: Gcina unyawo lwakho ku-Pedrogas
halomcc-keep-your-foot-on-the-pedrogas-3.description: Halo: Reach: Qedela konke Halo: Reach ohambweni lomkhankaso wenganekwane ngaphansi kwamahora angu-3.
halomcc-keep-your-foot-on-the-pedrogas-3.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Gcina unyawo lwakho ku-Pedrogas" kokuthi Halo: Reach ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), qedela ohambweni lomkhankaso ku-Legendary futhi ulethe isikhathi esirekhodiwe esihlanganisiwe sibe ngaphansi kwamahora amathathu. Dlala kusukela ekuqaleni kwe-mission ngayinye ngesikhathi esinikwe amandla, funda lapho ungeqa khona ukuhlangana, futhi udlale kabusha izigaba lapho ungonga khona isikhathi esiningi.

halomcc-red-vs-blue-75b3a0e6ad.name: Okubomvu vs. Okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka
halomcc-red-vs-blue-75b3a0e6ad.description: Halo 2A MP: Wina imidlalo engu-10 ku-Bloodline kubadlali abaningi.
halomcc-red-vs-blue-75b3a0e6ad.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Okubomvu vs. Okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka" kokuthi Halo 2: Anniversary ngaphakathi kwe-Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), dlala abadlali abaningi ku-Bloodline ku-Halo 2: Anniversary futhi uwine imidlalo engu-10 kuleyo mephu. Hlala ubheka imiphumela isikhathi ngasinye ukuze ukuwina kubalwe.

halomcc-planting-a-flag-c1e64a70e0.name: Ukutshala Ifulegi
halomcc-planting-a-flag-c1e64a70e0.description: Zuza isamba sezindondo Eziqondile zemodi ye-CTF engu-250 kumageyimu enziwe umeshi.
halomcc-planting-a-flag-c1e64a70e0.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukutshala Ifulegi" kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), thola izindondo eziqondile zemodi ye-CTF engu-250 emidlalweni eyenziwe ngomentshisi. Ulayini Wokuthwebula Ifulegi nokusekela ukubanjwa kwefulegi, ukubuyiselwa, nokuthwebula. Qhubeka udlala ngemiphumela ukuze izindondo zibalwe.

halomcc-vandalized-8bfaec17ce.name: Icekelwe phansi
halomcc-vandalized-8bfaec17ce.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Icekelwe phansi" kokuthi Halo 3: ODST ngaphakathi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), ngesikhathi se-NMPD HQ, bheka i-graffiti efihliwe futhi ubhekane nayo eduze. Sebenzisa umzila kuvidiyo kunokushiya indawo usuka emgomweni oyinhloko.

halomcc-term-of-enlistment-1ccd9e3baa.name: Isikhathi Sokubhaliswa
halomcc-term-of-enlistment-1ccd9e3baa.description: Halo 4: Qedela zonke izahluko Spartan Ops ngobunzima obujwayelekile.
halomcc-term-of-enlistment-1ccd9e3baa.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Isikhathi Sokubhaliswa" kokuthi Halo 4 ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), vula Spartan Ops kokuthi Halo 4 bese usethe kokuthi Okujwayelekile. Qedela zonke izahluko ezinhlanu zesiqephu ngasinye kweziyi-10. Sebenzisa imenyu yesiqephu ukuze uthole noma yiziphi izahluko ezishoda ngokusobala.

halomcc-life-story-3bd7404961.name: Indaba Yempilo
halomcc-life-story-3bd7404961.description: Gcwalisa uhlu lwadlalwayo lwe-Master Chief Saga.
halomcc-life-story-3bd7404961.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Indaba Yempilo" kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), vula imenyu yohlu lwadlalwayo lomkhankaso wegeyimu bese uqala i-Master Chief Saga. Qhubeka nomsebenzi usebenzisa ukulondoloza uhlu lwadlalwayo olufanayo, futhi uqedele umgomo walo wokugcina wokurekhoda uhlu lwadlalwayo ngokucacile.

halomcc-destination-vacation-4f15643689.name: Iholide Lendawo
halomcc-destination-vacation-4f15643689.description: Halo 2: Buka olunye lwezimpawu zesizini e-Zanzibar kubadlali abaningi bakudala.
halomcc-destination-vacation-4f15643689.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Iholide Lendawo" kokuthi Halo 2: Anniversary ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), buka uphawu olulodwa lwesizini e-Zanzibar kubadlali abaningi bakudala. Sebenzisa ividiyo ukuze uhlonze ingqopha-mlando nendlela osondela ngayo. Uma kuyinto, sondela eduze ngokwanele ukuze uxhumane nayo ngaphambi kokuqhubeka endaweni.

halomcc-this-is-my-rifle-this-is-my-gun-.name: Lesi isibhamu sami, Lesi isibhamu sami
halomcc-this-is-my-rifle-this-is-my-gun-.description: Halo 4: Phatha isikhali se-UNSC udlulele ku-Forerunner ku-Heroic noma Inganekwane.
halomcc-this-is-my-rifle-this-is-my-gun-.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Lesi isibhamu sami, Lesi isibhamu sami" kokuthi Halo 4 ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), qala I-Forerunner kokuthi Iqhawe noma Inganekwane. Gcina esinye sezikhali zakho zokuqala ze-UNSC endaweni yokubeka kuze kuphele umkhankaso. Shintsha enye i-slot yakho ibe izikhali zesitha njengoba kudingeka.

halomcc-trifecta-c66239f208.name: I-Trifecta
halomcc-trifecta-c66239f208.description: H3: ODST: Gcwalisa izinhla zokudlalayo ezintathu Halo 3: ODST.
halomcc-trifecta-c66239f208.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Trifecta" kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), vula Izinhla zokudlalayo Zomkhankaso ze-H3: ODST bese ukhetha izinhla zokudlalayo ezintathu ezihlukene. Qedela yonke inhloso ohlwini lwadlalwayo ngalunye olukhethiwe ngaphandle kokushintshela kokuthi Ukukhetha Kwemishini. Izinhla zokudlalayo ezinetimu emfushane ziyindawo enhle yokuqala.

halomcc-that-just-happened-0a24445cdb.name: Kwenzeke Lokho Nje
halomcc-that-just-happened-0a24445cdb.description: Halo CE: Gcwalisa Ilabhulali yobunzima bobuqhawe noma benganekwane ngaphandle kokufa.
halomcc-that-just-happened-0a24445cdb.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Kwenzeke Lokho Nje" kokuthi Halo: Combat Evolved Anniversary ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), qedela Ilabhulali Yobunzima Bobuqhawe noma Inganekwane ngaphandle kokufa. Qala i-mission kusukela ekuqaleni, sebenzisa ikhava ukuze ululame phakathi nokuhlangana, futhi ulandele umzila kuvidiyo. Zama futhi ukugijima uma wephula isimo senselele.

halomcc-the-marine-corps-gives-its-regar.name: I-Marine Corps Inikeza Ukuhlonipha
halomcc-the-marine-corps-gives-its-regar.description: H3: ODST: Beat par score kuwo wonke amazinga Halo 3: ODST.
halomcc-the-marine-corps-gives-its-regar.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Marine Corps Inikeza Ukuhlonipha" kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), dlala kabusha ohambweni lomkhankaso oludingekayo kanye ngesikhathi Ukushaya kunikwe amandla futhi uhlose ukushaya ithagethi ekhonjiswe umgomo ngamunye. Khetha ubunzima kanye nokushaya ama-Skulls ongakwazi ukuphatha, gcina ukubulala kanye nokulandelana kwezindondo, futhi uqedele kahle ukuze uvikele isiphindaphindi sakho sesikhathi.

halomcc-can-t-stop-here-this-is-brute-co.name: Awukwazi Ukuma Lapha, Leli Izwe Eline-Brute
halomcc-can-t-stop-here-this-is-brute-co.description: H3: ODST: Shaya ngesikhathi kuwo wonke amazinga Halo 3: ODST.
halomcc-can-t-stop-here-this-is-brute-co.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Awukwazi Ukuma Lapha, Leli Izwe Eline-Brute" kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), dlala kabusha umkhankaso ngamunye odingekayo kusukela ekuqaleni kokuthi Easy bese uvule isibali sikhathi ukuze ukwazi ukulandelela ngokumelene nethagethi ekhonjiswe umgomo ngamunye. Hamba phakathi kwezindawo zokuhlola ngokushesha futhi ulwe kuphela lapho ukuhlangana noma umgomo uvimba ukuqhubeka. Hlola amarekhodi emishini ukuze uthole noma yiziphi izikhathi ezishodayo.

halomcc-leave-it-where-it-lay-054f73d1ea.name: Lishiye Lapho Lilele Khona
halomcc-leave-it-where-it-lay-054f73d1ea.description: Halo CE: Qedela Ukukhaphela Okubili kubunzima benganekwane ngaphandle kokuthatha isikhali esisha.
halomcc-leave-it-where-it-lay-054f73d1ea.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Lishiye Lapho Lilele Khona" kokuthi Halo: Combat Evolved Anniversary ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), qala ama-Betrayals Okubili ku-Legendary futhi ugcine izikhali zakho zokuqala zawo wonke umsebenzi. Bagebhele izinhlamvu lapho ungakwazi khona, sebenzisa izimoto uma ziwusizo, futhi ugweme umyalo wokushintsha izikhali.

halomcc-tying-up-loose-ends-9a95e12ead.name: Ukubopha Iziphetho Ezixekethile
halomcc-tying-up-loose-ends-9a95e12ead.description: Halo CE: Bulala wonke ama-Elite asezingeni Okhiye kubunzima bobuqhawe noma benganekwane.
halomcc-tying-up-loose-ends-9a95e12ead.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukubopha Iziphetho Ezixekethile" kokuthi Halo: Combat Evolved Anniversary ngaphakathi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), bulala wonke ama-Elite asezingeni elithi Keyes kubunzima Bomaqhawe noma Inganekwane. Sebenzisa isikhali, imoto, noma indawo efanayo eboniswe kuvidiyo. Uma igoli lidinga ukushaywa kokugcina okuqondile, yeka ukwenza omunye umonakalo uma ithagethi isibuthakathaka.

halomcc-excellent-taste-2c84d9a603.name: I-Taste enhle kakhulu
halomcc-excellent-taste-2c84d9a603.description: Halo CE: Gcwalisa izinhla zokudlalayo ezintathu ze-Halo: CE.
halomcc-excellent-taste-2c84d9a603.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Taste enhle kakhulu" kokuthi Halo: Combat Evolved Anniversary ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), vula Izinhla zokudlalayo Zomkhankaso ze-Halo CE bese ukhetha izinhla zokudlalayo ezintathu ezihlukene. Qedela yonke inhloso ohlwini lwadlalwayo ngalunye olukhethiwe ngaphandle kokushintshela kokuthi Ukukhetha Kwemishini. Izinhla zokudlalayo ezinetimu emfushane ziyindawo enhle yokuqala.

halomcc-arcade-owner-c7cae0d138.name: Umnikazi we-Arcade
halomcc-arcade-owner-c7cae0d138.description: Halo 2: Hlula amaphuzu alinganayo kuwo wonke amazinga Halo 2.
halomcc-arcade-owner-c7cae0d138.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Umnikazi we-Arcade" kokuthi Halo 2: Anniversary ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), dlala kabusha ohambweni lomkhankaso oludingekayo kanye ngesikhathi Ukushaya kunikwe amandla futhi uhlose ukushaya ithagethi ekhonjiswe umgomo ngamunye. Khetha ubunzima kanye nokushaya ama-Skulls ongakwazi ukuphatha, gcina ukubulala kanye nokulandelana kwezindondo, futhi uqedele kahle ukuze uvikele isiphindaphindi sakho sesikhathi.

halomcc-classic-0e64eaf3f4.name: Okwakudala
halomcc-classic-0e64eaf3f4.description: H3: ODST: Qedela noma yiliphi izinga uwedwa ku-Legendary, ngaphandle kokudubula noma amabhomu.
halomcc-classic-0e64eaf3f4.guideDescription:
Ukuze uvule okuthi "Okwakudala" kokuthi Halo 3: ODST ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), landela lezi zinyathelo.

1. Qala i-Ulift Reserve uwedwa ku-Legendary.
2. Thatha umzila wemoto futhi usebenzise ukunyakaza ukuze uthole izitha ezedlule.
3. Ungalokothi uqhumise isibhamu noma ujikijele ibhomu ngaphambi kokufika endaweni yokugcina yemishini.

halomcc-starved-for-shields-6e0fbffdd6.name: Ilambele Izihlangu
halomcc-starved-for-shields-6e0fbffdd6.description: Halo 2: Qedela ileveli nge-Streaking Skull kuphela esebenzayo kokuthi Iqhawe noma Inganekwane.
halomcc-starved-for-shields-6e0fbffdd6.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ilambele Izihlangu" kokuthi Halo 2: Anniversary ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), vula i-Streaking njengogebhezi lwakho kuphela bese uqala ileveli Halo 2 emfushane kokuthi Iqhawe noma Inganekwane. Hlela imihlangano ezungeze ukubulala okudingekayo ukuze ubuyisele izihlangu, sebenzisa ikhava phakathi kwezimpi, futhi uqedele lonke izinga.

halomcc-what-power-outage-15665534d2.name: Kuyini Ukunqamuka kukagesi?
halomcc-what-power-outage-15665534d2.description: Halo 4: Qedela i-Cauldron Base ye-Spartan Ops ngaphandle kokulahlekelwa i-generator ku-Heroic noma Inganekwane.
halomcc-what-power-outage-15665534d2.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Kuyini Ukunqamuka kukagesi?" kokuthi Halo 4 ngaphakathi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), qedela i-Cauldron Base ye-Spartan Ops ngaphandle kokulahlekelwa ijeneretha ku-Heroic noma Inganekwane. Qala i-mission kusukela ekuqaleni, sebenzisa ikhava ukuze ululame phakathi nokuhlangana, futhi ulandele umzila kuvidiyo. Zama futhi ukugijima uma wephula isimo senselele.

halomcc-throne-of-bones-cdb3f2b054.name: Isihlalo Sobukhosi Samathambo
halomcc-throne-of-bones-cdb3f2b054.description: Thola futhi ufune zonke izingebhezi zomkhankaso ku-Halo:CE, Halo 2, kanye Halo 3.
halomcc-throne-of-bones-cdb3f2b054.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Isihlalo Sobukhosi Samathambo" kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), qoqa yonke i-Skull yomkhankaso kokuthi Halo: Combat Evolved Anniversary, Halo 2: Anniversary, kanye nokuthi Halo 3. Hlola izimpumelelo ze-Skull zomkhankaso ngamunye futhi udlale kabusha ohambweni ngokuthatha okulahlekile.

halomcc-mortardom-2f3fdd6da4.name: I-Mortardom
halomcc-mortardom-2f3fdd6da4.description: Halo 4: Ku-Reclaimer, sebenzisa i-Wraith ukuze ubulale okungenani izitha ezine ze-Wraiths ku-Heroic noma Inganekwane.
halomcc-mortardom-2f3fdd6da4.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Mortardom" kokuthi Halo 4 ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), qala i-Reclaimer kokuthi Iqhawe noma Inganekwane bese uduna i-Wraith. Sebenzisa udaka lwayo ukuze ubhubhise ama-Wraiths amane ezitha. Bulisa kusukela ebangeni elide futhi uhambe ngemuva kwezwe ngemva kokudutshulwa ngakunye.

halomcc-bros-to-the-close-6c933f368d.name: Bros to the Close
halomcc-bros-to-the-close-6c933f368d.description: Halo 4: I-Infinity ephelele ngaphandle kokufa okungavinjelwa kwasolwandle ku-Heroic noma Inganekwane.
halomcc-bros-to-the-close-6c933f368d.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Bros to the Close" kokuthi Halo 4 ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), qala i-Infinity kokuthi Iqhawe noma Inganekwane. Uma uhlangana namaMarines ungawavikela, ngena phakathi kwawo namaPrometheans. Beka kuqala Ababukeli nabanye abahlaseli abasabisa isikwati kuze kuphele inhloso yokugada.

halomcc-connoisseur-ac29fbde9f.name: Isazi
halomcc-connoisseur-ac29fbde9f.description: Halo 2: Gcwalisa izinhla zokudlalayo ezintathu Halo 2.
halomcc-connoisseur-ac29fbde9f.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Isazi" kokuthi Halo 2: Anniversary ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), vula Izinhla zokudlalayo Zomkhankaso ze-Halo 2 bese ukhetha izinhla zokudlalayo ezintathu ezihlukene. Qedela yonke inhloso ohlwini lwadlalwayo ngalunye olukhethiwe ngaphandle kokushintshela kokuthi Ukukhetha Kwemishini. Izinhla zokudlalayo ezinetimu emfushane ziyindawo enhle yokuqala.

halomcc-easy-as-one-two-three-99f316a440.name: Kulula Njengenye Okubili Kwesithathu
halomcc-easy-as-one-two-three-99f316a440.description: Halo 4: Betha isikhathi esilinganayo kuwo wonke amazinga Halo 4.
halomcc-easy-as-one-two-three-99f316a440.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Kulula Njengenye Okubili Kwesithathu" kokuthi Halo 4 ngaphakathi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), dlala futhi umkhankaso ngamunye odingekayo kusukela ekuqaleni kokuthi Easy bese uvule isibali sikhathi ukuze ukwazi ukulandelela ngokumelene nethagethi ekhonjiswe umgomo ngamunye. Hamba phakathi kwezindawo zokuhlola ngokushesha futhi ulwe kuphela lapho ukuhlangana noma umgomo uvimba ukuqhubeka. Hlola amarekhodi emishini ukuze uthole noma yiziphi izikhathi ezishodayo.

halomcc-devastating-79fd8dc925.name: Kuyabhubhisa
halomcc-devastating-79fd8dc925.description: Halo 3: Qedela konke Halo 3 ohambweni lomkhankaso wenganekwane ngaphansi kwamahora angu-3.
halomcc-devastating-79fd8dc925.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Kuyabhubhisa" kokuthi Halo 3 ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), qedela ohambweni lomkhankaso ku-Legendary futhi ulethe isikhathi esirekhodiwe esihlanganisiwe sibe ngaphansi kwamahora amathathu. Dlala kusukela ekuqaleni kwe-mission ngayinye ngesikhathi esinikwe amandla, funda lapho ungeqa khona ukuhlangana, futhi udlale kabusha izigaba lapho ungonga khona isikhathi esiningi.

halomcc-elder-signs-0d5cac0902.name: Izimpawu Zabadala
halomcc-elder-signs-0d5cac0902.description: Halo 3: Buka amasigil ahlukene angu-2 ku-Valhalla.
halomcc-elder-signs-0d5cac0902.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Izimpawu Zabadala" kokuthi Halo 3 ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), buka amasiginali angu-2 ahlukene ku-Valhalla. Sebenzisa ividiyo ukuze uhlonze ingqopha-mlando nendlela osondela ngayo. Uma kuyinto, sondela eduze ngokwanele ukuze uxhumane nayo ngaphambi kokuqhubeka endaweni.

halomcc-one-final-firefight-3f94462e52.name: I-Final Firefight eyodwa
halomcc-one-final-firefight-3f94462e52.description: Halo: Reach: Thola amaphuzu angu-150,000 ku-Lone Wolf.
halomcc-one-final-firefight-3f94462e52.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Final Firefight eyodwa" kokuthi Halo: Reach ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), qala i-Lone Wolf nge-Score enikwe amandla. Thola ikhava evikelekile, qoqa izikhali ezitheni eziwile, nezindondo zamaketanga esikhundleni sokujaha izitha endaweni evulekile. Hlala uphila kuze kube yilapho isikolo sakho sifinyelela ku-150,000.

halomcc-look-out-for-the-little-guys-63b.name: Bhekani Izinsizwa
halomcc-look-out-for-the-little-guys-63b.description: Halo CE: Qedela Ukukhaphela Okubili kubunzima benganekwane ngaphandle kokubulala ama-Grunts.
halomcc-look-out-for-the-little-guys-63b.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Bhekani Izinsizwa" kokuthi Halo: Combat Evolved Anniversary ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), qala ama-Betrayals Okubili kokuthi Inganekwane. Shiya ama-Grunts yedwa, sebenzisa izikhali ezinembile lapho izitha ziqoqwa, futhi ugweme ukulimala kwesplash kusuka kumabhomu noma umlilo wemoto. Qedela umkhankaso ngaphandle kokuthola ikhredithi ngokubulala kwe-Grunt.

halomcc-the-return-of-megg-1a371750ec.name: Ukubuya kwe-Megg
halomcc-the-return-of-megg-1a371750ec.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule i-"Ukubuya kwe-Megg" ku-Halo 2: Anniversary ngaphakathi kwe-Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), dlala i-Cairo Station ku-Legendary bese ulandela umzila ofihliwe ngaphandle kokushaya into edingekayo yokuvula. Finyelela indawo kuvidiyo bese ulinda inkhulumomphendvulwano ekhethekile. Zama futhi endaweni yokuhlola yangaphambilini uma wenza umonakalo.

halomcc-shiny-0eb73b2d94.name: Shiny...
halomcc-shiny-0eb73b2d94.description: H3: ODST: Shayela i-Banshee ku-Kizingo Boulevard.
halomcc-shiny-0eb73b2d94.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Shiny..." kokuthi Halo 3: ODST ngaphakathi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), dlala i-Kizingo Boulevard futhi uthathe umzila oboniswe kuvidiyo ukuze ufike ku-Banshee. Ngena esihlalweni somshayeli undize imoto ukuze uqalise impumelelo.

halomcc-wetwork-7f2ab9761b.name: Umsebenzi omanzi
halomcc-wetwork-7f2ab9761b.description: Halo 2A MP: Ku-Shrine ku-CTF, yenza impophoma yesisekelo sesitha isebenze futhi, ngaphambi kokuthi ime, bamba ifulegi.
halomcc-wetwork-7f2ab9761b.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Umsebenzi omanzi" kokuthi Halo 2: Anniversary ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), dlala i-CTF ku-Shrine futhi ufinyelele iswishi sempophoma yesisekelo sesitha. Yenze isebenze futhi ufike kufulegi labo ngaphambi kokuthi amanzi ame. Setha umzila wakho oya efulegini ngaphambi kokucindezela iswishi.

halomcc-icarus-014be3815c.name: I-Icarus
halomcc-icarus-014be3815c.description: Halo 4: Qedela zonke izahluko Spartan Ops ezimayelana nobunzima benganekwane.
halomcc-icarus-014be3815c.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Icarus" kokuthi Halo 4 ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), vula okuthi Spartan Ops kokuthi Halo 4 bese usethe kokuthi Inganekwane. Qedela zonke izahluko ezinhlanu zesiqephu ngasinye kweziyi-10. Sebenzisa imenyu yesiqephu ukuze uthole noma yiziphi izahluko ezishoda ngokusobala.

halomcc-catch-this-9bec9c9254.name: Bamba Lokhu
halomcc-catch-this-9bec9c9254.description: Zuza isamba sezindondo ezingama-500 zeGrenade Kill noma zePlasma Kill emidlalweni eyenziwe ngomentshisi.
halomcc-catch-this-9bec9c9254.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Bamba Lokhu" ku-Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), thola izindondo ezingama-500 zeGrenade Kill noma zePlasma Kill emidlalweni eyenziwe ngomentshisi. Sebenzisa ama-Frag Grenade ukuze uqedele abaphikisi ababuthaka emakhoneni noma unamathisele isitha nge-Plasma Grenade. Ividiyo ikhombisa amabhomu abulalayo ongazijwayeza ukwenza umentshisi. Qhubeka udlala ngemiphumela ukuze izindondo zibalwe.

halomcc-no-easy-way-out-06bea3756d.name: Ayikho Indlela Elula Yokuphuma
halomcc-no-easy-way-out-06bea3756d.description: Halo 4: Survive Spartan Miller (Ep.5 Ch.1) of Spartan Ops kokuthi Ubuqhawe noma Inganekwane.
halomcc-no-easy-way-out-06bea3756d.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ayikho Indlela Elula Yokuphuma" kokuthi Halo 4 ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), khetha Isiqephu 5, Isahluko 1 (Spartan Miller) kokuthi Halo 4 Spartan Ops kokuthi Amaqhawe noma Inganekwane. Bamba amaphuzu okuzivikela futhi uqedele zonke izinjongo zesahluko.

halomcc-hazard-pay-221fb36ec0.name: I-Hazard Pay
halomcc-hazard-pay-221fb36ec0.description: Halo 4: Qedela zonke izahluko Spartan Ops zobunzima Bobuqhawe.
halomcc-hazard-pay-221fb36ec0.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Hazard Pay" kokuthi Halo 4 ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), vula okuthi Spartan Ops kokuthi Halo 4 bese usethe kokuthi Iqhawe. Qedela zonke izahluko ezinhlanu zesiqephu ngasinye kweziyi-10. Sebenzisa imenyu yesiqephu ukuze uthole noma yiziphi izahluko ezishoda ngokusobala.

halomcc-airborne-d25fa1e26b.name: Esemoyeni
halomcc-airborne-d25fa1e26b.description: Halo CE: Yethula i-Warthog okungenani imizuzwana emi-5 futhi uyenze isakaze isitha.
halomcc-airborne-d25fa1e26b.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Esemoyeni" kokuthi Halo: Combat Evolved Anniversary ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), setha ukwethulwa kwe-Warthog okuboniswa kuvidiyo futhi ugcine okuqondiwe endaweni yokufikela. Yethula i-Warthog kude ngokwanele ukuze uhlale emoyeni okungenani imizuzwana emihlanu, bese uhlala endaweni ehlosiwe ukuze uthole i-splatter.

halomcc-the-true-king-0d9ff94d2a.name: Inkosi Yeqiniso
halomcc-the-true-king-0d9ff94d2a.description: Zuza isamba sezindondo Eziqondile zemodi ye-KOTH engu-250 emidlalweni eyenziwe ngomentshisi.
halomcc-the-true-king-0d9ff94d2a.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Inkosi Yeqiniso" kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), thola izindondo eziqondile zemodi ye-KOTH engu-250 emidlalweni eyenziwe ngomentshisi. Faka umugqa we-King of the Hill futhi ulwele igquma elisebenzayo ukuze uzuze izindondo zalo ezihlosiwe. Qhubeka udlala ngemiphumela ukuze izindondo zibalwe.

halomcc-invaders-repelled-864c8db02b.name: Abahlaseli Baxoshiwe
halomcc-invaders-repelled-864c8db02b.description: Halo 2A MP: Enkosini Yentaba, bulala abaphikisi abangu-5 ngaphakathi kwegquma lakho elilawulwayo.
halomcc-invaders-repelled-864c8db02b.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Abahlaseli Baxoshiwe" kokuthi Halo 2: Anniversary ngaphakathi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kokuthi Halo 2: Anniversary King of the Hill, vumela iqembu lakho libambe igquma. Bulala izitha ezinhlanu ngenkathi zingaphakathi kwegquma olilawulayo. Sebenzisa ikhava ngaphandle kwendlela yesitha ukuze ugcine ukubona indawo.

halomcc-annual-2fd4aca16c.name: Ngonyaka
halomcc-annual-2fd4aca16c.description: Halo 3: Qedela i-Halo ku-4-player Legendary co-op, ne-Iron Skull, nawo wonke umuntu ku-Ghosts.
halomcc-annual-2fd4aca16c.guideDescription:
Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ngonyaka" kokuthi Halo 3 ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), landela lezi zinyathelo.

1. Layisha i-Halo ku-Halo 3 ngabadlali abane be-co-op, i-Legendary ne-Iron inikwe amandla.
2. Ekubalekeni, thatha izipoki ezine futhi wonke umuntu ahlale kweyakhe kuze kube sekupheleni.
3. Gcina iqembu lindawonye ukuze kungabikho muntu osalayo lapho egxuma.

halomcc-no-one-left-behind-309471e8e5.name: Akekho Osele Ngemva
halomcc-no-one-left-behind-309471e8e5.description: Halo 4: Londoloza okungenani i-Marine eyodwa ku-Hacksaw (Ep.2 Ch.3) ye-Spartan Ops kokuthi Ubuqhawe noma Inganekwane.
halomcc-no-one-left-behind-309471e8e5.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Akekho Osele Ngemva" kokuthi Halo 4 ngaphakathi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), qala i-Hacksaw (Isiqephu 2, Isahluko 3) se-Halo 4 Spartan Ops ku-Heroic noma Inganekwane. Sula izitha ezizungeze i-Marines ngokushesha nje lapho ufika kuzo futhi uhlale useduze kuze kube yilapho okungenani oyedwa esinda ekuvikelweni.

halomcc-why-do-this-to-yourself-8f09d234.name: Kungani Uzenzela Lokhu Kuwe?
halomcc-why-do-this-to-yourself-8f09d234.description: Halo: Reach: Qedela uhlu lwadlalwayo lomkhankaso we-Halo: Reach LASO.
halomcc-why-do-this-to-yourself-8f09d234.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Kungani Uzenzela Lokhu Kuwe?" kokuthi Halo: Reach ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), vula Izinhla zokudlalayo Zomkhankaso bese uqala uhlu lwadlalwayo olwakhelwe ngaphakathi lwe-LASO. Sebenzisa ama-Skulls ayo abelwe futhi uqedele ohambweni olulondolozwe uhlu lwadlalwayo olufanayo. Yilwa nekhava, sebenzisa i-melee ukuze ubuyisele izihlangu lapho i-Black Eye idinga khona, futhi ufinyelele ekupheleni komsebenzi wokugcina.

halomcc-smooth-operator-6241dc65c7.name: I-Operator ebushelelezi
halomcc-smooth-operator-6241dc65c7.description: Halo 4: Qedela zonke izahluko Spartan Ops uwedwa kubunzima beLegendary.
halomcc-smooth-operator-6241dc65c7.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Operator ebushelelezi" kokuthi Halo 4 ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), vula okuthi Spartan Ops kokuthi Halo 4 bese usethe kokuthi Inganekwane. Qedela zonke izahluko ezinhlanu zesiqephu ngasinye kwezingu-10 ngaphandle kokujoyina omunye umdlali. Sebenzisa imenyu yesiqephu ukuze uthole noma yiziphi izahluko ezishoda ngokusobala.

halomcc-knightbane-2ce22a2464.name: Knightbane
halomcc-knightbane-2ce22a2464.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule "Knightbane" ku-Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), susa ama-Knights angu-1000. Dlala kabusha umgomo we-Halo 4 ngama-Prometheans noma ukhethe isahluko esithi Spartan Ops esiwafakayo. Qhubeka ususa izitha ezifanelekile njengoba usebenza ngezinye izimpumelelo.

halomcc-mind-the-gap-5a7512e684.name: Qaphela iGap
halomcc-mind-the-gap-5a7512e684.description: Halo 3: Izimoto ezi-4, igebe eli-1 ku-Legendary kusetshenziswa i-Cowbell, i-Catch, i-Dunderstorm, i-Mythic, ne-Tough Luck.
halomcc-mind-the-gap-5a7512e684.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Qaphela iGap" kokuthi Halo 3 ngaphakathi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), layisha umgwaqo i-Tsavo Highway ku-Legendary nge-Cowbell, Catch, Thunderstorm, Mythic, ne-Tough Luck enikwe amandla. Qoqa izimoto ezine, uziyise esikhaleni, bese ulandela ukulandelana kwevidiyo ukuze uwele ngayinye. Gcina imoto ngayinye iqinile kuze kube yilapho igxuma.

halomcc-deja-vu-f401441a60.name: Déja Vu
halomcc-deja-vu-f401441a60.description: H3: ODST: Qedela umgwaqo omkhulu wasogwini ku-Legendary co-op yabadlali abangu-4, nge-Iron, futhi akukho 'Hog noma Scorpion.
halomcc-deja-vu-f401441a60.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Déja Vu" kokuthi Halo 3: ODST ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), qala i-Coastal Highway ngokuhlanganyela kwabadlali abane ku-Legendary nge-Iron enikwe amandla. Sebenzisa ama-Mongoose nezikhali ezivela kunqolobane eseceleni ukuze uthole ukuphelezelwa komgwaqo omkhulu, futhi uqedele ngaphandle komuntu osebenzisa i-Warthog noma i-Scorpion.

halomcc-you-re-joking-665b395534.description: Halo 4: Qedela konke Halo 4 ohambweni lomkhankaso wenganekwane ngaphansi kwamahora angu-3.
halomcc-you-re-joking-665b395534.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Uyancokola" kokuthi Halo 4 ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), qedela ohambweni lomkhankaso ku-Legendary futhi ulethe isikhathi esirekhodiwe esihlanganisiwe sibe ngaphansi kwamahora amathathu. Dlala kusukela ekuqaleni kwe-mission ngayinye ngesikhathi esinikwe amandla, funda lapho ungeqa khona ukuhlangana, futhi udlale kabusha izigaba lapho ungonga khona isikhathi esiningi.

halomcc-remove-the-bishops-from-the-boar.name: Susa Ababhishobhi Ebhodini
halomcc-remove-the-bishops-from-the-boar.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Susa Ababhishobhi Ebhodini" ku-Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), susa izibukeli eziyi-1000. Dlala kabusha umgomo we-Halo 4 ngama-Prometheans noma ukhethe isahluko esithi Spartan Ops esiwafakayo. Qhubeka ususa izitha ezifanelekile njengoba usebenza ngezinye izimpumelelo.

halomcc-monopolized-4bdb4de6f2.name: Ibekwe yedwa
halomcc-monopolized-4bdb4de6f2.description: Halo 2: Qedela konke Halo 2 ohambweni lomkhankaso wenganekwane ngaphansi kwamahora angu-3.
halomcc-monopolized-4bdb4de6f2.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ibekwe yedwa" kokuthi Halo 2: Anniversary ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), qedela ohambweni lomkhankaso ku-Legendary futhi ulethe isikhathi esirekhodiwe esihlanganisiwe sibe ngaphansi kwamahora amathathu. Dlala kusukela ekuqaleni kwe-mission ngayinye ngesikhathi esinikwe amandla, funda lapho ungeqa khona ukuhlangana, futhi udlale kabusha izigaba lapho ungonga khona isikhathi esiningi.

halomcc-roadkill-rampage-4bac3c2ffe.name: I-Roadkill Rampage
halomcc-roadkill-rampage-4bac3c2ffe.description: Halo 2A MP: Ekwenziweni komdlalo wokugubha iminyaka yonke, zuza isamba sezindondo eziyi-100 ze-Splatter.
halomcc-roadkill-rampage-4bac3c2ffe.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Roadkill Rampage" kokuthi Halo 2: Anniversary ngaphakathi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), ulayini Halo 2: Anniversary wokufanisa kumamephu anezimoto. Shayela phakathi kwezimbangi ukuze uthole izindondo ze-Splatter, sebenzisa i-boost yemoto lapho itholakala khona, futhi uqhubeke udlala uze uthole eziyi-100 zalezo zindondo.

halomcc-rock-and-coil-hit-back-d69ffbff3.name: I-Rock ne-Coil Hit Back
halomcc-rock-and-coil-hit-back-d69ffbff3.description: Halo 2A MP: Ekwenziweni komdlalo wokugubha iminyaka yonke, zuza isamba sezindondo eziyi-100 ze-Environmentalist.
halomcc-rock-and-coil-hit-back-d69ffbff3.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Rock ne-Coil Hit Back" kokuthi Halo 2: Anniversary ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kokuthi Halo 2: Anniversary nokwenza umentshisi, sebenzisa izingozi zemephu ukuze uthole ukubulala. Beka iqhwa ku-Lockdown noma uqalise enye ingozi yokusebenzisana lapho ophikisana naye esendleleni yakhe. Bheka i-Environmentalist bese uphinda ukuthola izindondo eziyi-100.

halomcc-laso-master-f199f94aef.name: I-LASO Master
halomcc-laso-master-f199f94aef.description: Qedela uhlu lwadlalwayo oluqondene nomdlalo ngamunye we-LASO kuwo wonke umdlalo we-Halo.
halomcc-laso-master-f199f94aef.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-LASO Master" kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), vula imenyu yohlu lwadlalwayo lomkhankaso ngamunye womdlalo ngamunye bese ukhetha uhlu lwawo olusemthethweni lwe-LASO. Qedela uhlu lwadlalwayo ngalunye kusukela ekuqaleni kuya ekugcineni, uhlole okurekhodiwe okucacile ngaphambi kokushintshela emdlalweni olandelayo.

halo5-your-team-is-your-weapon-df4bf54c3.name: Ithimba Lakho Liyisikhali Sakho
halo5-your-team-is-your-weapon-df4bf54c3.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ithimba Lakho Liyisikhali Sakho" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, ku-Osiris, khomba esitheni noma iphuzu eliphansi futhi usebenzise okokufaka komyalo we-fireteam okuboniswa kusakhiwo sakho sokulawula. Bheka ozakwenu ukuthi avume noma enze ngokuvumelana ne-oda.

halo5-your-style-1cb83e0602.name: Isitayela Sakho
halo5-your-style-1cb83e0602.description: Shintsha igiya lakho le-Spartan ku-Spartan Hub.
halo5-your-style-1cb83e0602.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Isitayela Sakho" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, vula i-Spartan Hub bese uya ezinkethweni zokwenza ngokwezifiso zezikhali. Hlomisa isigqoko sokuzivikela esihlukile noma izivikelo zomzimba, bese uphuma noshintsho olusetshenzisiwe.

halo5-raise-your-banner-4fbc934e62.name: Phakamisa Isibhengezo Sakho
halo5-raise-your-banner-4fbc934e62.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Phakamisa Isibhengezo Sakho" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, vula isihleli sezimpawu ku-Spartan Hub, khetha uphawu oluhlukile noma ushintshe ukwakheka kwalo, bese usebenzisa uphawu olusha.

halo5-make-your-mark-6bfdee7ee0.name: Yenza Umaki Wakho
halo5-make-your-mark-6bfdee7ee0.description: xhoma i-Service Tag yakho ku-Spartan Hub.
halo5-make-your-mark-6bfdee7ee0.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Yenza Umaki Wakho" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, hamba kuzinketho ze-Spartan ID ku-Spartan Hub. Hlela Ithegi Yesevisi, faka ithegi ehlukile evumelekile, bese uyiqinisekisa.

halo5-gamemaster-cbcad7ee4e.name: Umphathi wegeyimu
halo5-gamemaster-cbcad7ee4e.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Umphathi wegeyimu" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, kokuthi Imidlalo Yangokwezifiso, vula izinketho zemodi yegeyimu, wenze ushintsho, futhi ulondoloze izilungiselelo zakho njengokuhlukile okusha. Qinisekisa ukulondoloza ngaphambi kokushiya indawo yokwamukela izivakashi.

halo5-benchwarmer-664674330b.name: I-Benchwarmer
halo5-benchwarmer-664674330b.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Benchwarmer" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, vula uhlelo lomdlali kugeyimu ongayibona futhi ukhethe inketho yokubuka lapho itholakala. Linda ukuthi umdlalo ulayishwe bese ufaka ukubuka kwesibukeli.

halo5-cry-havoc-7d22e7cf90.name: Khala Havoc
halo5-cry-havoc-7d22e7cf90.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Khala Havoc" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, faka ulayini we-Warzone evamile ngokwenza okufanayo futhi uhlale kuze kube isikrini somphumela. Qedela ukufana okuthathu ngohlu lwadlalwayo.

halo5-bringing-in-the-big-guns-b34c4f315.name: Engenisa Izibhamu Ezinkulu
halo5-bringing-in-the-big-guns-b34c4f315.description: Shayela i-REQ ebiza 5 Amandla noma ngaphezulu.
halo5-bringing-in-the-big-guns-b34c4f315.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Engenisa Izibhamu Ezinkulu" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, e-Warzone, dlala izinjongo futhi wakhe ileveli yakho ye-REQ namandla. Ngemva kokufinyelela ileveli 5 noma ngaphezulu, vula isiteshi se-REQ noma sebenzisa imenyu yokuzala ukuze ushayele ikhadi elibiza okungenani amandla angu-5.

halo5-go-for-the-gold-8dc4251fd0.name: Hamba uthole Igolide
halo5-go-for-the-gold-8dc4251fd0.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Hamba uthole Igolide" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, kumenyu ye-REQ, vula i-Gold REQ Pack. Uma ungenayo, hlola amaphekhi atholakalayo futhi usebenzise amaphuzu e-REQ azuziwe lapho iphekhi linikezwa khona.

halo5-warlord-a212cef84d.name: Inkosi yempi
halo5-warlord-a212cef84d.description: Wina umdlalo kuwo womathathu amamephu wangempela we-Warzone.
halo5-warlord-a212cef84d.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Inkosi yempi" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, dlala i-Warzone eyenziwe ngomdlalo futhi uwine ku-Escape from A.R.C., Raid on Apex 7, kanye no-March on Stormbreak. Landela ngomkhondo lawa mamephu amathathu ngokuhlukene futhi uhlale emiphumeleni ngemva kokuwina ngakunye.

halo5-castle-crasher-3a990a9032.name: I-Castle Crasher
halo5-castle-crasher-3a990a9032.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Castle Crasher" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, khetha uhlu lokudlalwayo lokufanisa oluhlanganisa i-Strongholds futhi uqedele okufanayo okuhlanu kwaleyo modi. Zungezisa phakathi kwezinqaba ezinobungane futhi usize ukuvikela izindawo zakho ezimbili ezibanjiwe. Hlala esikrinini semiphumela ukuze umdlalo ngamunye ubale.

halo5-off-to-the-races-a244186313.name: Ehle Emijahweni
halo5-off-to-the-races-a244186313.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ehle Emijahweni" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, khetha uhlu lokudlalwayo lokufanisa oluhlanganisa iBreakout futhi uqedele okufanayo okuhlanu kwaleyo modi. Hlala nethimba lakho ukuze nikwazi ukukhava omunye nomunye uma umzuliswano uqala. Hlala esikrinini semiphumela ukuze umdlalo ngamunye ubale.

halo5-flag-monger-aa8dbd40ce.name: Umdidiyeli wefulegi
halo5-flag-monger-aa8dbd40ce.description: Qedela imidlalo emi-5 eyenziwe ngokufanisa ye-Capture the Flag.
halo5-flag-monger-aa8dbd40ce.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Umdidiyeli wefulegi" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, khetha uhlu lwadlalwayo lokufanisa oluhlanganisa ukuthwebula ifulegi futhi uqedele okufanayo okuhlanu kwaleyo modi. Vikela inkampani yenethiwekhi futhi usize ukubuyisela ifulegi lakho uma lithathwa. Hlala esikrinini semiphumela ukuze umdlalo ngamunye ubale.

halo5-spartan-decimation-29dfec8727.name: I-Spartan Decimation
halo5-spartan-decimation-29dfec8727.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Spartan Decimation" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, khetha uhlu lokudlalwayo lokufanisa oluhlanganisa i-Slayer futhi uqedele okufanayo okuhlanu kwaleyo modi. Yilwa eduze nozakwenu ukuze ukwazi ukuhlanganisa umonakalo kanye nokuqedwa kohwebo. Hlala esikrinini semiphumela ukuze umdlalo ngamunye ubale.

halo5-into-the-fire-98f6f9e8b8.name: Emlilweni
halo5-into-the-fire-98f6f9e8b8.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Emlilweni" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, layisha i-Mission 1, "Osiris", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Landela i-Fireteam Osiris eqhweni nasezicishamlilo ukuze ufinyelele kuDkt. Halsey.

halo5-argent-moon-b807ecc1be.name: I-Argent Moon
halo5-argent-moon-b807ecc1be.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Argent Moon" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, layisha i-Mission 2, "Blue Team", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. I-Board Argent Moon njengeThimba Eliluhlaza. Sebenza esiteshini futhi ufinyelele ku-hangar ukuze ubaleke.

halo5-gravedigger-40680da6db.name: I-Gravedigger
halo5-gravedigger-40680da6db.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Gravedigger" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, cosha noma iyiphi i-Skull efihliwe phakathi nomsebenzi womkhankaso. Qala nge-Skull ku-Osiris futhi usebenzise ividiyo ukuze uthole i-ledge nendlela.

halo5-escape-4a597d2877.name: Phunyuka
halo5-escape-4a597d2877.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Phunyuka" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, layisha i-Mission 6, "Evacuation", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Finyelela ilifti ye-orbital, bese usula izitha ku-elevator futhi uqhubeke uhamba ngokulandelana kokuphunyuka.

halo5-together-again-d9493fe6f8.name: Sindawonye Futhi
halo5-together-again-d9493fe6f8.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Sindawonye Futhi" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, layisha i-Mission 7, "Reunion", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Landela umkhondo ngokusebenzisa umhosha. Sebenzisa i-Phaeton lapho itholakala khona futhi ubheke iphoyinti lendlela elilandelayo ngemva kwempi ngayinye.

halo5-reclamation-60ecda549a.name: Ukubuyiselwa kabusha
halo5-reclamation-60ecda549a.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukubuyiselwa kabusha" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, layisha i-Mission 13, "Genesis", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Sebenzisa i-Scorpion ukusula umzila kuGenesise. Susa izinsongo ezinzima ukusuka kude ngaphambi kokuqhubekela phambili.

halo5-a-new-dawn-8878e6cc16.name: Ukuntwela Okusha
halo5-a-new-dawn-8878e6cc16.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukuntwela Okusha" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, layisha i-Mission 14, "The Breaking", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Sula ukuhlangana kwe-Promethean ne-Blue Team futhi usebenzise ikhava ukuze uhlukanise ukunaka kwa-Wardens phakathi nempi yokugcina.

halo5-legacy-082348262b.name: Ifa
halo5-legacy-082348262b.description: Qedela yonke iMishini yomdlalo ngobunzima obujwayelekile.
halo5-legacy-082348262b.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ifa" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, setha umkhankaso ube Okuvamile futhi uqedele yonke imisebenzi engu-15. Hlola ubunzima oburekhodiwe bomkhankaso ngamunye ku-Mission Select, futhi uthathe izimpi kusukela ekhava ukuze ithimba lomlilo likwazi ukuvuselela ama-Spartans awile.

halo5-heroes-rise-3a4aeb757f.name: Maqhawe Phakama
halo5-heroes-rise-3a4aeb757f.description: Qedela yonke iMishini yomdlalo ngobunzima beHeroic.
halo5-heroes-rise-3a4aeb757f.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Maqhawe Phakama" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, setha umkhankaso ube Obuqhawe futhi uqedele yonke imisebenzi engu-15. Hlola ubunzima oburekhodiwe bomkhankaso ngamunye ku-Mission Select, futhi uthathe izimpi kusukela ekhava ukuze ithimba lomlilo likwazi ukuvuselela ama-Spartans awile.

halo5-forging-a-legend-73e9979b0b.name: Ukuqamba Inganekwane
halo5-forging-a-legend-73e9979b0b.description: Qedela yonke iMishini yomdlalo ngobunzima beLegendary.
halo5-forging-a-legend-73e9979b0b.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukuqamba Inganekwane" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, setha umkhankaso kokuthi Inganekwane futhi uqedele yonke imisebenzi engu-15. Hlola ubunzima oburekhodiwe bomkhankaso ngamunye ku-Mission Select, futhi uthathe izimpi kusukela ekhava ukuze ithimba lomlilo likwazi ukuvuselela ama-Spartans awile.

halo5-conspiracy-theory-e31504ddf4.name: Ithiyori Yozungu
halo5-conspiracy-theory-e31504ddf4.description: Thola futhi ufune ucezu olulodwa lwe-Intel.
halo5-conspiracy-theory-e31504ddf4.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ithiyori Yozungu" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, e-Osiris, hlola izindawo zokuqala ze-Intel ekuhambeni okuxhunyiwe futhi usebenzise ukwaziswa kokuhlanganyela kokukodwa. Noma yimuphi umkhankaso oqoqekayo ubala i-Intel.

halo5-top-of-the-food-chain-1b09345cab.name: Top of the Food Chain
halo5-top-of-the-food-chain-1b09345cab.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Top of the Food Chain" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, e-Warzone, linda isimemezelo somphathi Wenganekwane. Iya kubasi omakiwe ngesikhali samandla noma imoto, yihlasele eduze kweqembu lakho, bese uzama ukushaya into eqeda lokho.

halo5-hunt-the-truth-693384dcee.name: Zingela Iqiniso
halo5-hunt-the-truth-693384dcee.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Zingela Iqiniso" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, qoqa umkhankaso we-Intel kuzo zonke izimishini eziyi-15. Hlola ikhawunta ye-Intel ku-Mission Select, phinda udlale ohambweni ngokuthatha izithombe ezingekho, futhi usebenzise amavidiyo ahambayo ukuze uthole into ngayinye.

halo5-fire-drill-58cb781626.name: I-Fire Drill
halo5-fire-drill-58cb781626.description: Qedela Ukuphunyuka phakathi kuka-18:00 ngaphandle kokushona ngobunzima Bobuqhawe.
halo5-fire-drill-58cb781626.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Fire Drill" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, layisha u-Evacuation kokuthi Heroic futhi uqede emizuzwini engu-18 ngaphandle kokufa. Sebenzisa imoto ukuze uwele indawo evulekile kusenesikhathi, uye ngqo ekheshini, futhi ucashe phakathi nokuzivikela kwayo kokugcina.

halo5-gravelord-04e733d624.name: I-Gravelord
halo5-gravelord-04e733d624.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Gravelord" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, qoqa lonke ugebhezi lwekhanda olufihliwe phakathi nomkhankaso. Thatha ngayinye nge-Interact futhi uhlole ukuqhubeka kwe-Skull ku-Mission Select ngaphambi kokudlala kabusha ohambweni ngama-pickup angekho.

halo5-enemy-of-my-enemy-6d9377ce9b.name: Isitha Sezitha zami
halo5-enemy-of-my-enemy-6d9377ce9b.description: Siza i-Elite General ikhokhise igquma e-Osiris ngobunzima bobuqhawe.
halo5-enemy-of-my-enemy-6d9377ce9b.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Isitha Sezitha zami" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, dlala i-Osiris ethi Heroic. Uma ufika eqenjini leSivumelwano eduze kwegquma, vumela i-Elite General iphile futhi ikhiphe ama-Prometheans avimbe umzila wakhe. Phusha naye esikhundleni sokusula iqembu lama-Elite.

halo5-i-thought-i-d-lost-you-b6d4b09d3e.name: Bengithi Ngizolahlekelwa Nguwe
halo5-i-thought-i-d-lost-you-b6d4b09d3e.description: Escape the Hunters elebhu futhi ulwe nabo ku-hangar ku-Blue Team.
halo5-i-thought-i-d-lost-you-b6d4b09d3e.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Bengithi Ngizolahlekelwa Nguwe" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, ku-Blue Team, gijima udlule i-Hunters elebhu esikhundleni sokubabulala lapho. Qhubekela ku-hangar, bese usebenzisa ikhava ukuze uthole ngemuva kwalaba ababili futhi ulwe nabo lapho.

halo5-on-my-mark-62fbdf28ae.name: Kumaki Ami
halo5-on-my-mark-62fbdf28ae.description: Ngesikhathi esifanayo bulala ama-Elite amabili ku-Blue Team co-op.
halo5-on-my-mark-62fbdf28ae.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Kumaki Ami" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, layisha i-Blue Team ngokubambisana. Umdlali ngamunye kufanele akhethe eyodwa yama-Elite amabili futhi ahambe ngemuva kwayo engabonwa. Bala phansi phezu kwengxoxo yezwi futhi ubambe i-melee ukuze uqale kokubili ukubulala ngesikhathi esisodwa.

halo5-going-the-distance-88f98f8719.name: Ukuhamba Ibanga
halo5-going-the-distance-88f98f8719.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukuhamba Ibanga" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, dlala okuthi Glassed kusukela ekuqaleni. Landela umzila ngezinyawo futhi uwele izingxenye zemoto ngezinyawo futhi. Hlala kude nokwaziswa kwemoto yokungena kuze kuphele ukuthunyelwa.

halo5-shoot-from-the-hip-93e0a2cee9.name: Dubula ku-Hip
halo5-shoot-from-the-hip-93e0a2cee9.description: Gcwalisa Ngengilazi ngaphandle kwabadlali abasebenzisa i-Smart-Link.
halo5-shoot-from-the-hip-93e0a2cee9.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Dubula ku-Hip" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, dlala ethi Glassed and fire from the hip lonke. Gcina okokufaka kwe- aim-down-sights kungathintwa. Ngokusebenzisana, qinisekisa ukuthi wonke umdlali uyazi ukugwema i-Smart-Link ngaphambi kokuthi kuqale umkhankaso.

halo5-waiting-on-you-f1a60e2c48.name: Ngikulindile
halo5-waiting-on-you-f1a60e2c48.description: Bulala isitha esilungiswe izikhali zaso kokuthi Okungaqinisekisiwe.
halo5-waiting-on-you-f1a60e2c48.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ngikulindile" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, kokuthi Okungaqinisekisiwe, vumela Umbukeli alungise isitha esilimele se-Promethean. Uma usubona izikhali ezilungisiwe, gxilisa umlilo wakho kuleso sitha size sife.

halo5-maverick-231ad0ba79.name: UMaverick
halo5-maverick-231ad0ba79.description: Hlanganani emotweni ukuze nibulale izitha ezingu-30 ku-Co-op Engaqinisekisiwe.
halo5-maverick-231ad0ba79.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "UMaverick" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, qala okuthi Okungaqinisekisiwe ku-co-op bese ufaka abadlali ababili emotweni efanayo. Yenza oyedwa ashayele umzila wokudubula kuyilapho omunye esusa izitha. Hlalani ndawonye emotweni uze ubulale izitha ezingu-30.

halo5-savior-1ea30b51d7.name: Msindisi
halo5-savior-1ea30b51d7.description: Gcina abavukuzi abangu-6 bephila kukheshi ekuPhumeni ebunzimeni beHeroic.
halo5-savior-1ea30b51d7.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Msindisi" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, layisha u-Evacuation kokuthi Heroic. Ku-lifti, qhubekela phambili ngokushesha futhi ugxile ezitheni ezidubula abavukuzi. Bamba isikhundla ngokubuka kweqembu kuze kuphele ukulwa okungenani kubavukuzi abayisithupha besaphila.

halo5-take-a-hike-055accd709.name: Thatha i-Hike
halo5-take-a-hike-055accd709.description: Dabula umhosha ngaphandle kwe-Phaeton e-Reunion ngobunzima bobuqhawe.
halo5-take-a-hike-055accd709.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Thatha i-Hike" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, ku-Reunion on Heroic, landela umhosha ngezinyawo kunokugibela i-Phaeton. Sula izinsongo zebanga elide kusukela embozweni futhi usebenzise amakhono akho okunyakaza ukweqa izikhala kumzila wokuhamba.

halo5-no-witnesses-13d17bfa3d.name: Abekho oFakazi
halo5-no-witnesses-13d17bfa3d.description: Bhubhisa i-Phantom ekamu leSivumelwano e-Reunion ngobunzima bobuqhawe.
halo5-no-witnesses-13d17bfa3d.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Abekho oFakazi" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, ku-Reunion on Heroic, finyelela ekamu Lesivumelwano uphethe isikhali esinzima esilungile. Qala ukudubula i-Phantom ngokushesha nje lapho une-engeli ehlanzekile bese ulehlisa ngaphambi kokuthi isuke.

halo5-no-knock-raid-483f37ce3a.name: Akukho Knock Raid
halo5-no-knock-raid-483f37ce3a.description: Bhubhisa izindonga noma izitezi eziyi-10 ku-Swords of Sanghelios.
halo5-no-knock-raid-483f37ce3a.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Akukho Knock Raid" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, ku-Swords of Sanghelios, bheka izindonga eziqhekekile kanye naphansi ongaziphula nge-Spartan Charge noma i-Ground Pound. Bhubhisa izingcezu ezihlukene eziyi-10 njengoba udlula kumishini.

halo5-preying-mantis-79c750ada1.name: Edla isithwalambiza
halo5-preying-mantis-79c750ada1.description: Qedela Izinkemba ze-Sanghelios zisebenzisana nazo zombili izithwalambiza ngobunzima bobuqhawe.
halo5-preying-mantis-79c750ada1.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Edla isithwalambiza" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, layisha izinkemba ze-Sanghelios ku-Heroic nozakwethu wokubambisana. Thatha isithwalambiza esisodwa ngamunye. Yilwani nisuka ebangeni nishintshane ngokudweba umlilo ukuze izithwalambiza zisinde kuze kube sekupheleni.

halo5-kraken-lackin-b4502f2080.name: I-Kraken Lackin'
halo5-kraken-lackin-b4502f2080.description: Gcwalisa Imigqa Yezitha ngaphandle kokucekela phansi i-Kraken turret.
halo5-kraken-lackin-b4502f2080.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule i-"I-Kraken Lackin'" ku-Halo 5: Guardians, ku-Enemy Lines, ndiza uye e-Kraken futhi uhlale kuyo ngaphandle kokudubula ama-turrets ayo. Sula izisebenzi ngezinyawo, ucekele phansi umongo, futhi ushiye umkhumbi ngenkathi yonke i-turret isaphelele.

halo5-emergency-boarding-procedures-3e2f.name: Izinqubo Zokugibela Eziphuthumayo
halo5-emergency-boarding-procedures-3e2f.description: Balekela i-Kraken elahlekile ngokugxumela ku-Phaeton eshayelwa i-Spartan.
halo5-emergency-boarding-procedures-3e2f.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Izinqubo Zokugibela Eziphuthumayo" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, ngokubambisana ku-Enemy Lines, yiba nomshayeli wendiza oyedwa oyi-Phaeton futhi omunye acekele phansi i-Kraken core. Hambisa i-Phaeton eduze kwendawo yokugxuma yomdlali obalekile ukuze bagxume besuka eKraken bese begibela.

halo5-death-from-above-79ec279408.name: Ukufa okuvela Phezulu
halo5-death-from-above-79ec279408.description: Bulala i-Grunt bese uphihliza i-grate nge-Ground Pound e-Battle of Sunaion.
halo5-death-from-above-79ec279408.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukufa okuvela Phezulu" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, ku-Battle of Sunaion, thola i-Grunt emi phezu noma eduze kwe-grate ephukayo. Gxuma usuka phezulu futhi uqondise i-Ground Pound eshajiwe ukuze iphule i-grate futhi ibulale i-Grunt ngendlela efanayo.

halo5-worms-don-t-surf-9b98b41651.name: Izikelemu Musa Ukuntweza
halo5-worms-don-t-surf-9b98b41651.description: Khipha abazingeli ababili olwandle ngesikhathi seMpi yeSunaion.
halo5-worms-don-t-surf-9b98b41651.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Izikelemu Musa Ukuntweza" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, e-Battle of Sunaion, yenga uMzingeli ngamunye emaphethelweni angaphandle abheke ulwandle. Sondela ukusuka ohlangothini lwezwe futhi usebenzise i-Spartan Charge noma i-knockback eboniswe kuvidiyo ukuze uphushe bobabili aba-Hunters.

halo5-tank-still-beats-everything-3bdef2.name: I-Tank Ishaya Konke
halo5-tank-still-beats-everything-3bdef2.description: Qedela umsebenzi we-13 ngaphandle kokulahlekelwa i-Scorpion ebunzimeni be-Legendary.
halo5-tank-still-beats-everything-3bdef2.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Tank Ishaya Konke" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, dlala uGenesise ku-Legendary futhi ugcine i-Scorpion iphila kuze kuphele umkhankaso. Khetsa izikhali ezisindayo kububanzi bamathangi futhi ubuyele ngemuva kwendawo lapho izitha zivala.

halo5-rolling-thunder-f02f07a818.name: Ukuduma kwezulu
halo5-rolling-thunder-f02f07a818.description: Sebenzisa izimoto ezine ezahlukene ngesikhathi esisodwa ku-Mission 13 kubunzima bobuqhawe.
halo5-rolling-thunder-f02f07a818.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukuduma kwezulu" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, layisha iGenesis ku-Heroic nozakwethu abenele ukushayela izimoto ezine. Funa izinhlobo zezimoto ezine ezihlukene phakathi nomsebenzi futhi wenze bonke abadlali abane bashayele ngesikhathi esisodwa.

halo5-harbinger-5bc36aeb44.name: I-Harbinger
halo5-harbinger-5bc36aeb44.description: Qedela i-The Breaking on Legendary difficulty ngaphandle kokuthi i-fireteam yonke ife.
halo5-harbinger-5bc36aeb44.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Harbinger" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, qala i-The Breaking on Legendary. Sebenzisa ikhava futhi uhlukanise ama-engeli akho okudubula ukuze ukuhlasela okukodwa kungakwazi ukwehlisa iqembu. Vuselela ama-Spartans awehlisiwe ngokushesha nje lapho kuphephile futhi uqedele umkhankaso ngaphandle kokusula okugcwele kwe-fireteam.

halo5-prison-break-f7063f1355.name: Ikhefu Lejele
halo5-prison-break-f7063f1355.description: Ngesikhathi esifanayo bulala onogada ababili kubunzima be-Breaking on Heroic.
halo5-prison-break-f7063f1355.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ikhefu Lejele" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, kokuthi The Breaking on Heroic, limaza Onogada ababili baze bacishe bahlulwe. Qondisa amagalelo okugcina nozakwenu noma uwashaye ndawonye ngomonakalo we-splash ukuze bobabili bafe ngesikhathi esisodwa.

halo5-icy-cool-e181026e33.name: Icy Cool
halo5-icy-cool-e181026e33.description: Sebenzisa i-Ground Pound kumongo wamandla wangaphandle kokuthi Abaqaphi Kubunzima Bobuqhawe.
halo5-icy-cool-e181026e33.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule i-"Icy Cool" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, dlala i-Guardians on Heroic futhi ukhwele ngaphezu kweyodwa yama-core cores aveziwe. Gxumela kuyo, shaja i-Ground Pound emoyeni, bese uhlasela umgogodla.

halo5-double-stuff-27d0c0ec03.name: Izinto Ezikabili
halo5-double-stuff-27d0c0ec03.description: Ngesikhathi esifanayo bhubhisa ama-cores angu-2 ku-Guardians on Heroic difficulty.
halo5-double-stuff-27d0c0ec03.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Izinto Ezikabili" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, kokuthi Guardians on Heroic, yenza buthaka amakhora amabili angaphandle ngaphandle kokuwacekela phansi. Ngokuhlanganyela, nikeza umdlali ngamunye ingqikithi bese nibala phansi ukuze nithole amashothi okugcina ndawonye.

halo5-lone-wolf-5d71c25973.name: Impisi Yodwa
halo5-lone-wolf-5d71c25973.description: Qedela yonke iMishini yomdlalo uwedwa ngobunzima beLegendary.
halo5-lone-wolf-5d71c25973.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Impisi Yodwa" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, setha umkhankaso ku-Legendary futhi uqedele yonke imisebenzi engu-15 ngaphandle kokujoyina omunye umdlali. Hlola ubunzima oburekhodiwe bomkhankaso ngamunye ku-Mission Select, futhi uthathe izimpi kusukela ekhava ukuze ithimba lomlilo likwazi ukuvuselela ama-Spartans awile.

halo5-one-for-all-6f2b07344d.name: Okukodwa Kwabo Bonke
halo5-one-for-all-6f2b07344d.description: Qedela noma iyiphi i-Co-op Mission kubunzima bobuqhawe.
halo5-one-for-all-6f2b07344d.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Okukodwa Kwabo Bonke" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, mema omunye umdlali emkhankasweni futhi uqale inhloso ethi Heroic. Hlala ku-fireteam efanayo ngokusebenzisa indawo yokuhlola yokugcina nemiphumela. I-Osiris iyisinqumo esihle sokuqala.

halo5-all-for-one-a2633afb52.name: Konke Kokukodwa
halo5-all-for-one-a2633afb52.description: Qedela yonke i-Co-op Mission kubunzima bobuqhawe.
halo5-all-for-one-a2633afb52.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Konke Kokukodwa" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, qedela wonke amamishini angu-15 nozakwethu wokubambisana ku-Heroic. Hlola i-Mission Select ukuze uthole irekhodi lobunzima be-co-op futhi udlale kabusha noma iyiphi i-mission ngaphandle kwe-Heroic co-op ecacile.

halo5-civil-war-dc3d88b430.name: Impi Yombango
halo5-civil-war-dc3d88b430.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Impi Yombango" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, layisha i-Mission 12, "Battle of Sunaion", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Dlulela ngaphesheya kweSunaion ngamabutho e-Arbiter. Buka izikhala ezindleleni zokuhamba futhi usule izitha endaweni ekhavayo ngaphambi kokuphushela ezinkundleni eziveziwe.

halo5-my-rules-4110cad7e5.name: Imithetho Yami
halo5-my-rules-4110cad7e5.description: Qedela noma iyiphi i-Mission nge-3+ Skulls esebenzayo kubunzima bobuqhawe.
halo5-my-rules-4110cad7e5.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Imithetho Yami" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, qoqa okungenani ama-Skulls amathathu, bese ukhetha injongo emfushane owazi kahle. Isethe ku-Heroic, nika amandla ama-Skulls amathathu noma ngaphezulu kuzinketho zemishini, futhi uqedele ngawo asebenzayo.

halo5-valor-recognized-b8faabe538.name: Ukuqina Kuyabonakala
halo5-valor-recognized-b8faabe538.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukuqina Kuyabonakala" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, faka umugqa ohlwini lokudlalayo olusezingeni elilodwa futhi uqedele ukufana kokubekwa. Qedela isethi egcwele kulolo hlu lwadlalwayo kuze kube yilapho igeyimu ikunikeza Isilinganiselwa Sekhono Esiqhudelanayo.

halo5-glasslands-32b615bb58.name: Izingilazi
halo5-glasslands-32b615bb58.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Izingilazi" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, layisha i-Mission 3, "Glassed", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Landela umzila oya e-Meridian futhi uvikele ithimba lakho njengoba usula ukuhlangana kwe-Promethean. Sebenzisa imoto lapho inhloso ikunikeza khona ukuze udlule ezindaweni ezivulekile.

halo5-roots-of-the-earth-3672c85d5b.name: Izimpande Zomhlaba
halo5-roots-of-the-earth-3672c85d5b.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Izimpande Zomhlaba" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, layisha i-Mission 4, "Meridian Station", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Landela imiyalo yokusebenzisana e-Meridian Station futhi ukhulume nabalingiswa abamakiwe ukuze uqhubekisele phambili indaba.

halo5-stolen-gauntlet-b41a706287.name: Intshontshiwe Gauntlet
halo5-stolen-gauntlet-b41a706287.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Intshontshiwe Gauntlet" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, layisha i-Mission 5, "Unconfirmed", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Phusha endaweni yezimayini futhi uhlale eduze nekhava ngaphambi kwe-Warden Eternal fight. Zungezisa ukuhlasela kwakhe ukuze uthole isibhamu emhlane wakhe.

halo5-swords-756823ffa2.name: Izinkemba
halo5-swords-756823ffa2.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Izinkemba" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, layisha i-Mission 8, "Swords of Sanghelios", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Phusha ezindaweni zeSivumelwano ubheke emabuthweni e-Arbiter. Sebenzisa ikhava ngaphambi kwezimpi ezinkulu futhi usebenzise isithwalambiza uma udinga usizo lokusisusa.

halo5-old-bones-1d154487c6.name: Amathambo Amadala
halo5-old-bones-1d154487c6.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Amathambo Amadala" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, layisha i-Mission 9, "Alliance", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Landela omaka ekamu bese uqedela izingxoxo ezidingekayo ukuze udlulele kumishini elandelayo.

halo5-breakthrough-44a61912b9.name: Ukuphumelela
halo5-breakthrough-44a61912b9.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukuphumelela" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, layisha i-Mission 10, "Enemy Lines", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Sebenza ngemigqa yeSivumelwano, gibela i-Kraken, futhi ucekele phansi umnyombo wayo. Yehla emkhunjini ngaphambi kokuba uwe.

halo5-stormbound-e444b61628.name: Isiphepho
halo5-stormbound-e444b61628.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Isiphepho" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, layisha i-Mission 11, "Before the Storm", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Khuluma nabalingiswa abamakiwe ekamu futhi ulandele umgomo wokugcina wokuqhubekela e-Sunaion.

halo5-sentinels-17b0b0779d.name: Abalindi
halo5-sentinels-17b0b0779d.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Abalindi" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, layisha i-Mission 15, "Guardians", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Landela indlela eya kuma-cores amandla angaphandle futhi uwabhubhise ngaphambi kokuqhubekela ekupheleni komsebenzi.

halo5-drop-a-quarter-b465274307.name: Yehlisa Ikota
halo5-drop-a-quarter-b465274307.description: Qedela umkhankaso ku-Score Attack ngamaphoyinti okungenani ayi-10,000.
halo5-drop-a-quarter-b465274307.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Yehlisa Ikota" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, qala umsebenzi osuka ku-Score Attack futhi uqedele okungenani ngamaphoyinti angu-10,000. Sebenzisa amaketango ezindondo nobunzima obulawulekayo noma isiphindaphindi se-Skull ukuze ukhuphule isikolo sakho.

halo5-up-for-a-challenge-cf64596fb2.name: Khuphukela Inselelo
halo5-up-for-a-challenge-cf64596fb2.description: Finyelela amaphuzu angu-50,000 ku-Score Attack ngesiphindaphindi se-Skull se-x2 noma ngaphezulu.
halo5-up-for-a-challenge-cf64596fb2.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Khuphukela Inselelo" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, khetha I-Score Attack, vula inhlanganisela Yezigebhezi ezinengqikithi yokuphindaphinda Ugebhezi lwe-x2, bese ufinyelela amaphuzu angu-50,000. Gcina amaketanga okubulala ehamba futhi uqedele umsebenzi wokurekhoda amaphuzu.

halo5-party-hearty-734b324062.name: Iphathi Yenhliziyo
halo5-party-hearty-734b324062.description: Qedela umkhankaso ku-Score Attack co-op, bonke ababambiqhaza bathole okungenani amaphuzu angu-200,000.
halo5-party-hearty-734b324062.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Iphathi Yenhliziyo" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, qala i-Score Attack ngokuhlanganyela. Nikeza umdlali ngamunye izitha ezanele ukuze akhe amaphuzu akhe ngabanye futhi ahlole isamba ngaphambi kokuqeda. Wonke umuntu udinga okungenani amaphuzu angu-200,000 kumishini efanayo.

halo5-the-hare-e04fbdb1f4.name: UMvundla
halo5-the-hare-e04fbdb1f4.description: Hlula isikhathi esilinganiselwe semishini ku-Score Attack.
halo5-the-hare-e04fbdb1f4.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "UMvundla" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, kokuthi Score Attack, khetha injongo oyaziyo futhi uhlole isikhathi sayo ngaphambi kokuqaliswa. Landela umzila oyinhloko, weqa ukulwa okungadingekile, futhi uqedele ngaphambi kwesikhathi okuhlosiwe.

halo5-the-tortoise-4ec6397aa1.name: UFudu
halo5-the-tortoise-4ec6397aa1.description: Qedela umkhankaso ku-Score Attack ngamaphoyinti okungenani angu-500,000.
halo5-the-tortoise-4ec6397aa1.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "UFudu" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, sebenzisa i-Score Attack bese ukhetha inhloso enezitha eziningi. Khulisa isiphindaphindi samaphuzu sibe sezingeni ongaliqeda, ukubulawa kwamaketango nezindondo, bese uqedela ukugijima ngemva kokufinyelela amaphuzu angu-500,000.

halo5-not-your-first-rodeo-221b413698.name: Akuyona I-Rodeo Yakho Yokuqala
halo5-not-your-first-rodeo-221b413698.description: Iqedele ngempumelelo imidlalo emi-5 ye-Warzone Firefight.
halo5-not-your-first-rodeo-221b413698.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Akuyona I-Rodeo Yakho Yokuqala" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, faka ulayini we-Warzone Firefight futhi usebenze nethimba lakho ukuze uqedele yonke imizuliswano ngempumelelo. Yakha amandla e-REQ emizuliswaneni yakamuva bese uphinda uze uqophe ukuqeda okuyisihlanu okuyimpumelelo.

halo5-tour-of-duty-4c082a1fcf.name: Tour of Duty
halo5-tour-of-duty-4c082a1fcf.description: Qedela umdlalo we-Warzone Firefight kumamephu ayi-6 ahlukile.
halo5-tour-of-duty-4c082a1fcf.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Tour of Duty" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, faka i-Warzone Firefight futhi uqedele umeshi kumephu ngayinye kwayisithupha ahlukene. Landela ngomkhondo amagama emephu ekuqaleni komdlalo ngamunye ukuze amamephu aphindaphindiwe angabalwa kabili.

halo5-dangerous-game-806e79d250.name: Umdlalo Oyingozi
halo5-dangerous-game-806e79d250.description: Zuza Ukwehliswa Komphathi Wenganekwane emdlalweni we-Warzone Firefight.
halo5-dangerous-game-806e79d250.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Umdlalo Oyingozi" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, umugqa womdlalo we-Warzone Firefight ongazala umphathi weMythic. Londoloza i-REQ esindayo ngomzuliswano wokugcina, gxila kumphathi weMythic lapho ebizwa, futhi uvikele indondo yokwehliswa.

haloinfinite-clocking-in-23ca79782a.name: Ukungena
