haloinfinite-clocking-in-23ca79782a.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukungena" kokuthi Halo Infinite, vula iphaneli Yezinselele futhi ufunde Inselelo Yansuku zonke yamanje. Dlala umsebenzi ewubalayo kuze kube yilapho umgomo wansuku zonke usuphelile, bese uqeda umdlalo ukuze uqhubeke ubhalise.

haloinfinite-we-have-a-job-for-you-ec8db.name: Sinomsebenzi Wakho
haloinfinite-we-have-a-job-for-you-ec8db.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Sinomsebenzi Wakho" kokuthi Halo Infinite, vula iphaneli Yezinselele, khetha Inselele Yamaviki Onke esebenzayo, bese uhlola imodi yayo edingekayo nenjongo ngaphambi kokubeka ulayini. Qedela okufanayo noma izenzo ezidingekayo ukuze usule.

haloinfinite-humble-beginnings-e4abf2002.name: Iziqalo Ezithobekile
haloinfinite-humble-beginnings-e4abf2002.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Iziqalo Ezithobekile" kokuthi Halo Infinite, khetha i-Battle Pass esebenzayo futhi uzuze i-pass XP eyanele ukuze ufinyelele ileveli yayo elandelayo. Sebenza ezinseleleni ongakwazi ukuqeda izinjongo zakho emdlalweni ofanayo.

haloinfinite-i-m-ready-how-bout-you-4aca.name: Sengilungile, Kunjani Wena?
haloinfinite-i-m-ready-how-bout-you-4aca.description: Shintsha ukubukeka kwakho kwe-Spartan kumenyu ethi Yenza ngokwezifiso.
haloinfinite-i-m-ready-how-bout-you-4aca.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Sengilungile, Kunjani Wena?" kokuthi Halo Infinite, vula okuthi Yenza ngokwezifiso bese ufaka i-Armor Hall. Khetha isisekelo sezikhali, shintsha enye yezingcezu ezihlomile, futhi usisebenzise ku-Spartan yakho.

haloinfinite-peak-performance-5b1c6ea871.name: Ukusebenza Okuphakeme
haloinfinite-peak-performance-5b1c6ea871.description: Zuza amaphuzu angu-2,000 kugeyimu eyenziwe ngokufanisa.
haloinfinite-peak-performance-5b1c6ea871.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukusebenza Okuphakeme" kokuthi Halo Infinite, sebenzisa imodi yenhloso eyenziwe ngokufanisa futhi unikele ekuthwebuleni, ekubuyiseni, noma ekubambeni eduze nokukhipha kwakho. Hlola isikolo sakho somdlalo bese ufinyelela ku-2,000 ngaphambi kwesikrini semiphumela.

haloinfinite-passion-for-fashion-aa8607d.name: Passion for Fashion
haloinfinite-passion-for-fashion-aa8607d.description: Gqoka into entsha yokwenza ngokwezifiso izikhali.
haloinfinite-passion-for-fashion-aa8607d.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Passion for Fashion" kokuthi Halo Infinite, ngokwenza ngendlela oyifisayo, vula ingqikithi yezikhali zakho bese uhlomisa ucezu oluhlukile lwezivikelo olungakhiyiwe noma okokunamathela. Qinisekisa ukuthi ucezu luhlomile ngaphambi kokushiya i-Armor Hall.

haloinfinite-which-one-of-us-is-the-mach.name: Ubani Kithi Ongumshini?
haloinfinite-which-one-of-us-is-the-mach.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ubani Kithi Ongumshini?" kokuthi Halo Infinite, kokuthi Yenza ngokwezifiso, vula izinketho ze-Personal AI. Khetha imodeli ye-AI evuliwe ehlukile futhi uyihlomise ngaphambi kokuhlehla.

haloinfinite-reporting-for-duty-ee9f812f.name: Ukubikela Umsebenzi
haloinfinite-reporting-for-duty-ee9f812f.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukubikela Umsebenzi" kokuthi Halo Infinite, vula okuthi Yenza ngokwezifiso futhi uthole i-Spartan ID. Hlela Ithegi Yesevisi, faka ithegi ehlukile evumelekile, bese uyigcina.

haloinfinite-brutality-8666b8bf4f.name: Isihluku
haloinfinite-brutality-8666b8bf4f.description: Bulala isitha nge-melee usebenzisa isikhali esinamaphiko kumdlalo owenziwe ngomentshisi.
haloinfinite-brutality-8666b8bf4f.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Isihluku" kokuthi Halo Infinite, thatha isikhali esinamapheshana njenge-Mangler, Skewer, noma i-Ravager ekwenzeni ukufanisa. Yenza isitha sibe buthaka, bese usiqeda ngokuhlasela kwe-melee yaleso sikhali.

haloinfinite-need-a-weapon-131b22fa71.name: "Udinga Isikhali?"
haloinfinite-need-a-weapon-131b22fa71.description: Zama into entsha yokwenza ngokwezifiso isikhali.
haloinfinite-need-a-weapon-131b22fa71.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi ""Udinga Isikhali?"" kokuthi Halo Infinite, vula Ibhentshi Lezikhali Kokwenza Ngokwezifiso. Khetha isikhali esinengubo evuliwe, intelezi, noma imodeli, bese uhlomisa into bese uqinisekisa ukuthi iyasebenza.

haloinfinite-limited-addition-d0ba6049c3.name: Ukwengeza Okunomkhawulo
haloinfinite-limited-addition-d0ba6049c3.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukwengeza Okunomkhawulo" kokuthi Halo Infinite, qedela ukuphonselwa inselelo kwamasonto onke kuze kuvele inselele yabo yokugcina engavuleki. Funda leyo nselele kuphaneli Yezinselele futhi uqedele inhloso yayo ngesikhathi lisasebenza.

haloinfinite-slaying-with-style-0a521997.name: Ukubulala ngeSitayela
haloinfinite-slaying-with-style-0a521997.description: Zuza Indondo Yenganekwane kugeyimu eyenziwe ngomentshisi.
haloinfinite-slaying-with-style-0a521997.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukubulala ngeSitayela" kokuthi Halo Infinite, thola indondo yeMythic ekwenzeni ukufanisa. Khetha umgomo othile ofana nokudubula okuningi noma ukubulala isikhathi eside futhi usebenzise imodi enabaphikisi abenele noma ama-respawns ukuze uzame.

haloinfinite-you-re-up-rook-e778243c1e.name: Uvukile, Rook'
haloinfinite-you-re-up-rook-e778243c1e.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Uvukile, Rook'" kokuthi Halo Infinite, khetha Uhlu lwadlalwayo Olukumazinga oluvela Kubadlali abaningi bese uqedela okufanayo. Hlala emdlalweni kuze kube isikrini semiphumela.

haloinfinite-peeker-s-disadvantage-94419.name: Ukungalungi kwePeeker
haloinfinite-peeker-s-disadvantage-94419.description: "Back Smack" isitha esondezwe ngesikhali esinobubanzi kugeyimu eyenziwe ngokufanisa.
haloinfinite-peeker-s-disadvantage-94419.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukungalungi kwePeeker" kokuthi Halo Infinite, zulazula isitha usebenzisa isikhali esinesikophu ekwenzeni okufanayo. Linda baze baqonde ku-scope, bese ubashaya ngemuva nge-melee.

haloinfinite-running-laps-16e876f332.name: Ama-Running Laps
haloinfinite-running-laps-16e876f332.description: Thwebula ifulegi kabili kugeyimu yokufanisa i-Capture the Flag.
haloinfinite-running-laps-16e876f332.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ama-Running Laps" kokuthi Halo Infinite, ku-Capture the Flag eyenziwe njengomdlalo, thatha ifulegi lesitha uliyise endaweni yakho yokushaya kabili emdlalweni ofanayo. Cela ozakwenu ukuthi bakuphelezele futhi bakubuyisele ifulegi lakho uma seliphumile.

haloinfinite-customary-3db478745f.name: Ngokwesiko
haloinfinite-customary-3db478745f.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ngokwesiko" kokuthi Halo Infinite, vula igeyimu yangokwezifiso, qala umeshi, futhi uwudlale wonke. Sebenzisa umkhawulo wamaphuzu aphansi kumdlalo omfushane uma uzibekela wena igeyimu.

haloinfinite-just-the-two-of-us-e52a948a.name: Sibabili nje
haloinfinite-just-the-two-of-us-e52a948a.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Sibabili nje" kokuthi Halo Infinite, qala Okokufundisa kusuka ku-Academy bese ulandela umgomo uye ku-AI yomuntu siqu. Sebenzisa i-Interact ukuze uyifinyelele.

haloinfinite-kebab-ecb248d50e.name: I-Kebab
haloinfinite-kebab-ecb248d50e.description: Bhubhisa imoto yesitha nge-Skewer kugeyimu eyenziwe ngomentshisi.
haloinfinite-kebab-ecb248d50e.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Kebab" kokuthi Halo Infinite, ekwenzeni umentshisi, thatha iSkewer bese usisebenzisela ukuthola isibhamu sokuqeda emotweni esetshenziswa isitha. Khomba i-Ghost noma enye imoto elula ukuze uthole impi emfushane.

haloinfinite-that-thing-on-the-left-is-t.name: Leya nto eNxele iBrake
haloinfinite-that-thing-on-the-left-is-t.description: Hlola ukushayela ukwenza ngokwezifiso imoto entsha.
haloinfinite-that-thing-on-the-left-is-t.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Leya nto eNxele iBrake" kokuthi Halo Infinite, vula i-Vehicle Bay ngokwenza ngendlela oyifisayo. Khetha imoto futhi uhlomise into entsha evuliwe yokwenza ngendlela oyifisayo, bese uyaphuma ukuze uyisebenzise.

haloinfinite-they-see-me-rollin-820ae1f3.name: Bayangibona Rollin '
haloinfinite-they-see-me-rollin-820ae1f3.description: Caphela umlingani oshayela i-Warthog noma i-Razorback kugeyimu eyenziwe ngomentshisi.
haloinfinite-they-see-me-rollin-820ae1f3.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Bayangibona Rollin '" kokuthi Halo Infinite, kugeyimu eyenziwe ngokufanisa, sebenzisa ukubuka ngenkathi ulinde ukuzala kabusha ukuze ubuke uzakwenu oshayela i-Warthog noma i-Razorback. Biyela phakathi kozakwenu uze ufike kumshayeli.

haloinfinite-sharpshooter-9daa61199d.name: I-Sharpshooter
haloinfinite-sharpshooter-9daa61199d.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Sharpshooter" kokuthi Halo Infinite, vula i-Academy, khetha I-Weapon Drills, futhi uqedele ukubhoboza ngesikhali esijwayelekile. Sebenzisa amathagethi okuvula ukuze uthole isigqi ngaphambi kokuhamba phakathi kwemizila.

haloinfinite-doing-your-part-de32d431df.name: Ukwenza Ingxenye Yakho
haloinfinite-doing-your-part-de32d431df.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukwenza Ingxenye Yakho" kokuthi Halo Infinite, vula i-Academy bese uqala Okokufundisa. Landela imiyalelo yokudubula nokunyakaza bese uqedela umsebenzi wokugcina.

haloinfinite-all-about-the-grind-e21ed5d.name: Konke Mayelana Nokugaya
haloinfinite-all-about-the-grind-e21ed5d.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Konke Mayelana Nokugaya" kokuthi Halo Infinite, khetha Uhlu lwadlalwayo Olusezingeni bese uqedela uchungechunge lwalo olugcwele lokubekwa kulolo hlu lwadlalwayo. Qeda umeshi ngamunye kuze kube yilapho igeyimu ikunika izinga.

haloinfinite-bomb-returned-7bee9ad87f.name: Ibhomu Libuyile
haloinfinite-bomb-returned-7bee9ad87f.description: Xoxisa ibhomu lesitha nge-Repulsor kugeyimu eyenziwe ngomentshisi.
haloinfinite-bomb-returned-7bee9ad87f.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ibhomu Libuyile" kokuthi Halo Infinite, thatha i-Repulsor ekwenzeni okufanayo. Uma isitha sijikijela ibhomu libheke kuwe, bhekana nalo bese usebenzisa i-Repulsor ngaphambi kokuthi liqhume.

haloinfinite-control-freak-ec56b46453.name: Lawula i-Freak
haloinfinite-control-freak-ec56b46453.description: Siza ekuthwebuleni wonke amazoni aholela kumphumela kugeyimu yokulawula Okuphelele eyenziwe ngokufanisa.
haloinfinite-control-freak-ec56b46453.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Lawula i-Freak" kokuthi Halo Infinite, faka umugqa wokulawula okuphelele okwenziwe ngokulinganisa. Yiba kundawo ngayinye kwezintathu zokuthwebula lapho iqembu lakho likuthatha ngokulandelana okufanayo kwamaphuzu. Zungezisa nozakwenu ukuze bakwazi ukubamba izindawo zangaphambili.

haloinfinite-zone-ranger-d4f2ac462b.name: I-Zone Ranger
haloinfinite-zone-ranger-d4f2ac462b.description: Vikela izindawo ezi-5 kugeyimu ye-Strongholds eyenziwe ngokulingana.
haloinfinite-zone-ranger-d4f2ac462b.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Zone Ranger" kokuthi Halo Infinite, Ezizindeni Eziqinile ezenziwe ngokulingana, yima ezindaweni eziqhudelanayo noma eziyisitha kuze kube yilapho iqembu lakho lizithumba. Siza ukuqeda ukuthwebula okuhlanu emdlalweni ofanayo.

haloinfinite-back-to-the-chopper-11dbdea.name: Abuyele kuChopper
haloinfinite-back-to-the-chopper-11dbdea.description: Zuza u-"Splatter" nge-Brute Chopper kugeyimu eyenziwe ngokufanisa.
haloinfinite-back-to-the-chopper-11dbdea.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Abuyele kuChopper" kokuthi Halo Infinite, shayela i-Brute Chopper ekwenzeni ukufanisa. Layisha isitha ngezinyawo, sebenzisa i-boost ukuvala ibanga, futhi usishaye ngaphambili kwemoto ukuze uzuze i-Splatter.

haloinfinite-first-contact-85bab3744a.name: Oxhumana Naye Wokuqala
haloinfinite-first-contact-85bab3744a.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Oxhumana Naye Wokuqala" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "Warship Gbraakon". Yenza indlela yakho ngomkhumbi oxoshiwe, finyelela ebhulohweni, futhi ubalekele ngemva kokucekela phansi umkhumbi.

haloinfinite-getting-strong-now-32b6a4ed.name: Ukuba namandla Manje
haloinfinite-getting-strong-now-32b6a4ed.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukuba namandla Manje" kokuthi Halo Infinite, vula i-Academy, khetha Imodi Yokuqeqesha, bese uqalisa iseshini. Linda imephu ukuthi iqede ukulayisha.

haloinfinite-together-again-3627e2a496.name: Ndawonye. Futhi?
haloinfinite-together-again-3627e2a496.description: Hlola i-underbelly ye-Zeta Halo futhi ubuyise isikhali ukuze uguqule isimo salokhu kungqubuzana.
haloinfinite-together-again-3627e2a496.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ndawonye. Futhi?" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "Foundation". Landela inhloso ngokusebenzisa isakhiwo Se-Forerunner ukuze ubuyise Isikhali. Qhubeka nomsebenzi kuze kube yilapho ibhala ngokucacile.

haloinfinite-infinity-down-3b361a32f4.name: I-Infinity Phansi
haloinfinite-infinity-down-3b361a32f4.description: Finyelela ilogu yakho yokuqala yomsindo we-Spartan.
haloinfinite-infinity-down-3b361a32f4.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Infinity Phansi" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "Warship Gbraakon". Thola i-Spartan Audio Log yangaphambi kwesikhathi futhi usebenzise i-Interact uma ucelwa. Lalela umsindo wayo njengoba usondela endaweni yokulanda.

haloinfinite-two-sides-to-every-story-59.name: Izinhlangothi Ezimbili Kuyo Yonke Indaba
haloinfinite-two-sides-to-every-story-59.description: Finyelela ilogu yakho yokuqala yomsindo exoshiwe.
haloinfinite-two-sides-to-every-story-59.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Izinhlangothi Ezimbili Kuyo Yonke Indaba" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "Warship Gbraakon". Sebenzisa i-Interact kulogi yokuqala yomsindo Ekhishiwe ohlangana nayo. Ividiyo exhunyiwe ibonisa ilogi emkhunjini wempi.

haloinfinite-ascension-34e7687d6a.name: Ukwenyuka
haloinfinite-ascension-34e7687d6a.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukwenyuka" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "Foundation". Empini ye-Tremonius, hlubula izihlangu zakhe nge-plasma futhi ubhekane nomonakalo lapho edalulwa. Sebenzisa i-Grappleshot ukuze uvule isikhala uma evala.

haloinfinite-those-wonderful-toys-409c2c.name: Lawo Amathoyizi Amangalisayo
haloinfinite-those-wonderful-toys-409c2c.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Lawo Amathoyizi Amangalisayo" kokuthi Halo Infinite, hlomisa i-Grappleshot futhi uzidonsele ezindongeni noma amaleji emkhankasweni. Thola indawo ebangeni, linda ukupholisa phansi phakathi kokwenza kusebenze, futhi uqhubeke nokuyisebenzisa kuze kube yilapho ususebenzise ngempumelelo okungu-50.

haloinfinite-hidden-experience-8559d0072.name: Umuzwa Ofihliwe
haloinfinite-hidden-experience-8559d0072.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Umuzwa Ofihliwe" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "Outpost Tremonius". Vula enye yeziqukathi ezimhlophe ze-UNSC Spartan Core. Eyakho eyokuqala ikumzila we-Outpost Tremonius. Sebenzisa ividiyo ukuhlonza indawo ekuyo.

haloinfinite-zeta-b408eaddda.name: Zetha
haloinfinite-zeta-b408eaddda.description: Lwela indlela yakho nge-Outpost Tremonius bese uphumela ngaphandle kwe-Zeta Halo.
haloinfinite-zeta-b408eaddda.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Zetha" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "Outpost Tremonius". Yilwa endaweni engaphandle futhi ufinyelele phezulu. Sula Abaxoshiwe endaweni okufikela kuyo ngaphambi kokudlulela kunhloso elandelayo.

haloinfinite-dispatches-from-the-front-5.name: Ama-Dispatches Avela Phambili
haloinfinite-dispatches-from-the-front-5.description: Finyelela ilogu yakho yokuqala yomsindo ye-UNSC.
haloinfinite-dispatches-from-the-front-5.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ama-Dispatches Avela Phambili" kokuthi Halo Infinite, thatha Ilogi Yomsindo ye-UNSC futhi usebenzise i-Interact kuyo. Umhlahlandlela wendawo oxhunyiwe ubonisa ukuthi ungayithola kuphi eyokuqala.

haloinfinite-multi-class-racer-961090b5d.name: I-Multi-class Racer
haloinfinite-multi-class-racer-961090b5d.description: Shayela izimoto ezi-4 ezihlukile kumdlalo wenziwe.
haloinfinite-multi-class-racer-961090b5d.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Multi-class Racer" kokuthi Halo Infinite, kumdlalo owodwa owenziwe umentshisi, thatha isihlalo somshayeli ezimotweni ezine ezihlukene. Sebenzisa imephu enezinhlamvu zezimoto ezimbalwa futhi ushintshe ngokushesha nje lapho usushayele ngayinye.

haloinfinite-a-fellow-of-infinite-jest-b.name: Umfoka Infinite Jest
haloinfinite-a-fellow-of-infinite-jest-b.description: Bulala izitha ezintathu ngebhola kumdlalo we-Oddball owenziwe umentshisi.
haloinfinite-a-fellow-of-infinite-jest-b.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Umfoka Infinite Jest" kokuthi Halo Infinite, ku-Oddball eyenziwe ngokufanisa, thatha ibhola futhi uqedele izitha ezintathu ngokuhlasela kwebhola kumdlalo ofanayo. Linda eduze kwekhava ukuze uvumele izitha ezibuthakathaka zisondele kuwe.

haloinfinite-working-remote-ae89b76cc2.name: Isilawuli kude esisebenzayo
haloinfinite-working-remote-ae89b76cc2.description: Thatha isikhali usebenzisa i-Grappleshot kugeyimu eyenziwe ngokufanisa.
haloinfinite-working-remote-ae89b76cc2.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Isilawuli kude esisebenzayo" kokuthi Halo Infinite, thatha i-Grappleshot ekwenzeni okufanayo futhi uqondise ngqo esikhalini esixekethile noma i-rack pickup. Shisa ukubambana futhi uyivumele idonsele isikhali ezandleni zakho.

haloinfinite-reclaimer-49b36b3ced.name: Umbuyiseli
haloinfinite-reclaimer-49b36b3ced.description: Thwebula isisekelo sakho sokuqala sokusebenza phambili.
haloinfinite-reclaimer-49b36b3ced.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Umbuyiseli" kokuthi Halo Infinite, hamba ku-Forward Operating Base enabantu abaningi, sula abavikeli Abaxoshiwe, bese usebenzisa itheminali ye-FOB ukuze uyithwebule.

haloinfinite-visionary-9b84d4ff11.name: Umbono
haloinfinite-visionary-9b84d4ff11.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Umbono" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "The Tower". Qhubeka ngokusebenzisa i-Tower futhi uthathe Inzwa Yosongo lapho indaba yethula. Yisebenzise ukuveza i-Spartan Killer egqoke izingubo ngesikhathi sokuhlangana.

haloinfinite-outpost-discovery-a2ba530dc.name: Ukutholwa kwe-Outpost
haloinfinite-outpost-discovery-a2ba530dc.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukutholwa kwe-Outpost" kokuthi Halo Infinite, thola ibutho Elikhishiwe ku-TACMAP futhi usule izinhloso zalo ezimakiwe. I-Ransom Keep inketho yangaphambi kwesikhathi. Bhubhisa izisele zikaphethiloli futhi uqedele noma yikuphi okuhlosiwe okusele ngaphambi kokuhamba.

haloinfinite-we-re-on-our-way-319fa3f2b2.name: Sisendleleni
haloinfinite-we-re-on-our-way-319fa3f2b2.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Sisendleleni" kokuthi Halo Infinite, khetha ucingo lokucindezeleka lwe-UNSC ku-TACMAP bese uya eqenjini. Sula izitha ezizungezile, uvikele Amasosha Asolwandle, futhi ulinde ukuqinisekiswa kokuhlenga. Izithombe ezixhunyanisiwe ze-co-op zinokuphawula kweSpanishi.

haloinfinite-fallen-3fca855bba.name: Iwile
haloinfinite-fallen-3fca855bba.description: Landela isignali ye-UNSC eya endaweni eqinile Exoshiwe ebizwa ngokuthi i-Tower. Thola umthombo. Phuma uphila.
haloinfinite-fallen-3fca855bba.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Iwile" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "The Tower". Landela isignali yokucindezeleka ungene ku-Tower. Finyelela endaweni yejele, sebenzisa Inzwa Yosongo ukuze ulandelele u-Chak 'Lok, futhi umhlule ukuze uqedele.

haloinfinite-money-in-the-bank-d5d466ad3.name: Imali Ebhange
haloinfinite-money-in-the-bank-d5d466ad3.description: Finyelela i-Mjolnir Armor Locker yakho yokuqala.
haloinfinite-money-in-the-bank-d5d466ad3.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Imali Ebhange" kokuthi Halo Infinite, vula i-Mjolnir Armor Locker eyodwa. Thwebula i-FOB eseduze ukuze uveze amalokha ku-TACMAP, bese ulandela umaka futhi uxhumane nesiqukathi esiluhlaza.

haloinfinite-headhunter-cc0479736f.name: I-Headhunter
haloinfinite-headhunter-cc0479736f.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Headhunter" kokuthi Halo Infinite, landelela isithonjana esibomvu se-High-Value Target ku-TACMAP. Susa isikhulu esimakiwe futhi usule noma yiziphi izitha ezidingwa ukuhlangana. Izithombe ezixhunyanisiwe ze-co-op zinokuphawula kweSpanishi.

haloinfinite-please-shut-up-53ed093cc8.name: Ngicela Uthule
haloinfinite-please-shut-up-53ed093cc8.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ngicela Uthule" kokuthi Halo Infinite, thola enye ye-Banished Propaganda Towers, ekhonjwe ngokusakazwa kwayo. Shoot isisekelo sawo kuze kube yilapho umbhoshongo uphuka futhi ukusakaza kuma.

haloinfinite-unearthed-b25c9066ab.name: Kutholwe
haloinfinite-unearthed-b25c9066ab.description: Vala i-laser yezimayini Ekhishiwe futhi uthole ukufinyelela ku-Conservatory.
haloinfinite-unearthed-b25c9066ab.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Kutholwe" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "Excavation Site". Khubaza okokusebenza okupholisa okuvikela i-laser yezimayini, bese uvala i-laser ukuze uvule indlela eya ku-Conservatory.

haloinfinite-grab-some-cover-876e6c3a8c.name: Bamba Enye Ikhava
haloinfinite-grab-some-cover-876e6c3a8c.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Bamba Enye Ikhava" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "Conservatory". Landela umzila wemishini uze uthole i-Drop Wall. Ihlomise ngesikhethi sezisetshenziswa uma ufuna ukuyizama phakathi nempi elandelayo.

haloinfinite-evasive-maneuvers-a2255ac96.name: Ama-Evasive Maneuvers
haloinfinite-evasive-maneuvers-a2255ac96.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ama-Evasive Maneuvers" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "Conservatory". Qhubeka ngokusebenzisa i-Conservatory uze uthathe i-Thruster. Yihlomise futhi uyisebenzisele ukubalekela ukuhlasela kwesitha.

haloinfinite-takes-one-to-make-one-64c7f.name: Kuthatha Okukodwa Ukwenza Okukodwa
haloinfinite-takes-one-to-make-one-64c7f.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Kuthatha Okukodwa Ukwenza Okukodwa" kokuthi Halo Infinite, thatha i-Ghost emkhankasweni bese uklelisa isitha endaweni evulekile. Sheshisa kubo ngokuthuthukisa ukubulala.

haloinfinite-natural-formation-location-.name: Ukuzwa Kwendawo Yokwakheka Kwemvelo
haloinfinite-natural-formation-location-.description: Thola ukufinyelela emhumeni wempango kugeyimu eyenziwe ngokufanisa.
haloinfinite-natural-formation-location-.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukuzwa Kwendawo Yokwakheka Kwemvelo" kokuthi Halo Infinite, ku-Big Team Battle on Fragmentation, thola umnyango womhume oyimpango. Hlanganyela ukuze uqale ukugebenga kwe-Personal AI futhi uvikele indawo yokungena kuze kuvuleke umnyango.

haloinfinite-whip-riding-the-ghost-20d15.name: I-Whip-Riding the Ghost
haloinfinite-whip-riding-the-ghost-20d15.description: Sebenzisa i-Grappleshot ukuze ugibele i-Ghost yesitha.
haloinfinite-whip-riding-the-ghost-20d15.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Whip-Riding the Ghost" kokuthi Halo Infinite, thola i-Ghost enomshayeli wendiza Oxoshiwe, eduze nebanga le-Grappleshot, bese udubula imoto. Ivumele ikudonse ukuze uhlale esihlalweni.

haloinfinite-hunter-killer-bec55ed701.name: Umzingeli. Umbulali.
haloinfinite-hunter-killer-bec55ed701.description: Hlula umbhangqwana we-Hunter omiswe phansi kwe-Spire.
haloinfinite-hunter-killer-bec55ed701.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Umzingeli. Umbulali." kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "Spire". Finyelela phansi kwe-Spire futhi unqobe bobabili aba-Hunters. Sebenzisa ikhava ukuze uhlukanise eyodwa ngesikhathi, bese uyizungeza futhi uhlose ukuphumela obala kwayo.

haloinfinite-pelican-down-90a211d4a7.name: Pelican Phansi
haloinfinite-pelican-down-90a211d4a7.description: Vala i-Spire yokuqala futhi umise ukuguqulwa kwe-Zeta ngaphambi kokuba kuphuze kakhulu.
haloinfinite-pelican-down-90a211d4a7.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Pelican Phansi" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "Spire". Faka i-Spire yokuqala, finyelela endaweni yayo yokulawula bese uyivala. Sebenzisa i-Grappleshot kanye nekhava ngenkathi usebenza ngokuhlangana ngaphakathi.

haloinfinite-one-down-083bdebc80.name: Okukodwa Phansi...
haloinfinite-one-down-083bdebc80.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Okukodwa Phansi..." kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "Pelican Down". Hamba kwesinye sezibhamu ezintathu ezilwa nendiza bese ulandela izimpawu zaso zenhloso ukuze usiveze futhi usibhubhise. Ukusula isibhamu esisodwa kwanele kule mpumelelo.

haloinfinite-brothers-grim-9bdf030bfc.name: Abazalwane Grim
haloinfinite-brothers-grim-9bdf030bfc.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Abazalwane Grim" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "Pelican Down". Ngemva kokubhekana nezibhamu ezilwa nezindiza, ukulwa noHyperius noTovarus. Sebenzisa ikhava ukuhlukanisa ukuhlasela kwabo futhi wehlise okukodwa ngaphambi kokugxila kokunye.

haloinfinite-sick-burn-e19c9b719b.name: Ukushiswa Okugulayo
haloinfinite-sick-burn-e19c9b719b.description: Bulala isitha ngesibhamu esikhokhisiwe se-Ravager kugeyimu eyenziwe ngomentshisi.
haloinfinite-sick-burn-e19c9b719b.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukushiswa Okugulayo" kokuthi Halo Infinite, ekwenzeni okufanayo, bamba i-trigger ye-Ravager ukuze ushaje ishothi, bese uyidedela emhlabathini eduze kwesitha esibuthakathaka. Vumela isibhamu esikhokhisiwe sibaqedele.

haloinfinite-gun-runner-1abfca7c46.name: Gun Runner
haloinfinite-gun-runner-1abfca7c46.description: Yehlisa zonke izibhamu ezintathu eziBanished AA.
haloinfinite-gun-runner-1abfca7c46.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Gun Runner" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "Pelican Down". Vakashela zonke izibhamu ezintathu ezilwa nezindiza futhi ucekele phansi ngasinye. Sebenzisa imoto noma i-Grappleshot ukuhamba phakathi kwazo. Uma futhi usebenza ngenguqulo yesikhathi yale nselele, hlela umzila wakho ngaphambi kokuthatha isibhamu sokuqala.

haloinfinite-deadeye-3e55b250ff.name: Deadeye
haloinfinite-deadeye-3e55b250ff.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Deadeye" kokuthi Halo Infinite, ku-Academy, khetha i-Weapon Drill futhi uhlose ukuthola izinkanyezi ezintathu. Khetha i-low-tier drill yesikhali osiphatha kahle, gcina i-reticle eduze kwethagethi elandelayo, bese ulayisha kabusha phakathi kwamaqembu.

haloinfinite-wait-i-can-throw-those-c708.name: Ima, Ngingakwazi Ukulahla Lezo?
haloinfinite-wait-i-can-throw-those-c708.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ima, Ngingakwazi Ukulahla Lezo?" kokuthi Halo Infinite, thatha futhi ujikijele amakhoyili ahlanganisiwe usebenzisa i-Interact uma useduze kweyodwa. Zisebenzise phakathi nezimpi zomkhankaso ukuze uthole umonakalo kalula futhi uqhubeke uze uphonse ama-50.

haloinfinite-light-the-way-da7c69f5f0.name: Khanyisa Indlela
haloinfinite-light-the-way-da7c69f5f0.description: Finyelela kuma-Beacons, hlanganisa Ukulandelana, futhi uthole ukufinyelela ku-Command Spire.
haloinfinite-light-the-way-da7c69f5f0.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Khanyisa Indlela" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "The Sequence". Vakashela i-Beacon ngayinye futhi uxhumane netheminali yayo ukuze uhlanganise Ukulandelana. Landela umaka olandelayo ukuze uvule i-Command Spire.

haloinfinite-what-will-it-take-7f763b2d8.name: Kuzothathani?
haloinfinite-what-will-it-take-7f763b2d8.description: Faka i-Nexus futhi ufunde izimfihlo ze-Spires. Ukuthembana kuyinto entekenteke, akunjalo?
haloinfinite-what-will-it-take-7f763b2d8.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Kuzothathani?" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "Nexus". Faka i-Nexus futhi ulwe emagumbini ayo, ume kukhonsoli ngayinye eboniswa umaka wenhloso. Qedela izinjongo ze-Nexus ukuze uvule umgomo olandelayo.

haloinfinite-wars-with-friends-19971eabb.name: Izimpi nabangani
haloinfinite-wars-with-friends-19971eabb.description: Letha namasosha Asolwandle e-UNSC asindisiwe ukuze agibele emishinini eyinhloko.
haloinfinite-wars-with-friends-19971eabb.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Izimpi nabangani" kokuthi Halo Infinite, hlenga Amasosha Asolwandle noma thola iqembu ku-FOB ethwebuliwe. Donsela imoto enezihlalo zamahhala bese ulinda ukuthi bagibele. Bashayele endaweni yemishini enkulu.

haloinfinite-hear-these-words-205ff7a2f8.name: Yizwa Lawa Mazwi!
haloinfinite-hear-these-words-205ff7a2f8.description: Ngena ku-Command Spire futhi uqede iNguquko.
haloinfinite-hear-these-words-205ff7a2f8.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Yizwa Lawa Mazwi!" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "The Command Spire". Sula i-Command Spire, landela indlela eya kuzilawuli zayo, futhi umise iNguquko. Gcina isikhali esiseduze siseduze sabakwa-Sentinels abavalayo.

haloinfinite-together-again-b49c0a482c.name: Ndawonye. Futhi.
haloinfinite-together-again-b49c0a482c.description: Umngane usengozini futhi isikhathi siyahamba. Yisikhathi sokubhekana nokwakho okwedlule futhi ulondoloze ikusasa lakho.
haloinfinite-together-again-b49c0a482c.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ndawonye. Futhi." kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "Repository". Landela umzila onqamula eNqolobaneni bese ufinyelela kuSikhali. Qhubekela endaweni yokugcina lapho umkhankaso uthuthukela khona.

haloinfinite-new-kid-on-the-block-0a7955.name: Ingane Entsha Ebhulokhini
haloinfinite-new-kid-on-the-block-0a7955.description: Zuza u-"Perfect" nge-VK78 Commando kugeyimu eyenziwe ngokufanisa.
haloinfinite-new-kid-on-the-block-0a7955.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ingane Entsha Ebhulokhini" kokuthi Halo Infinite, thatha i-VK78 Commando ekwenzeni ukufanisa. Amashothi alawulwa ngumlilo ukuze yonke ichashazi lixhume futhi liqede nge-headshot ukuze uthole i-Perfect.

haloinfinite-eld-aficionado-e1e5489325.name: Umdala Aficionado
haloinfinite-eld-aficionado-e1e5489325.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Umdala Aficionado" kokuthi Halo Infinite, thola I-Artifacts Engaphambili emise okwendandatho ngaphandle ku-Zeta Halo. Yiya endaweni yokusebenzelana esakhiweni bese uyiskena.

haloinfinite-reckoning-5601989fdf.name: Ukubala
haloinfinite-reckoning-5601989fdf.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukubala" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "House of Reckoning". Ngena eNdlu Yokulandisa futhi usule izimpi zasenkundleni. Phinda unikeze phakathi kwamagagasi futhi ulandele izinhloso ungene ekamelweni elilandelayo.

haloinfinite-legends-aa37de033c.name: Izinganekwane
haloinfinite-legends-aa37de033c.description: Ekugcineni wayeyisosha nje. Ngethemba ukuthi wenze okufanele.
haloinfinite-legends-aa37de033c.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Izinganekwane" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "House of Reckoning". Qedela ukulwa no-Escharum. Sebenzisa izinsika kanye ne-Grappleshot ukuze ungangeni ebangeni le-melee. Uma isihlangu sakhe sikhuphuka, khomba okokusebenza okumakiwe ukuze umenze abe sengozini futhi.

haloinfinite-set-a-fire-in-your-heart-1d.name: Faka Umlilo Enhliziyweni Yakho
haloinfinite-set-a-fire-in-your-heart-1d.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Faka Umlilo Enhliziyweni Yakho" kokuthi Halo Infinite, qala umkhankaso futhi uqedele yonke imisebenzi eyi-14 eyinhloko kuze kufike eHholo Elithulile. Landela omaka bendaba noma nini uma i-TACMAP ivuleka futhi udlulele kumphathi wokugcina ukuze urekhode umkhankaso ngokucacile.

haloinfinite-too-many-goodbyes-4c0071b06.name: Sanibonani Kakhulu
haloinfinite-too-many-goodbyes-4c0071b06.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Sanibonani Kakhulu" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "Silent Auditorium". Yilwa ne-Harbinger futhi usule amagagasi okuqinisa aBanished phakathi kwezigaba zomonakalo. Londoloza amabhomu noma isikhali samandla sezitha eziphuthuma ikhava yakho.

haloinfinite-reaching-out-4f49efac0b.name: Ukufinyelela
haloinfinite-reaching-out-4f49efac0b.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukufinyelela" kokuthi Halo Infinite, qoqa ama-Spartan Cores ezitsheni ezimhlophe emkhankasweni. Vula ithebhu ethi Thuthukisa futhi uthenge isigaba ngasinye kumugqa we-Grappleshot kuze kube yilapho wonke umugqa usuvuliwe.

haloinfinite-getting-defensive-25cb24de8.name: Ukuthola Ukuzivikela
haloinfinite-getting-defensive-25cb24de8.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukuthola Ukuzivikela" kokuthi Halo Infinite, qoqa ama-Spartan Cores ezitsheni ezimhlophe emkhankasweni. Vula ithebhu ethi Thuthukisa futhi uthenge isigaba ngasinye kumugqa we-Energy Shields kuze kube yilapho wonke umugqa usuvuliwe.

haloinfinite-sparring-partners-3977b2fd9.name: Sparring Partners
haloinfinite-sparring-partners-3977b2fd9.description: Shintsha noma iyiphi inketho yemodi yokuqeqesha.
haloinfinite-sparring-partners-3977b2fd9.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Sparring Partners" kokuthi Halo Infinite, vula Imodi Yokuqeqesha kusukela ku-Academy, misa isikhashana, futhi uvule Izinketho Zokuqeqesha. Shintsha enye yezilungiselelo, njengobunzima be-bot, bese uqalisa kabusha iseshini.

haloinfinite-enemies-everywhere-465dd574.name: Izitha Yonke Indawo!
haloinfinite-enemies-everywhere-465dd574.description: Maka izitha ezi-3+ ngesikhathi esisodwa kumdlalo owenziwe umentshisi.
haloinfinite-enemies-everywhere-465dd574.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Izitha Yonke Indawo!" kokuthi Halo Infinite, linda kuze kube yilapho abaphikisi abathathu sebesondelene ngokubuka kwakho ekwenzeni okufanayo, bese usebenzisa okokufaka kuka-Mark eqenjini. Yilwa kusuka endaweni ephakeme ukuze uthole umbono ocacile wabaphikisi abambalwa ngesikhathi esisodwa.

haloinfinite-bare-your-fangs-a2361cbe1a.name: Phatha Amazinyo Akho
haloinfinite-bare-your-fangs-a2361cbe1a.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Phatha Amazinyo Akho" kokuthi Halo Infinite, setha umkhankaso ube Okuvamile futhi uqedele konke okushiwo yizindaba ezingu-14. Sebenzisa i-Grappleshot ukuze uphume ekulweni obala futhi uqoqe ama-Spartan Cores ukuze uthole isihlangu kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwemishini phakathi kwezinhloso zendaba.

haloinfinite-get-the-popcorn-e3fb9165fc.name: Thola i-Popcorn
haloinfinite-get-the-popcorn-e3fb9165fc.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Thola i-Popcorn" kokuthi Halo Infinite, vula Ithiyetha, khetha okufanayo emlandweni wakho wakamuva, bese uqala ukudlala. Ivumele ilayishe ize ifike lapho ungalawula khona ukurekhoda.

haloinfinite-headstrong-0632bd68a7.name: Ikhanda eliqinile
haloinfinite-headstrong-0632bd68a7.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ikhanda eliqinile" kokuthi Halo Infinite, thola futhi uqoqe noma iyiphi i-Skull efihliwe. Sebenzisa isithwebuli uma uzwa isiqephu somsindo se-Skull, bese ulandela ividiyo uma uyilanda.

haloinfinite-wanna-have-a-catch-d2e10409.name: Ufuna Ukubamba?
haloinfinite-wanna-have-a-catch-d2e10409.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ufuna Ukubamba?" kokuthi Halo Infinite, sebenzisa ama-Plasma noma ama-Spike Grenades futhi uhlasele izitha eziqondile ukuze amabhomu anamathele. Vala ibanga kuqala ukuze ukujikijela kube lula, futhi uqhubeke uze ubambe izitha ezingu-50.

haloinfinite-watt-say-you-bf059d801a.name: Uthi Wena?
haloinfinite-watt-say-you-bf059d801a.description: Zuza u-"Chain Reaction" nge-Shock Rifle kugeyimu eyenziwe ngokufanisa.
haloinfinite-watt-say-you-bf059d801a.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Uthi Wena?" kokuthi Halo Infinite, sebenzisa i-Shock Rifle ekwenzeni okufanayo. Shutha eduze kwezitha ezihlanganiswe ngokuqinile ngokwanele ukuze ugesi u-arc, futhi uthole ukubulala nge-arc ukuze uthole i-Chain Reaction.

haloinfinite-resurgency-44d21e773d.name: Ukuvuka kabusha
haloinfinite-resurgency-44d21e773d.description: Thwebula zonke izisekelo ezitholakalayo zokuSebenza Phambili.
haloinfinite-resurgency-44d21e773d.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukuvuka kabusha" kokuthi Halo Infinite, sula futhi uthwebule Isisekelo SokuSebenza Phambili esimakiwe ku-TACMAP. Sebenzisa itheminali ngayinye ye-FOB ngemva kokuhlula abavikeli bayo futhi uhlole noma yiziphi izimpawu zokuthwebula ezisele.

haloinfinite-bunker-buster-35e675adb1.name: I-Bunker Buster
haloinfinite-bunker-buster-35e675adb1.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Bunker Buster" kokuthi Halo Infinite, qedela zonke izindawo eziyisikhombisa Ezixoshiwe. Yenza kusebenze indawo ngayinye yangaphandle ku-TACMAP, landela omaka benhloso yasendaweni, futhi uhlale kuze kuvele isaziso sokuqeda.

haloinfinite-one-shot-top-mid-54c0319171.name: IShot One, Top Mid
haloinfinite-one-shot-top-mid-54c0319171.description: Maka isitha esitholakala kokuthi "Top Mid" kugeyimu eyenziwe ngomentshisi.
haloinfinite-one-shot-top-mid-54c0319171.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "IShot One, Top Mid" ku-Halo Infinite, e-Arena eyenziwe ngomentshisi, linda isitha sime maphakathi nendawo engenhla yemephu nge-Top Mid callout, efana ne-Aquarius. Khomba isitha futhi usebenzise Maka. Bheka i-callout ukuze uqinisekise indawo.

haloinfinite-bloodstars-bane-aee2119dab.name: I-Bloodstars 'Bane
haloinfinite-bloodstars-bane-aee2119dab.description: Susa konke okuhlosiwe kwenani eliphezulu okungu-15.
haloinfinite-bloodstars-bane-aee2119dab.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Bloodstars 'Bane" kokuthi Halo Infinite, landelela phansi konke Okuqondiwe Kwenani Eliphezulu Okuyi-15 Ku-TACMAP. Sula ukuhlangana ngakunye futhi uhlole ukuthi isithonjana saso esiqondiwe simakwe njengokuphelele ngaphambi kokukhetha okulandelayo. Izithombe ezixhunyanisiwe ze-co-op zinokuphawula kweSpanishi.

haloinfinite-nosebleed-b3a05ec122.name: Ukopha ekhaleni
haloinfinite-nosebleed-b3a05ec122.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukopha ekhaleni" kokuthi Halo Infinite, gibela esiqongweni sentaba esiphezulu esibheke endaweni emaphakathi ye-Zeta Halo. I-Chain Grappleshot idonsa ubuso bedwala futhi ime esiqongweni.

haloinfinite-battle-tested-f5304255e2.name: Impi Ihlolwe
haloinfinite-battle-tested-f5304255e2.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Impi Ihlolwe" kokuthi Halo Infinite, setha i-Battle Pass ofuna ukusebenza ngayo njengesebenzayo. Zuza i-XP kumameshi nezinselele uze uqede isigaba sayo sokugcina.

haloinfinite-skyhook-shot-24c26160a4.name: I-Skyhook Shot
haloinfinite-skyhook-shot-24c26160a4.description: "Grapplejack" isitha endizayo imoto kumdlalo wenziwe umeshisi.
haloinfinite-skyhook-shot-24c26160a4.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Skyhook Shot" kokuthi Halo Infinite, thatha i-Grappleshot ekwenzeni okufanayo futhi ufinyelele isitha esishayela imoto endizayo. Khomba endizeni, dubula impi, futhi uyivumele ikudonsele ekuduneni.

haloinfinite-all-seeing-i-a66f58289f.name: Obona Konke I
haloinfinite-all-seeing-i-a66f58289f.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Obona Konke I" kokuthi Halo Infinite, hlomisa Inzwa Yosongo futhi uyivulele endaweni eseduze emkhankasweni. Thola udonga oluseceleni kokulwa, linda ukupholisa umoya phakathi kokwenza kusebenze, futhi uqhubeke nokulusebenzisa uze ube nokusetshenziswa okuyimpumelelo okungu-50.

haloinfinite-no-one-left-behind-b8ee74af.name: Akekho Osele Ngemva
haloinfinite-no-one-left-behind-b8ee74af.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Akekho Osele Ngemva" kokuthi Halo Infinite, phendula ucingo ngalunye lwe-UNSC ku-TACMAP futhi ubulale Abaxoshiweyo abasongela iqembu. Hlola izimpawu zokucindezeleka ezisele uma usuqedile. Izithombe ezixhunyanisiwe ze-co-op zinokuphawula kweSpanishi.

haloinfinite-do-you-even-gift-b40cf80b1c.name: Ingabe Unayo Isipho?
haloinfinite-do-you-even-gift-b40cf80b1c.description: Dedela Isikhali Samandla sozakwethu kugeyimu eyenziwe ngokufanisa.
haloinfinite-do-you-even-gift-b40cf80b1c.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ingabe Unayo Isipho?" kokuthi Halo Infinite, ekwenzeni okufanayo, thatha Isikhali Samandla njengesiqalisi se-Rocket noma i-Skewer. Sebenzisa okokufaka kwe-Drop Weapon eduze nozakwethu futhi ubavumele bakuthathe. Hlola izibopho zakho kuqala uma okokufaka kungabelwe.

haloinfinite-thrusters-on-full-183d3f2d5.name: Ama-Thrusters Agcwele
haloinfinite-thrusters-on-full-183d3f2d5.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ama-Thrusters Agcwele" kokuthi Halo Infinite, qoqa ama-Spartan Cores ezitsheni ezimhlophe emkhankasweni. Vula ithebhu ethi Thuthukisa futhi uthenge isigaba ngasinye kumugqa we-Thruster kuze kube yilapho wonke umugqa usuvuliwe.

haloinfinite-big-brother-725cb977d7.name: Ubhuti Omkhulu
haloinfinite-big-brother-725cb977d7.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ubhuti Omkhulu" kokuthi Halo Infinite, qoqa ama-Spartan Cores ezitsheni ezimhlophe emkhankasweni. Vula ithebhu ethi Thuthukisa futhi uthenge isigaba ngasinye kumugqa Wenzwa Yosongo kuze kube yilapho usuvulwe wonke umugqa.

haloinfinite-impervious-cf81115d5d.name: I-Impervious
haloinfinite-impervious-cf81115d5d.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Impervious" kokuthi Halo Infinite, qoqa ama-Spartan Cores ezitsheni ezimhlophe emkhankasweni. Vula ithebhu ethi Thuthukisa futhi uthenge isigaba ngasinye kumugqa Wodonga Oludedelayo kuze kube yilapho wonke umugqa usuvuliwe.

haloinfinite-augmented-e504c528ce.name: Kwengeziwe
haloinfinite-augmented-e504c528ce.description: Zuza izinkanyezi ezi-3 kuma-5 Tier 3 Weapon Drill.
haloinfinite-augmented-e504c528ce.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Kwengeziwe" kokuthi Halo Infinite, vula i-Academy Weapon Drills bese ukhetha i-Tier 3. Zuza amaphuzu ezinkanyezi ezintathu ngezikhali ezinhlanu ezahlukene, uqale ngezikhali ububanzi bazo nesikhathi sokulayisha kabusha owazi kangcono.

haloinfinite-straight-to-the-bank-f6da14.name: Aqonde eBhange
haloinfinite-straight-to-the-bank-f6da14.description: Idiphozithi Imbewu Yamandla emi-5 kumdlalo we-Stockpile owenziwe ngomentshisi.
haloinfinite-straight-to-the-bank-f6da14.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Aqonde eBhange" kokuthi Halo Infinite, kusitoko esenziwe njengomdlalo, phatha Imbewu Yamandla uye ezindaweni zokugcina imali zeqembu lakho. Idiphozithi emihlanu kugeyimu efanayo, usebenzisa ozakwenu ukuze uthole ikhava emzileni obuyayo.

haloinfinite-secret-stash-4a75046f07.name: I-Secret Stash
haloinfinite-secret-stash-4a75046f07.description: Beka into endaweni yokugcina ye-Razorback kugeyimu eyenziwe ngokufanisa.
haloinfinite-secret-stash-4a75046f07.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Secret Stash" kokuthi Halo Infinite, kugeyimu eyenziwe ngokufanisa, letha into esekelwe njengeMbewu Yamandla ngemuva kwe-Razorback. Sebenzisa umyalo wesitoreji lapho ukuze uwubeke.

haloinfinite-fight-hard-die-well-6414517.name: Yilwa Kakhulu, Ufe Kahle
haloinfinite-fight-hard-die-well-6414517.description: Qedela yonke imikhankaso eyinhloko yobunzima bobuqhawe.
haloinfinite-fight-hard-die-well-6414517.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Yilwa Kakhulu, Ufe Kahle" kokuthi Halo Infinite, setha umkhankaso ube Obuqhawe futhi uqedele konke okushiwo yizindaba eziyi-14. Sebenzisa i-Grappleshot ukuze uphume ekulweni obala futhi uqoqe ama-Spartan Cores ukuze uthole isihlangu kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwemishini phakathi kwezinhloso zendaba.

haloinfinite-run-rabbit-run-6d44b795b2.name: Gijima uNogwaja, Gijima
haloinfinite-run-rabbit-run-6d44b795b2.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Gijima uNogwaja, Gijima" kokuthi Halo Infinite, hlomisa i-Thruster futhi uyenze isebenze ukuze igijime emkhankasweni. Thola indawo evulekile, linda ukupholisa phansi phakathi kokwenza kusebenze, futhi uqhubeke uyisebenzisa kuze kube yilapho usukwazi ukusebenzisa ngempumelelo okungu-50.

haloinfinite-aegis-fate-bc3723b083.name: I-Aegis Fate
haloinfinite-aegis-fate-bc3723b083.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Aegis Fate" kokuthi Halo Infinite, hlomisa i-Drop Wall futhi uyisebenzise emkhankasweni. Thola indawo eyisicaba, linda ukupholisa phansi phakathi kokwenza kusebenze, futhi uqhubeke nokuyisebenzisa kuze kube yilapho ususebenzise ngempumelelo izikhathi ezingu-50.

haloinfinite-medic-bb8ed16537.name: MEDIC!
haloinfinite-medic-bb8ed16537.description: Vuselela ababambisene nabo abangu-3 emzuliswaneni we-Attrition/Ekuqedweni kumdlalo owenziwe ngokwezifiso.
haloinfinite-medic-bb8ed16537.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "MEDIC!" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala umjikelezo we-Attrition noma wokuqeda ekwenzeni ukufanisa noma Umdlalo Wangokwezifiso. Uma ozakwethu ephansi futhi evuseleleka, bamba i-Interact endaweni yakhe yokuvuselela. Qedela ukuvuselela okuthathu emzuliswaneni ofanayo.

haloinfinite-armory-amore-e7eadc6980.name: I-Armory Amore
haloinfinite-armory-amore-e7eadc6980.description: Finyelela kuwo wonke ama-34 Mjolnir Armor Lockers.
haloinfinite-armory-amore-e7eadc6980.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Armory Amore" kokuthi Halo Infinite, vula wonke ama-34 Mjolnir Armor Lockers. Thwebula ama-FOB aseduze ukuze uveze izithonjana futhi uphawule isifunda ngasinye ku-TACMAP njengoba uvula amalokha ayo.

haloinfinite-bring-shiela-home-safely-41.name: Letha uShiela Ekhaya ngokuphepha
haloinfinite-bring-shiela-home-safely-41.description: Thola i-Scorpion yonke indlela eya "House" ngaphandle kokuthi iqhume.
haloinfinite-bring-shiela-home-safely-41.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Letha uShiela Ekhaya ngokuphepha" kokuthi Halo Infinite, ku-The Road, shayela i-Scorpion kusukela ekuqaleni komzila oya eNdlini Yokubika. Bhubhisa izinsongo ezinzima ezivela ebangeni elide futhi wenze ikhophi yasenqolobaneni uma izitha zisondela. Finyelela endlini ngethangi lokuqala liphelele.

haloinfinite-mjolnir-master-3b3822f030.name: UMjolnir Master
haloinfinite-mjolnir-master-3b3822f030.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "UMjolnir Master" kokuthi Halo Infinite, vula zonke iziqukathi ze-Spartan Core. Thwebula ama-FOB ukuze umake ukuthatha okuseduze futhi uhlole ohambweni lomkhankaso wanoma yiziphi iziqukathi ozigejile. Sebenzisa i-Mission Replay ukuze uhlanze.

haloinfinite-haruspis-387fc8e1c3.name: I-Haruspis
haloinfinite-haruspis-387fc8e1c3.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Haruspis" kokuthi Halo Infinite, skena izindandatho eziyisikhombisa zaManduleli. Sebenzisa izindawo ezixhunyiwe ukumaka ngayinye ku-TACMAP futhi uxhumane neringi ngaphambi kokudlulela phambili.

haloinfinite-passing-the-gas-a9e99ad531.name: Ukudlulisa iGas
haloinfinite-passing-the-gas-a9e99ad531.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukudlulisa iGas" kokuthi Halo Infinite, thola i-Brute eduze ne-Grunt bese uyilinda ukuze iphakamise i-Grunt. Landelela i-Grunt ngokuphonsa futhi ubulale leyo Grunt ngaphambi kokuthi ibaleke.

haloinfinite-make-a-little-more-noise-81.name: Yenza Umsindo Omuncane
haloinfinite-make-a-little-more-noise-81.description: Thatha isikhali samandla endaweni yezikhali Okokufundisa.
haloinfinite-make-a-little-more-noise-81.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Yenza Umsindo Omuncane" kokuthi Halo Infinite, qala Isifundo se-Academy futhi ufinyelele indawo yokugcina izikhali. Sebenzisa i-Interact ukuze uthathe isikhali samandla endaweni yaso ngenkathi usegumbini.

haloinfinite-a-true-test-of-legends-e9bd.name: Uhlolo Lweqiniso Lwezinganekwane
haloinfinite-a-true-test-of-legends-e9bd.description: Qedela yonke imikhankaso eyinhloko ebunzimeni be-Legendary.
haloinfinite-a-true-test-of-legends-e9bd.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Uhlolo Lweqiniso Lwezinganekwane" kokuthi Halo Infinite, setha umkhankaso ku-Legendary futhi uqedele konke ukuthunywa kwezindaba ezingu-14. Sebenzisa i-Grappleshot ukuze uphume ekulweni obala futhi uqoqe ama-Spartan Cores ukuze uthole isihlangu kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwemishini phakathi kwezinhloso zendaba.

haloinfinite-know-your-enemy-3d8841308c.name: Yazi Isitha Sakho
haloinfinite-know-your-enemy-3d8841308c.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Yazi Isitha Sakho" kokuthi Halo Infinite, qoqa wonke Amalogi Omsindo Akhishiwe. Hlola izinto zokubala zenjongo nezindawo ku-TACMAP futhi usebenzise Ukudlala kabusha Kwezinjongo nganoma yini egejiwe ngaphakathi kwamaleveli endaba.

haloinfinite-catacomb-3d90a03ffb.name: I-Catacomb
haloinfinite-catacomb-3d90a03ffb.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule "I-Catacomb" kokuthi Halo Infinite, qoqa zonke izingebhezi ezifihliwe ezingu-12. Sebenzisa izahluko kuvidiyo ukuze usebenze indawo eyodwa ngesikhathi, futhi usebenzise i-Mission Replay ukuze ubuyisele ama-Skulls ngaphakathi kwamazinga ezindaba aqediwe.

haloinfinite-forza-veloce-b89a3a3011.name: Forza Veloce
haloinfinite-forza-veloce-b89a3a3011.description: Qedela yonke imisebenzi eyi-14 eyinhloko ngaphansi kwamahora ayisishiyagalombili.
haloinfinite-forza-veloce-b89a3a3011.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Forza Veloce" kokuthi Halo Infinite, qala umkhankaso kokuthi Easy futhi ugxile kuphela ezinjongweni zendaba ensomi. Sebenzisa i-Grappleshot nemoto isikhathi eside, futhi uqedele ohambweni abangu-14 ngesikhathi esiphelele esingaphansi kwamahora ayisishiyagalombili.

haloinfinite-party-bus-16b1d6417e.name: Ibhasi Lephathi
haloinfinite-party-bus-16b1d6417e.description: Zuza "Mount Up" nge-Razorback kugeyimu eyenziwe ngokufanisa.
haloinfinite-party-bus-16b1d6417e.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ibhasi Lephathi" kokuthi Halo Infinite, ngena esihlalweni somshayeli we-Razorback ekwenzeni umentshisi bese ushaya uphondo. Linda ozakwenu ukuthi bagcwalise zonke izihlalo ezintathu ngenkathi ucingo lusebenza ukuze uthole i-Mount Up.

haloinfinite-off-the-air-f9e9b98d85.name: Emoyeni
haloinfinite-off-the-air-f9e9b98d85.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule "Emoyeni" kokuthi Halo Infinite, bhubhisa yonke imibhoshongo engu-40 Exoshiwe Ye-Propaganda. Lalela ukusakaza kwabo, sebenzisa ividiyo ukuze uthole imibhoshongo engabonakali kumephu yakho, futhi uhlole isibalo sesifunda ngasinye njengoba uya.

haloinfinite-canon-collector-a95046c9e7.name: Umqoqi weCanon
haloinfinite-canon-collector-a95046c9e7.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Umqoqi weCanon" kokuthi Halo Infinite, qoqa yonke ilogi yomsindo ye-UNSC. Lalela inkomba yelogi eseduze, sebenzisa i-Interact, bese ubheka izinto zokubala zesifunda nezemishini ku-TACMAP ukuze uthole okurekhodiwe okungekho.

haloinfinite-who-is-max-valor-f7c071233d.name: Ubani uMax Valor?
haloinfinite-who-is-max-valor-f7c071233d.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ubani uMax Valor?" kokuthi Halo Infinite, sula imisebenzi yokuzithandela eklomelisa i-Valor. Sebenza ngezindawo Ezikhishiwe, izingcingo ze-UNSC, kanye ne-Propaganda Towers, bese uqhathanisa izibalo zemisebenzi eqediwe yesifunda ngasinye. Izithombe ezixhunyanisiwe ze-co-op zinokuphawula kweSpanishi.

haloinfinite-rubicon-protocol-351f4cb060.name: I-Rubicon Protocol
haloinfinite-rubicon-protocol-351f4cb060.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Rubicon Protocol" kokuthi Halo Infinite, qoqa yonke ilogi yomsindo ye-Spartan. Hlola ukuqhubeka ku-TACMAP, uyiqhathanise nezindawo zevidiyo, futhi usebenzise i-Mission Replay ukuthola izindawo zendaba ezingekho.

haloinfinite-greased-lightning-f0dfb5275.name: Unyazi olugcotshisiwe
haloinfinite-greased-lightning-f0dfb5275.description: Qedela i-Movement Yard ngaphansi kwamasekhondi angu-25.
haloinfinite-greased-lightning-f0dfb5275.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Unyazi olugcotshisiwe" kokuthi Halo Infinite, qala Okokufundisa futhi ufinyelele Igceke Lokunyakaza. Shelelisela esifundweni, gxuma izithiyo ngaphandle kokuma, bese uslayida engxenyeni ephansi. Zama futhi kusukela ekuqaleni kwesifundo kuze kube isikhathi singaphansi kwamasekhondi angu-25.

haloinfinite-gatecrasher-5cb9b86402.name: I-Gatecrasher
haloinfinite-gatecrasher-5cb9b86402.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Gatecrasher" kokuthi Halo Infinite, ngendlela ye-Auditorium, dlulela emgomweni wokwephula ngokushesha. Sebenzisa i-Grappleshot ukweqa izikhala futhi ugweme izimpi ozikhethele ukuze ufinyelele iphuzu lokwephulwa kwemithetho ngaphansi kwemizuzu emithathu.

haloinfinite-headmaster-f1cb7bbddb.name: Uthishanhloko
haloinfinite-headmaster-f1cb7bbddb.description: Qedela yonke imisebenzi eyinhloko ku-Legendary ngawo wonke ama-Skulls asebenzayo.
haloinfinite-headmaster-f1cb7bbddb.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Uthishanhloko" kokuthi Halo Infinite, qoqa zonke izingebhezi eziyi-12 ngaphambi kokuqala ukugijima kwenganekwane. Qala umkhankaso omusha ngayo yonke i-Skull enikwe amandla ukuze yonke imisebenzi emikhulu ibalwe. Gcina izihlangu zifakwe i-melee uma i-Black Eye isebenza futhi usebenzise izinhlamvu ezingenamkhawulo ze-Bandana ukuze ugcine ingcindezi ezitheni.

haloinfinite-stick-around-da20343fe2.name: Stick Around
haloinfinite-stick-around-da20343fe2.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Stick Around" kokuthi Halo Infinite, thola i-skewer yempi ye-Tremonius. Sebenzisa esinye isikhali ukukhumula izihlangu zakhe uma kudingeka, bese uklelisa ukushaya kokugcina nge-Skewer.

haloinfinite-more-than-he-bargained-for-.name: Okungaphezu Kwalokho Akuhlosile
haloinfinite-more-than-he-bargained-for-.description: Nqoba i-War Chief Escharum ngaphandle kokulahlekelwa izihlangu zakho ngokugcwele.
haloinfinite-more-than-he-bargained-for-.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Okungaphezu Kwalokho Akuhlosile" kokuthi Halo Infinite, yilwa no-Escharum kusukela embozweni futhi usebenzise i-Grappleshot ukuze udale ibanga lapho egijima. Uma isihlangu sakho siba phansi, nqamula umugqa wokubona futhi usivumele sishajwe kabusha. Mehlule ngaphandle kokulahlekelwa yisihlangu sonke.

haloinfinite-inseparable-57538e974f.name: Ayihlukaniseki
haloinfinite-inseparable-57538e974f.description: Ngokubambisana, bulala u-Hunter nomfowabo oyisibopho phakathi kwamasekhondi amathathu omunye komunye.
haloinfinite-inseparable-57538e974f.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule i-"Ayihlukaniseki" kokuthi Halo Infinite, ngokubambisana, yabela umdlali oyedwa u-Hunter ngababili kumdlali ngamunye. Yenza kube buthaka kokubili, bese ubiza uma ngayinye seyilungile futhi ubeke amagalelo okuqeda phakathi nemizuzwana emithathu enye kwenye. Izithombe ezixhunyanisiwe ze-co-op zinokuphawula kweSpanishi.

haloinfinite-hunting-party-01d3ed3333.name: Iphathi Yokuzingela
haloinfinite-hunting-party-01d3ed3333.description: Ngokubambisana, susa konke Okuhlosiwe Kwenani Eliphezulu Okukhishiwe kunoma ibuphi ubunzima.
haloinfinite-hunting-party-01d3ed3333.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Iphathi Yokuzingela" kokuthi Halo Infinite, joyina umkhankaso wokubambisana futhi umake Okukhonjiwe Kwenani Eliphezulu ku-TACMAP. Sula konke okuyi-15 njengeqembu futhi uhlole isithonjana ngasinye ukuze siqedwe ngaphambi kokuthi uqhubeke. Izithombe ezixhunyanisiwe ze-co-op zinokuphawula kweSpanishi.

haloinfinite-first-responders-9df67109f5.name: Abaphenduli bokuqala
haloinfinite-first-responders-9df67109f5.description: Ngokubambisana, phendula zonke izingcingo ze-UNSC zokucindezeleka kunoma ibuphi ubunzima.
haloinfinite-first-responders-9df67109f5.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Abaphenduli bokuqala" kokuthi Halo Infinite, ngokubambisana, hamba kuwo wonke umaka wokucindezeleka we-UNSC. Sula izitha ezibeka iqembu engozini bese ulinda isaziso sokuqeda ngaphambi kokudlulela kwesilandelayo. Izithombe ezixhunyanisiwe ze-co-op zinokuphawula kweSpanishi.

haloinfinite-wardens-of-zeta-ae6f7d7c89.name: Abaphathi beZeta
haloinfinite-wardens-of-zeta-ae6f7d7c89.description: Ngokuhlanganyela, qedelani zonke izindawo eziyisikhombisa Ezixoshwayo kunoma ibuphi ubunzima.
haloinfinite-wardens-of-zeta-ae6f7d7c89.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Abaphathi beZeta" kokuthi Halo Infinite, ngokubambisana, sulani zonke izindawo eziyisikhombisa Ezixoshiwe ndawonye. Landela izinjongo zendawo zesikhungo ngasinye bese uhlola i-TACMAP ukuze uthole izindawo eziphumayo ezisabonakala njengezingakaqedwa. Izithombe ezixhunyanisiwe ze-co-op zinokuphawula kweSpanishi.

haloinfinite-vintage-fisticuffs-2ae5d298.name: I-Vintage Fisticuffs
haloinfinite-vintage-fisticuffs-2ae5d298.description: Ku-Nexus, bulala ipheya ye-Hunter ngamagalelo okugcina e-melee.
haloinfinite-vintage-fisticuffs-2ae5d298.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule i-"I-Vintage Fisticuffs" ku-Halo Infinite, ku-Nexus, gcina aba-Hunter bephila kuze kube yilapho ubaqeda nge-melee. Yenza buthaka ngemuva, bese uvala eyodwa ngenkathi ilulama ekuhlaselweni futhi ihlasele i-melee yokubulala. Phinda wenze okunye.

haloinfinite-what-s-rightfully-ours-647a.name: Okuyikho Ngokwethu
haloinfinite-what-s-rightfully-ours-647a.description: Ngokuhlanganyela, thwebula zonke Izisekelo Zokusebenza Phambili kunoma ibuphi ubunzima.
haloinfinite-what-s-rightfully-ours-647a.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Okuyikho Ngokwethu" kokuthi Halo Infinite, kumkhankaso wokubambisana, sula yonke i-FOB futhi usebenzise ikhonsoli yokuthwebula. Qhathanisa omaka bakho abaqediwe be-TACMAP ukuze uthole noma iyiphi i-FOB esengaphansi kolawulo Lokuxoshwa. Izithombe ezixhunyanisiwe ze-co-op zinokuphawula kweSpanishi.

haloinfinite-turnabout-is-fair-play-0faf.name: I-Turnabout i-Fair Play
haloinfinite-turnabout-is-fair-play-0faf.description: Bulala iNduna eyodwa bese usebenzisa i-turret yakhe ukubulala enye eNqolobaneni.
haloinfinite-turnabout-is-fair-play-0faf.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Turnabout i-Fair Play" kokuthi Halo Infinite, Endaweni Yokugcina, bulala iNhloko eyodwa bese ucosha i-turret ewisayo. Phatha i-turret kwenye iNduna futhi uyisebenzisele ukuletha igalelo lokugcina.

haloinfinite-air-raid-9044774975.name: I-Air Raid
haloinfinite-air-raid-9044774975.description: Ngokubambisana, bulala izitha eziyi-100 ngenkathi bonke abadlali begibele izimoto zomoya.
haloinfinite-air-raid-9044774975.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Air Raid" kokuthi Halo Infinite, ekuhlanganyeleni komkhankaso, nikeza wonke umdlali indawo endizeni. Hlala emoyeni ngenkathi i-fireteam ibulala izitha ngezansi, futhi uqhubeke kuze kube yilapho inani lokubulala elingu-100 nabo bonke abadlali abagibeleyo. Izithombe ezixhunyanisiwe ze-co-op zinokuphawula kweSpanishi.

haloinfinite-rapid-unscheduled-disassemb.name: I-Rapid Unschedule Disassembly
haloinfinite-rapid-unscheduled-disassemb.description: Bhubhisa womabili amaPhantom ngaphambi kokuthi asuke e-Outpost Tremonius.
haloinfinite-rapid-unscheduled-disassemb.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Rapid Unschedule Disassembly" kokuthi Halo Infinite, ku-Outpost Tremonius, qoqa izikhali ezinzima ngaphambi kokucupha ama-Phantom. Gxilisa umlilo ku-dropship ngayinye njengoba ingena futhi ibhubhise yomibili ngaphambi kokuthi ihambe.

haloinfinite-it-really-does-beat-everyth.name: Impela Ishaya Konke
haloinfinite-it-really-does-beat-everyth.description: Susa zonke izitha ku-South Beacon nge-Scorpion Tank.
haloinfinite-it-really-does-beat-everyth.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Impela Ishaya Konke" kokuthi Halo Infinite, thatha i-Scorpion uye kuBeacon waseNingizimu Ngokulandelana. Hlala ethangini futhi usebenzise izikhali zayo ukuqeda zonke izitha kuBeacon ngaphambi kokuxhumana nenhloso yayo.

haloinfinite-conservation-of-momentum-c4.name: Ukulondolozwa kwe-Momentum
haloinfinite-conservation-of-momentum-c4.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukulondolozwa kwe-Momentum" kokuthi Halo Infinite, qala i-Conservatory kusukela ekuqaleni bese uqonda ngqo ezinhlosweni. Sebenzisa i-Grappleshot emaphaseji, weqa izimpi ezingavimbeli ukuqhubeka, futhi uqede ngaphansi kwemizuzu eyi-15.

haloinfinite-workplace-safety-violation-.name: Ukwephulwa Kokuphepha Kwasemsebenzini
haloinfinite-workplace-safety-violation-.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukwephulwa Kokuphepha Kwasemsebenzini" kokuthi Halo Infinite, kuyilapho i-laser yezimayini eNdaweni Yokumbiwa isebenza, yima ohlangothini olukude lwe-beam kusukela esitheni. Yiyengele ekuweleni ugongolo futhi uvumele i-laser ithole ukubulala.

haloinfinite-out-with-a-bang-fb686ea521.name: Aphume nge-Bang
haloinfinite-out-with-a-bang-fb686ea521.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Aphume nge-Bang" ku-Halo Infinite, ku-The Tower, yenza buthaka i-Chak 'Lok ngezikhali zakho. Sebenzisa Inzwa Yosongo ukuze ubone ukuthi ukuphi, bese umnamathisele nge-Plasma Grenade ukuze aqede.

haloinfinite-spire-stalker-14a4edb56c.name: Spire Stalker
haloinfinite-spire-stalker-14a4edb56c.description: Bulala izitha ezingama-40 nge-Stalker Rifle ku-Command Spire.
haloinfinite-spire-stalker-14a4edb56c.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Spire Stalker" kokuthi Halo Infinite, letha i-Stalker Rifle ku-Command Spire futhi uyisebenzisele ukuqeda izitha ezingu-40 lapho. Londoloza amashothi ayo ukuze uthole amahithi ahlanzekile futhi uthathe okushintshile noma ugcwalise kabusha lapho kutholakala.

haloinfinite-cow-catcher-96fb7f7003.name: Inkomo Catcher
haloinfinite-cow-catcher-96fb7f7003.description: Ngokubambisana, splatter izitha ezingu-50 ngenkathi ugibele imoto nomunye umdlali.
haloinfinite-cow-catcher-96fb7f7003.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Inkomo Catcher" kokuthi Halo Infinite, ngokubambisana, faka abadlali ababili emotweni efanayo. Sebenzisa umfutho womshayeli ukugijima phezu kwezitha endaweni evulekile futhi ugcine bobabili abadlali begibele uze ube nama-splatters angama-50. Izithombe ezixhunyanisiwe ze-co-op zinokuphawula kweSpanishi.

haloinfinite-gruesome-twosome-22397ae2eb.name: I-Gruesome Twosome
haloinfinite-gruesome-twosome-22397ae2eb.description: Ngokusebenzisana, bulala izitha ezingu-50 ngenkathi ugibele iMongoose nomunye umdlali.
haloinfinite-gruesome-twosome-22397ae2eb.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Gruesome Twosome" kokuthi Halo Infinite, faka abadlali ababili kuMongoose nihlanganyele. Vumela umgibeli adubule ngenkathi umshayeli egcina iMongoose inganyakazi. Hlala emkhunjini ngokubulala okungu-50. Izithombe ezixhunyanisiwe ze-co-op zinokuphawula kweSpanishi.

haloinfinite-keep-it-steady-b6861028ef.name: Igcine Iqinile
haloinfinite-keep-it-steady-b6861028ef.description: Bulala izitha ezi-5 nge-Sniper Rifle emotweni. Bonke abadlali abagibele inqubekelaphambili yabelana ngemoto.
haloinfinite-keep-it-steady-b6861028ef.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Igcine Iqinile" kokuthi Halo Infinite, thatha i-Sniper Rifle uye esihlalweni semoto ongakwazi ukudubula kuso futhi uhlale phakathi kwayo ngenkathi uthola ukubulala okuhlanu ngaso. Noma ubani ogibele imoto efanayo wabelana ngenqubekelaphambili. Izithombe ezixhunyanisiwe ze-co-op zinokuphawula kweSpanishi.

haloinfinite-rolling-thunder-267c235873.name: Ukuduma kwezulu
haloinfinite-rolling-thunder-267c235873.description: Bulala izitha ezi-5 nge-Gravity Hammer emotweni. Bonke abadlali abagibele inqubekelaphambili yabelana ngemoto.
haloinfinite-rolling-thunder-267c235873.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukuduma kwezulu" kokuthi Halo Infinite, hlomisa i-Gravity Hammer bese ugibela isihlalo semoto esivumela ukuhlasela. Shayela eduze kwamaqembu futhi usebenzise isando esivela esihlalweni ukuze uthole ukubulala okuhlanu. Abadlali abagibele imoto efanayo babelana ngenqubekelaphambili. Izithombe ezixhunyanisiwe ze-co-op zinokuphawula kweSpanishi.

haloinfinite-mix-things-up-3d3e44e247.name: Hlanganisa Izinto
haloinfinite-mix-things-up-3d3e44e247.description: Thola okungenani ukubulala okukodwa ngaso sonke isikhali esitholakalayo kanye namabhomu emkhunjini oBanished.
haloinfinite-mix-things-up-3d3e44e247.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Hlanganisa Izinto" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala i-Warship Gbraakon futhi usebenzise isikhali ngasinye nohlobo lwamabhomu olutholakala emkhunjini ukuze uthole ukubulala. Qala ngokulayisha kwakho, bese ushintshanisa izikhali ukuze uthole amaconsi ezitha kanye nama-pickup. Landelela uhlobo ngalunye ngaphambi kokushiya umkhumbi.

haloinfinite-you-me-same-page-8b27cf2ffd.name: Wena, Mina, Ikhasi elifanayo
haloinfinite-you-me-same-page-8b27cf2ffd.description: Ngokusebenzisana, cekela phansi yonke imibhoshongo epholile e-Dig Site phakathi kwamasekhondi angu-60 ukusuka kwenye.
haloinfinite-you-me-same-page-8b27cf2ffd.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Wena, Mina, Ikhasi elifanayo" kokuthi Halo Infinite, ngokubambisana ku-Dig Site, veza imibhoshongo yokupholisa kuqala. Hlukanisa ithimba lakho phakathi kokuhlosiwe, lilungiselele ukuqeda ngokushesha, futhi uwalahle wonke phakathi kwamasekhondi angu-60 wokuqala.

haloinfinite-controlled-demolition-27346.name: Ukubhidliza okulawulwayo
haloinfinite-controlled-demolition-27346.description: Ngokusebenzisana, bhubhisa ama-Fuel Silos amane phakathi nemizuzwana emihlanu ku-Ransom Keep noma ku-Forge of Teash.
haloinfinite-controlled-demolition-27346.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukubhidliza okulawulwayo" kokuthi Halo Infinite, ngokubambisana e-Ransom Keep noma i-Forge of Teash, veza omane ama-Fuel Silos kuqala futhi uwenze buthaka ngaphandle kokuwacekela phansi. Yabela okuqondiwe, ubale wehle, futhi ucekele phansi konke okune phakathi kwamasekhondi amahlanu.

haloinfinite-wolves-at-the-doors-c67546b.name: Izimpisi Eminyango
haloinfinite-wolves-at-the-doors-c67546b.description: Ngokusebenzisana, yehlisa wonke amasango amathathu phakathi kwamasekhondi angu-15 elinye nelinye e-Riven Gate.
haloinfinite-wolves-at-the-doors-c67546b.guideDescription:
Ukuze uvule okuthi "Izimpisi Eminyango" kokuthi Halo Infinite, landela lezi zinyathelo.

1. Ngokusebenzisana e-Riven Gate, sula izitha ezizungeze izilawuli ezintathu kuqala.
2. Beka isidlali kusilawuli ngasinye esitholakalayo noma hlela umzila omfushane phakathi kwemibili.
3. Qala ukubala wehle bese wehlisa wonke amasango amathathu ngemizuzwana eyi-15.

halowarsde-58.name: Hlangana noSayitsheni Forge
halowarsde-58.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Hlangana noSayitsheni Forge" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, layisha i-Mission 1, "Alpha Base", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Sula izindawo zesitha eduze kwendlela, khulula Amasosha Asolwandle avaleleke, futhi usebenzise ama-Warthogs akho kanye nebutho elihamba ngezinyawo ukuze uthathe kabusha i-Alpha Base.

halowarsde-75.name: I-Halo Undergraduate
halowarsde-75.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Halo Undergraduate" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, vula umcimbi wakho wokuqala womugqa wesikhathi ngokuthuthukela emkhankasweni kanye noQoboniso nokuqoqa amabhokisi Amnyama. Ekuqaleni, thatha Ibhokisi Elimnyama ku-Alpha Base ukuze uthole indlela eqondile yokuvula umugqa wesikhathi. Hlola umugqa wesikhathi kumenyu ukuze ubone ukuthi yini evuliwe.

halowarsde-59.name: Yakha Ukuze Uphumelele
halowarsde-59.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Yakha Ukuze Uphumelele" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, layisha i-Mission 2, "Relic Approach", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Yakha esisekelweni sakho, bese uphushela ngasesandleni ngokusebenzisa ukuzivikela kweSivumelwano. Sula imibhoshongo nezimoto ngaphambi kokuthumela izinsana phambili.

halowarsde-3.name: Umfana kaMama
halowarsde-3.description: Thola Indondo Yegolide kunoma iyiphi injongo.
halowarsde-3.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Umfana kaMama" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, dlala kabusha i-Alpha Base futhi uhlose ukuqeda ngokushesha ngokulahleka kweyunithi okumbalwa. Sebenzisa inqama ye-Warthog ku-Grunts ngokubulala okusheshayo. Hlola isikrini semiphumela yegolide futhi usebenzise ukugijima okuxhunyiwe ukuze ubone ukuthi sakha kanjani isikolo.

halowarsde-60.name: Smash futhi Ubambe
halowarsde-60.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Smash futhi Ubambe" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, layisha i-Mission 3, "Relic Interior", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Thola ku-Forge no-Anders, bese ubaphelezela ubuye ngesalela. Sebenzisa izilawuli zebhuloho futhi unamathele kumphelezeli uze ufinyelele ekukhishweni.

halowarsde-61.name: High Class Escort
halowarsde-61.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "High Class Escort" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, layisha i-Mission 4, "Arcadia City", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Vikela imikhumbi ephumayo futhi usule amasosha eSivumelwano emizileni yabantu. Gxilisa ukuzivikela kwakho nxazonke zokuthutha ngaphansi komlilo.

halowarsde-62.name: Ukubekezela Kuwubuhle
halowarsde-62.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukubekezela Kuwubuhle" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, layisha i-Mission 5, "Arcadia Outskirts", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Buyela endaweni eyisisekelo, wakhe ibutho kanye nama-turrets, futhi ubambe isikhundla sakho ngokuhlaselwa kweSivumelwano.

halowarsde-63.name: Ifomu Elikhulu!
halowarsde-63.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ifomu Elikhulu!" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, layisha i-Mission 6, "Dome of Light", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Baphelezele oRhino baye ezindaweni zabo ezimakiwe zokudubula. Gcina amayunithi asekelayo eduze kukaRhino ngamunye kuze kube yilapho idome lehla.

halowarsde-64.name: Ukudansa ne-Beam Queen
halowarsde-64.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukudansa ne-Beam Queen" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, layisha i-Mission 7, "Scarab", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Yakha ibutho esisekelweni bese wehlisa iScarab. Gcina amayunithi ecacile kugongolo lwawo olushanelayo lapho umiswa kabusha.

halowarsde-65.name: Ukusindisa I-Parade
halowarsde-65.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukusindisa I-Parade" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, layisha i-Mission 8, "Ander's Signal", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Landela isignali, vikela Izindlovu, futhi uvikele amasosha akho ahamba ngezinyawo njengoba uphusha kuZamcolo.

halowarsde-56.name: Maye, u-Andrew Thomas ompofu
halowarsde-56.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Maye, u-Andrew Thomas ompofu" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, qala i-Alpha Base bese uqedela umgomo webhonasi wokubulala ama-Grunts angu-100. Uma ugebhezi luvela, hambisa iyunithi endaweni yayo bese uyiqoqa ngaphambi kokuthi umgomo uphele. Ividiyo ikhombisa ukulandwa.

halowarsde-66.name: Ukugwema Ukutheleleka
halowarsde-66.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukugwema Ukutheleleka" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, layisha i-Mission 9, "The Flood", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Misa isisekelo sakho, udlule emakoloni kaZamcolo aseduze, futhi ugxilise amasosha akho esakhiweni esimaphakathi sikaZamcolo.

halowarsde-67.name: Ukukhishwa kwe-Fittest
halowarsde-67.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukukhishwa kwe-Fittest" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, layisha i-Mission 10, "Shield World", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Buyisa ama-platoon ahlakazekile futhi ubuyisele abasindile endaweni yokuphuma ngaphambi kokuphela kwesikhathi.

halowarsde-68.name: Isandla Sedekhi Esibaluleke Kakhulu
halowarsde-68.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Isandla Sedekhi Esibaluleke Kakhulu" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, layisha i-Mission 11, "Cleansing", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Sula uZamcolo emphemeni yoMoya woMlilo. Hambisa amasosha kude nensimu yokuhlanza lapho isondela endaweni yawo.

halowarsde-69.name: Uyi-Fixer yami ephezulu
halowarsde-69.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Uyi-Fixer yami ephezulu" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, layisha i-Mission 12, "Repairs", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Thumela amayunithi e-Cyclops ukuze alungise umgogodla wamandla futhi uwavikele ezitheni ezisesiteki kuze kuqedwe ukulungiswa.

halowarsde-70.name: A Izindlela Zokuphela
halowarsde-70.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "A Izindlela Zokuphela" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, layisha i-Mission 13, "Beachhead", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Vikela indawo yokuhlala, sungula isisekelo sakho, futhi usebenze ngeSivumelwano noZamcolo endleleni eya emgomweni omakiwe.

halowarsde-71.name: Sayiniwe, Kwatywinwa, Kwakhululwa
halowarsde-71.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Sayiniwe, Kwatywinwa, Kwakhululwa" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, layisha i-Mission 14, "Reactor", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Vikela Indlovu edonsa i-reactor futhi usule ingxenye ngayinye yomzila ngaphambi kokuhambisa i-reactor ukhuphuke.

halowarsde-72.name: Ukuqamba Indlela Eya Emlandweni
halowarsde-72.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukuqamba Indlela Eya Emlandweni" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, layisha i-Mission 15, "Escape", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Hlukanisa ibutho lakho phakathi kwamaphoyinti okulawula futhi wenze kusebenze izilawuli zeminyango njengoba i-mission iqondisa. Gcina abavikeli ezindaweni ezivuliwe kuze kuvuleke ukuphuma.

halowarsde-40.name: N00b n0 M0r3
halowarsde-40.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "N00b n0 M0r3" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, faka indawo yokwamukela abantu abaningi futhi udlale umdlalo ogcwele kuze kube yilapho iqembu lakho liwina. Bheka ukuvuleka kusenesikhathi ukuze wakhe ibutho lakho, bese uhlanganisa ukuhlasela nanoma yibaphi abambisene nabo.

halowarsde-32.name: Abangane Bami Abangokoqobo Bayangithanda
halowarsde-32.description: Wina umdlalo we-Skirmish we-3v3 nge-2 AI Allies.
halowarsde-32.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Abangane Bami Abangokoqobo Bayangithanda" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, setha i-3v3 Skirmish futhi ufake abadlali be-AI kuzo zombili izikhala ezihlangene. Gcina izisekelo zabo ziphephile ngenkathi iqembu lakho lihlasela uhlangothi oluphikisayo. Qeda umdlalo ngokuwina.

halowarsde-41.name: So Lonely At the Top
halowarsde-41.description: Wina futhi uthole amaphuzu aphezulu kakhulu kumdlalo womphakathi.
halowarsde-41.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "So Lonely At the Top" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, joyina umdlalo osesidlangalaleni futhi uqedele ohlangothini oluwinile ngesikolo somdlali esiphezulu kakhulu. Nweba umnotho wakho kusenesikhathi, sebenzisa amayunithi akho ekulweni esikhundleni sokuwagcina engenzi lutho, futhi uwagcine phakathi kokuhlasela.

halowarsde-33.name: Ophumelele ekuhambeni
halowarsde-33.description: Sebenzisa amandla angu-6 Omholi Omkhulu ukucekela phansi iyunithi yokugcina yesitha.
halowarsde-33.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ophumelele ekuhambeni" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, shiya isitha neyunithi eyodwa, bese usebenzisa elinye lamandla akho amakhulu omholi ukuze usibhubhise. Bamba umlilo webutho lakho njengoba uwumisa ukuze amandla athole igalelo lokugcina.

halowarsde-21.name: Ukukhanya Ngokuziqhenya
halowarsde-21.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukukhanya Ngokuziqhenya" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, ku-Beachhead, sebenzisa i-Spartan ukuduna i-Scarab. Yilawule ngokuqondile futhi uqondise izitha zakho kuze kube yilapho sezicekele phansi angu-25. Gcina amayunithi asekela eduze ngaphandle kokubavumela babulale obala.

halowarsde-17.name: Sweet Naptime
halowarsde-17.description: I-Mission 9: Faka yonke i-Colony ku-Hibernation Mode ngesikhathi esifanayo.
halowarsde-17.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Sweet Naptime" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, dlala iSikhukhula, wenze buthaka amakoloni azungeze imephu, futhi ushiye amandla elungile endaweni ngayinye. Zibeke phansi zisondele ndawonye ukuze wonke amakholoni abe sebusika ngesikhathi esifanayo.

halowarsde-52.name: Umjaho Iwashi
halowarsde-52.description: Qedela umsebenzi owodwa ngaphansi kwe-Par Time kubunzima bobuqhawe.
halowarsde-52.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Umjaho Iwashi" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, setha ubunzima ku-Heroic futhi uqedele umkhankaso owodwa womkhankaso ngaphansi kwezikhathi ezikhonjiswe kumbiko wemishini. Qala nge-Alpha Base, sebenzisa inqama ye-Warthog ukuze usule ama-Grunts ngokushesha, futhi weqe izimpi ozikhethela zona ezehlisa ijubane umgomo oyinhloko. Hlola isikhathi sokuqeda esirekhodiwe ngemva komzamo ngamunye.

halowarsde-42.name: Ngokuyisisekelo Naïve
halowarsde-42.description: Win 10 Skirmish noma Imidlalo Yabadlali abaningi
halowarsde-42.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ngokuyisisekelo Naïve" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, wina ukufana okungu-10 kwe-Skirmish noma kwabadlali abaningi. Ukuze wakhe abawinile ku-Skirmish, khetha imephu encane kanye ne-Easy AI, khiqiza amandla okuhlasela angaphambi kwesikhathi, futhi ukhiphe isisekelo sesitha ngaphambi kokuthi sande. Qedela esikrinini semiphumela ukuze ukuwina ngakunye kubalwe.

halowarsde-4.name: Imibala Echotshoziwe
halowarsde-4.description: Thuthukisa isikolo sakho kunoma iyiphi Inhloso Yomkhankaso.
halowarsde-4.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Imibala Echotshoziwe" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, khetha umkhankaso onomphumela orekhodiwe. Yidlale futhi futhi uthuthukise umphumela ngokuqeda ngokushesha, ngokugwema ukulahlekelwa, noma ukuzuza amaphuzu amaningi okulwa. Qedela umsebenzi ukuze kuqoshwe amaphuzu aphezulu amasha.

halowarsde-19.name: Washaywa Phansi Ama-Hatches
halowarsde-19.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Washaywa Phansi Ama-Hatches" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, kokuthi Cleansing, vikela yonke i-airlock kuZamcolo. Sabalalisa amandla edekhini ukuze iqembu liphendule ekuhlaselweni nhlangothi zombili. Donsa amabutho ensikeni yokuhlanza, bese ubuyela esimweni lapho isidlulile.

halowarsde-26.name: I-Backscratcher
halowarsde-26.description: Qedela noma iyiphi i-Campaign Mission nge-Co-op Mode.
halowarsde-26.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Backscratcher" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, mema omunye umdlali emkhankasweni, bese niqedela umsebenzi ndawonye. I-Alpha Base iyi-run yokuqala emfushane. Hlala emdlalweni kuze kube isikrini semiphumela ukuze umsebenzi ubale.

halowarsde-12.name: Umnqobi Wangempela
halowarsde-12.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Umnqobi Wangempela" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, e-Arcadia City, thola u-Adam futhi usule umzila ophambi kwakhe. Gcina amabutho akho eduze kwakhe aze afinyelele ezokuthutha, futhi ubeke phambili noma yisiphi iSivumelwano esidubula endleleni yakhe.

halowarsde-34.name: 2 Izimbungulu Zingcono Kuno-1
halowarsde-34.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "2 Izimbungulu Zingcono Kuno-1" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, dlala i-Skirmish njengomholi weSivumelwano. Thuthukisa umnotho wakho, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nenani labantu uze ukwazi ukukhokhela ama-Scarab amabili. Yakha kokubili futhi uwagcine ephila ngenkathi usula isisekelo sesitha sokugcina.

halowarsde-23.name: Ngicabanga 'ngensimbi Yami Yomnyango
halowarsde-23.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ngicabanga 'ngensimbi Yami Yomnyango" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, kokuthi Escape, sebenzisa izilawuli zeminyango ngokulandelana kwazo ezihlosiwe. Vikela iphoyinti lokulawula ngalinye bese ulinda umnyango walo ukuze uvule ngaphambi kokuvula olandelayo. Landela ukuhleleka okuboniswe kuvidiyo.

halowarsde-11.name: Isivumelwano "Hot Drop"
halowarsde-11.description: Injongo yesi-3: Bulala okungenani amayunithi eSivumelwano ama-5 ngeBhuloho.
halowarsde-11.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Covenant "Hot Drop" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, ku-Relic Interior, linda iqembu lamayunithi eSivumelwano ukuthi liye ebhulohweni, bese usebenzisa izilawuli ukuze uliwise. Qinisekisa ukuthi okungenani amayunithi amahlanu asebhulohweni uma uyicisha. Ividiyo ibonisa ukuthi uliletha kuphi iqembu.

halowarsde-36.name: IHalo Academic
halowarsde-36.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "IHalo Academic" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, vula imicimbi engu-20 yomugqa wesikhathi ngokuthuthukela emkhankasweni kanye nokuQothulelana nokuqoqa amabhokisi Amnyama. Ekuqaleni, thatha Ibhokisi Elimnyama ku-Alpha Base ukuze uthole indlela eqondile yokuvula umugqa wesikhathi. Hlola umugqa wesikhathi kumenyu ukuze ubone ukuthi yini evuliwe.

halowarsde-14.name: U-Rhino Hugger
halowarsde-14.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "U-Rhino Hugger" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, ku-Dome of Light, phelezela wonke uRhino endaweni yawo emakiwe futhi ugcine ngamunye ephila. Hambisa amayunithi okulwa ngaphambi kohide futhi ushiye abadlali basemuva eduze kwe-Rhinos asebevele beqalile.

halowarsde-43.name: Isikhulu kuDekhi
halowarsde-43.description: Win 20 Skirmish noma Imidlalo Yabadlali abaningi
halowarsde-43.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Isikhulu kuDekhi" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, wina ukufana okungu-20 kwe-Skirmish noma kwabadlali abaningi. Ukuze wakhe abawinile ku-Skirmish, khetha imephu encane kanye ne-Easy AI, khiqiza amandla okuhlasela angaphambi kwesikhathi, futhi ukhiphe isisekelo sesitha ngaphambi kokuthi sande. Qedela esikrinini semiphumela ukuze ukuwina ngakunye kubalwe.

halowarsde-18.name: I-Procrastinator
halowarsde-18.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Procrastinator" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, ku-Shield World, hlola iphoyinti lendlela yensimbi kagandaganda bese uqedela izinjongo zokuphazamiseka ngaphambi kokuhamba. Gcina ibutho lakho linama-platoons njengoba usula izindawo ezizungeze imishayo.

halowarsde-39.name: Amahora angama-24 Wekhwalithi
halowarsde-39.description: Dlala i-Halo Wars okungenani amahora angama-24 Ephelele.
halowarsde-39.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Amahora angama-24 Wekhwalithi" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, qhubeka nokudlala umkhankaso noma i-Skirmish kuze kube igeyimu iqopha ingqikithi yamahora angu-24. Sebenza ngezindondo zomkhankaso noma ukuwina kwe-Skirmish ngesikhathi esifanayo ukuze isikhathi sokudlala sibale kwezinye izimpumelelo.

halowarsde-48.name: Hhayi uTardy
halowarsde-48.description: Qedela ohambweni oluhlanu ngaphansi kwe-Par Time kubunzima bobuqhawe.
