halowarsde-48.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Hhayi uTardy" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, setha ubunzima ku-Heroic futhi uqedele ohambweni lwemikhankaso emihlanu ehlukene ngaphansi kwezikhathi ezishiwo kumbiko wemishini. Qala nge-Alpha Base, sebenzisa inqama ye-Warthog ukuze usule ama-Grunts ngokushesha, futhi weqe izimpi ozikhethela zona ezehlisa ijubane umgomo oyinhloko. Hlola isikhathi sokuqeda esirekhodiwe ngemva komzamo ngamunye.

halowarsde-27.name: Dlala enkundleni
halowarsde-27.description: Wina i-Skirmish Game nawo wonke umholi.
halowarsde-27.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Dlala enkundleni" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, sebenzisa isikrini sokusetha i-Skirmish ukuze ukhethe umholi ohlukile kumdlalo ngamunye. Wina kanye njengomholi ngamunye kwabathathu be-UNSC kanye nabaholi abathathu beSivumelwano. Gcina uhlu lokuhlola futhi uqedele ukufana ngakunye esikrinini semiphumela.

halowarsde-44.name: Eqhuba uMbukiso
halowarsde-44.description: Win 30 Skirmish noma Imidlalo Yabadlali abaningi
halowarsde-44.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Eqhuba uMbukiso" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, wina ukufana okungu-30 kwe-Skirmish noma kwabadlali abaningi. Ukuze wakhe abawinile ku-Skirmish, khetha imephu encane kanye ne-Easy AI, khiqiza amandla okuhlasela angaphambi kwesikhathi, futhi ukhiphe isisekelo sesitha ngaphambi kokuthi sande. Qedela esikrinini semiphumela ukuze ukuwina ngakunye kubalwe.

halowarsde-50.name: Iqoqo Elithandekayo Likakhukhunathi
halowarsde-50.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Iqoqo Elithandekayo Likakhukhunathi" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, qedela umgomo ohlobene wokubulala ibhonasi kumkhankaso ngamunye womkhankaso ukuze wenze ugebhezi lwayo luvele. Thumela iyunithi ukuze uyiqoqe ngaphambi kokuqeda. Qala ngemishini yangaphambi kwesikhathi bese ulandela izindawo ezixhunyiwe uze ube nezigebhezi eziyisishiyagalombili ezihlukene.

halowarsde-8.name: I-Epic Grinder
halowarsde-8.description: Thola umkhankaso wempilo yakho yonke Amaphuzu angaphezu kuka-1,000,000.
halowarsde-8.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Epic Grinder" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, yakha amaphuzu omkhankaso ahlanganisiwe angaphezu kuka-1,000,000. Khulisa imiphumela yemishini yamaphuzu aphansi ngokuqeda phakathi nesikhathi esilinganiselwe kanye nokunciphisa ukulahlekelwa kwamayunithi. Sebenza ngezinye izimpumelelo ukuze uthole izindondo zemishini ngenkathi wakha isamba sempilo yonke.

halowarsde-31.name: I-Big Al's Scooter
halowarsde-31.description: Wina i-Heroic Skirmish Game ngokumelene ne-AI ngaphansi kwemizuzu eyi-10.
halowarsde-31.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Big Al's Scooter" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, qala i-Heroic Skirmish futhi usebenzise ukushesha ngaphambi kokuthi isitha sakhe. Thumela iyunithi yokuhlola ukuze uthole isisekelo, ukhiqize amandla akho okuhlasela ngaphandle kokulibala, futhi uqedele ngaphansi kwemizuzu eyi-10.

halowarsde-45.name: Ungangiyeki Manje
halowarsde-45.description: Win 40 Skirmish noma Imidlalo Yabadlali abaningi.
halowarsde-45.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ungangiyeki Manje" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, wina ukufana okungu-40 kwe-Skirmish noma kwabadlali abaningi. Ukuze wakhe abawinile ku-Skirmish, khetha imephu encane kanye ne-Easy AI, khiqiza amandla okuhlasela angaphambi kwesikhathi, futhi ukhiphe isisekelo sesitha ngaphambi kokuthi sande. Qedela esikrinini semiphumela ukuze ukuwina ngakunye kubalwe.

halowarsde-10.name: Ubumnandi obungapheli
halowarsde-10.description: Injongo yesi-2: Bhubhisa yonke i-Methane Tank.
halowarsde-10.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ubumnandi obungapheli" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, dlala futhi i-Relic Approach. Bheka emaphethelweni wendawo ngayinye ye-Methane Tanks bese unikeza amayunithi akho umyalelo wokuhlasela endaweni ngayinye. Shanela umzila wanoma yimaphi amathangi aphelele ngaphambi kokuqeda umkhankaso.

halowarsde-35.name: UPenny Pincher
halowarsde-35.description: Thola i-High Score ewinayo enama-squads angu-10 noma ngaphansi uma ubhekene ne-Heroic AI.
halowarsde-35.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "UPenny Pincher" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, qala i-Heroic Skirmish futhi ugcine ibutho lakho libe kumaqembu angu-10 noma ngaphansi. Thuthukisa amayunithi onawo, buyisela ukulahlekelwa ngaphakathi kwekhephu, futhi uqedele umdlalo ngokuwina amaphuzu aphezulu.

halowarsde-1.name: Gweba u-Arbiter
halowarsde-1.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Gweba u-Arbiter" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, setha ubunzima boMkhankaso bube yi-Heroic futhi usule yonke imisebenzi engu-15. Gcina ingxubevange yamayunithi alwa nezingane kanye nezimoto, buyisela ukulahlekelwa phakathi kwezimpi, futhi uhlole irekhodi lemishini nganoma yini engaphansi kweHeroic.

halowarsde-46.name: Umzamo omkhulu
halowarsde-46.description: Win 50 Skirmish noma Ukufana Kwabadlali abaningi.
halowarsde-46.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Umzamo omkhulu" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, wina ukufana okungu-50 kwe-Skirmish noma kwabadlali abaningi. Ukuze wakhe abawinile ku-Skirmish, khetha imephu encane kanye ne-Easy AI, khiqiza amandla okuhlasela angaphambi kwesikhathi, futhi ukhiphe isisekelo sesitha ngaphambi kokuthi sande. Qedela esikrinini semiphumela ukuze ukuwina ngakunye kubalwe.

halowarsde-30.name: I-Titan
halowarsde-30.description: Thola amaphuzu angu-20,000 kunoma yimuphi umdlalo we-Skirmish.
halowarsde-30.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Titan" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, dlala i-Skirmish futhi wakhe amaphuzu ngokubhubhisa amayunithi ezitha nezisekelo kuyilapho ugcina ukulahlekelwa kwakho kuphansi. Gcina isisekelo sesitha sinde ngokwanele ukuze sakhele kumaphoyinti angu-20,000, bese uqeda umdlalo.

halowarsde-13.name: Uphethe uJack
halowarsde-13.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Uphethe uJack" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, e-Arcadia Outskirts, sebenzisa abaduni base-Spartan ukuthatha izimoto eziyisithupha ze-Covenant. Shiya ithagethi iphila, khetha i-Spartan ngezinyawo, bese usebenzisa umyalo wokuduna. Phuma emotweni ethunjiwe uma udinga leyo Spartan kwelandelayo.

halowarsde-54.name: I-Freak ku-Streak
halowarsde-54.description: Zuza okungenani inani labantu abangu-15 kugagasi elilodwa kugeyimu Yokuqinisa.
halowarsde-54.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Freak ku-Streak" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, dlala i-Reinforcement futhi ukhulule isikhala esanele sabantu ngaphambi kwegagasi elilandelayo. Vumela amayunithi amasha ukuthi afike ndawonye futhi uhlole ukuthi igagasi lengeze okungenani inani labantu abangu-15 ngokwalo.

halowarsde-47.name: Donsa Kakhulu, Donsa Ujule
halowarsde-47.description: Wina futhi ungalokothi ulandele kumdlalo we-Tug of War.
halowarsde-47.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Donsa Kakhulu, Donsa Ujule" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, khetha i-Tug of War futhi wakhe amayunithi kusenesikhathi ukuze ugcine amandla akho ephambi kolunye uhlangothi. Shintshanisa ukulahlekelwa ngokushesha, vikela izisekelo zakho, futhi uhlale uboshiwe noma uphambili kubha yenqubekelaphambili uze uwine.

halowarsde-51.name: Isosha lase-Ares
halowarsde-51.description: Win 75 Skirmish noma Ukufana Kwabadlali abaningi.
halowarsde-51.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Isosha lase-Ares" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, wina ukufana okungu-75 kwe-Skirmish noma kwabadlali abaningi. Ukuze wakhe abawinile ku-Skirmish, khetha imephu encane kanye ne-Easy AI, khiqiza amandla okuhlasela angaphambi kwesikhathi, futhi ukhiphe isisekelo sesitha ngaphambi kokuthi sande. Qedela esikrinini semiphumela ukuze ukuwina ngakunye kubalwe.

halowarsde-2.name: Phumula Uhambo Olukhulu
halowarsde-2.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Phumula Uhambo Olukhulu" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, setha ubunzima bomkhankaso kube Inganekwane futhi usule yonke imisebenzi engu-15. Yakha umnotho wakho ngaphambi kokuzibophezela ezimpini ozikhethela zona, hlola ngeyunithi esheshayo, futhi uhlole umgomo olandelayo ekuhambeni okuxhunyiwe lapho umzila uba nzima.

halowarsde-7.name: Udonga Lokuqashelwa
halowarsde-7.description: Thola Indondo Yegolide kuyo yonke Imishini Yomkhankaso.
halowarsde-7.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Udonga Lokuqashelwa" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, sebenza kuwo wonke amamishini omkhankaso angu-15 futhi uqedele ngalinye ngeNdondo Yegolide. Ukugijima okuxhunyiwe kunesahluko semishini ngayinye. Sebenzisa irekhodi lesevisi ukuze ubone noma yiliphi izinga elingaphansi kwegolide ngaphambi kokulidlala futhi.

halowarsde-22.name: Awufikanga Esisekelweni Sesibili
halowarsde-22.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Awufikanga Esisekelweni Sesibili" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, dlala i-Reactor usebenzisa kuphela isisekelo oqala ngaso. Yakha ibutho lakho nomnotho lapho, bese usula indlela ye-reactor ngaphandle kokufuna isizinda esingeziwe.

halowarsde-55.name: Ungalinge Ushiye Umuntu Ngemva
halowarsde-55.description: Qeda ngezinsizakusebenza ezingu-5000 ezinikelwe ozakwenu eSikhumbuzweni ngaphandle kwase-Deathmatch.
halowarsde-55.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ungalinge Ushiye Umuntu Ngemva" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, setha igeyimu yeqembu ku-Memorial Basin ngemodi engeyona i-Deathmatch. Sebenzisa inketho yentela ukuze uthumele izinsiza zabalingani futhi ulandelele lokho ezikubuyisela emuva. Qeda ngokuthumela okungenani okungu-5,000 kunalokho okutholiwe.

halowarsde-24.name: I-Graverobber
halowarsde-24.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Graverobber" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, umkhankaso ngamunye unogebhezi lwekhanda oluvulwe ngenjongo yokuzikhethela. Qedela leyo nhloso, bese uthumela iyunithi ukuze iqoqe Ugebhezi endaweni oluzalele kuyo ngaphambi kokuqeda. Phinda kuzo zonke izimishini eziyi-15.

halowarsde-29.name: I-Empire Builder
halowarsde-29.description: Wina umdlalo kuyo yonke i-Skirmish Game Mode.
halowarsde-29.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Empire Builder" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, setha i-Skirmish futhi uwine imodi ngayinye yegeyimu etholakalayo. Hlola isikhethi semodi phakathi kokufanayo ukuze umboze i-Standard, Deathmatch, nezinye izindlela ezifakiwe.

halowarsde-49.name: Isikhali sikaZeus
halowarsde-49.description: Win 100 Skirmish noma Ukufana Kwabadlali abaningi.
halowarsde-49.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Isikhali sikaZeus" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, wina ukufana okungu-100 kwe-Skirmish noma kwabadlali abaningi. Ukuze wakhe abawinile ku-Skirmish, khetha imephu encane kanye ne-Easy AI, khiqiza amandla okuhlasela angaphambi kwesikhathi, futhi ukhiphe isisekelo sesitha ngaphambi kokuthi sande. Qedela esikrinini semiphumela ukuze ukuwina ngakunye kubalwe.

halowarsde-16.name: Ramblin 'Man
halowarsde-16.description: Injongo yesi-8: Sebenzisa Izindlovu ukuqeqesha amasosha ahamba ngezinyawo ayi-100.
halowarsde-16.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ramblin 'Man" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, ku-Ander's Signal, sebenzisa Izindlovu zakho kanye namasosha akho ahamba ngezinyawo kulayini kumamenyu azo okukhiqiza. Gcina Izindlovu zivalekile futhi qhubeka nokushintsha olayini abagcwele kuze kube yilapho usuqeqeshe amasosha ahamba ngezinyawo ayi-100 ngaphambi kokuqeda.

halowarsde-28.name: I-Gallivant ezungeze i-Galaxy
halowarsde-28.description: Wina umdlalo kuwo wonke amamephu we-Skirmish.
halowarsde-28.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Gallivant ezungeze i-Galaxy" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, khetha imephu ongawinanga kuyo ku-Skirmish, shaya i-AI, bese uphinda kumephu ngayinye etholakalayo. Lungisa usayizi wegeyimu ukuze uveze amamephu anezibalo ezihlukile zabadlali.

halowarsde-20.name: Isebenza ngamathuluzi
halowarsde-20.description: Injongo 12: Lungisa I-Power Core ngaphansi kwemizuzu emi-4.
halowarsde-20.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Isebenza ngamathuluzi" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, qala Ukulungisa futhi uthumele amayunithi akho e-Cyclops aqonde ku-Power Core. Zigcine emsebenzini wokulungisa futhi usebenzise amanye amasosha akho ukuvimba abahlaseli. Buyisela indikimba ibe namandla aphelele ngaphambi kokuthi kudlule imizuzu emine.

halowarsde-74.name: KillJoy
halowarsde-74.description: Phakamisa Amandla Omholi angu-5 asebenzayo kugeyimu eyodwa ku-Blood River.
halowarsde-74.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "KillJoy" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, ku-Blood River, dlala njenge-UNSC ngokumelene nomholi Wesivumelwano. Gcina Ibhomu Lokuphazamiseka litholakala bese uliphonsa kumholi ngenkathi amandla esebenza. Linda ukupholisa phansi bese uphinda uze uphazamise amandla amahlanu kumdlalo ofanayo.

halowarsde-5.name: UMnu. Ogcina isikhathi
halowarsde-5.description: Qeda yonke imisebenzi ngaphansi kwe-Par Time kubunzima bobuqhawe.
halowarsde-5.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "UMnu. Ogcina isikhathi" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, setha ubunzima ku-Heroic futhi uqedele yonke imikhankaso engu-15 ngaphansi kwezikhathi ezikhonjiswe kumbiko wemishini. Qala nge-Alpha Base, sebenzisa inqama ye-Warthog ukuze usule ama-Grunts ngokushesha, futhi weqe izimpi ozikhethela zona ezehlisa ijubane umgomo oyinhloko. Hlola isikhathi sokuqeda esirekhodiwe ngemva komzamo ngamunye.

halowarsde-15.name: Umphathi omncane
halowarsde-15.description: Injongo 7: Ungachithi noma iyiphi i-Power Node.
halowarsde-15.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Umphathi omncane" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, dlala i-Scarab futhi ugxilise ukuhlasela kwakho ku-Scarab uqobo. Gcina ama-Power Nodes ngaphandle kwama-oda akho okuhlasela futhi ukhiphe amayunithi akho endleleni ye-beam. Qeda ngaphandle kokucekela phansi inodi.

halowarsde-53.name: Ukuphila Isiphazamisi Sothando
halowarsde-53.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukuphila Isiphazamisi Sothando" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, setha Ukuqiniswa njengomholi Wesivumelwano. Thuthukisa ubuchwepheshe bakho futhi ushiye isikhala esanele sabantu ukuze uthole i-Scarab kugagasi lokuqinisa. Qhubeka nokudlala kuze kufike iyunithi.

halowarsde-57.name: Uhambo Oluzodlula
halowarsde-57.description: Okushisayo phonsa amaqembu angu-50 kumholi wakho Wesivumelwano kumdlalo owodwa ku-Barrens.
halowarsde-57.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Uhambo Oluzodlula" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, ku-Barrens, dlala njengomholi weSivumelwano futhi usebenzise lowo mholi ensimini. Qeqesha amaqembu futhi uwathumele nge-base teleporter kumholi. Phinda kuze kube sekufike amaqembu angu-50 emdlalweni ofanayo.

halowarsde-9.name: Konke Kungcono Nge-Bacon
halowarsde-9.description: Injongo 1: Qhama futhi ubulale amaGrunts angama-50 ngama-Warthogs.
halowarsde-9.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Konke Kungcono Nge-Bacon" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, qala i-Alpha Base bese ukhetha ama-Warthogs akho. Sebenzisa ikhono labo le-Ram emaqenjini e-Grunts esikhundleni sokuvumela i-turret iwaqedele. Qhubeka ugoqa kuyo yonke indlela eya esisekelweni uze ubulale ama-Grunts angu-50 ngale ndlela.

halowarsde-25.name: Okukodwa futhi Kwenziwe
halowarsde-25.description: Thola iphoyinti eliwinile kugeyimu ye-Keepaway ngokumelene ne-Legendary AI's.
halowarsde-25.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Okukodwa futhi Kwenziwe" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, setha igeyimu ye-Keepaway ngokumelene ne-Legendary AI. Thwebula ifulegi kuze kube yilapho iqembu lakho selithola iphuzu elilodwa kusukela ekuwineni, bese uthwebula futhi ulethe ifulegi lokugcina ngokwakho. Vikela eduze komzila wefulegi ngenkathi ulinde ithuba lokugcina.

halowarsde-6.name: Own Isitha Esibi Kakhulu
halowarsde-6.description: Thola Indondo Yegolide enawo wonke ama-Debuff Skulls Active.
halowarsde-6.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Own Isitha Esibi Kakhulu" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, qoqa ama-Skulls omkhankaso, bese unika amandla i-Rebel Sympathizer, Umsekeli Wezihlubuki, Nomholi Wezihlubuki kumenyu yoKhakhayi. Qalisa umgomo omfushane njenge-Alpha Base futhi usebenzise ama-Warthogs akho ukuze unqande ama-Grunts ukuze ubulale ngokushesha. Qeda ngendondo yegolide.

halowarsde-37.name: Isazi-mlando seHalo
halowarsde-37.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Isazi-mlando seHalo" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, vula Umugqa Wesikhathi bese ukhomba okufakiwe okukhiyiwe. Qoqa umkhankaso othi Black Boxes futhi uqedele umkhankaso ohlobene kanye nezigigaba ze-Skirmish kuze kube yilapho okungenelayo kuvuliwe. Hlola i-walkthrough exhunyiwe uma ushoda ngomcimbi othile.

halowarsde-73.name: I-Drain Cleaner
halowarsde-73.description: Bulala amaqembu ezitha angu-20 nge-Covenant Leader Power eqhubekayo ku-Sikhumbuzo Basin.
halowarsde-73.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Drain Cleaner" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, dlala ku-Memorial Basin njengomholi Wesivumelwano onekhono eliqhubekayo. Linda amaqembu esitha aqoqwe, bese ugcine amandla esebenza futhi uwaqondise ekwakhekeni. Gcina amandla ayo kanye nezindleko zokuhlinzeka engqondweni njengoba usebenzela ekubulaweni kweqembu okungama-20.

halowarsde-38.name: Ilungele Ukulandelana
halowarsde-38.guideDescription:
Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ilungele Ukulandelana" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, landela lezi zinyathelo.

1. Hlola iphesenti lakho lokuqedwa kurekhodi lesevisi.
2. Zuza Igolide kuyo yonke imikhankaso eyi-15, qedela umgomo okhethekile we-mission ngayinye, futhi uqoqe ama-Skulls nama-Black Boxes.
3. Ku-Skirmish, wina ngomholi ngamunye, kumephu ngayinye, nakumodi ngayinye, futhi ufinyelele amaphuzu angu-20,000 kumdlalo.
4. Hlola i-Halo Historian kanye ne-Epic Grinder nganoma yimuphi umugqa wesikhathi osele noma izidingo zamaphuzu.

halospartanstrike-11.name: Unolwazi
halospartanstrike-11.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Unolwazi" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Strike, dlala umkhankaso wokuqala kanye nokubulalana eduze ukuze uthole amabhonasi ezindondo. Qedela umgomo uma usufinyelele impokophelo yayo yomphumela weGolide. Ungasebenzisa i-Score Booster esikrinini sokulayisha uma udinga amaphuzu engeziwe. Ividiyo ibonisa inhloso yokuvula ukuze isetshenziswe.

halospartanstrike-1.name: Siyakwamukela eNew Mombasa
halospartanstrike-1.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Siyakwamukela eNew Mombasa" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Strike, vula i-Operation A emkhankasweni futhi uqedele yonke imisebenzi engu-6, kusukela ku-A-1 kuya ku-A-6. Landela umaka wenhloso yenjongo ngayinye bese uqedela umgomo wokugcina wokuvula impumelelo. Noma yisiphi isilinganiso senkanyezi sanele kulokhu kusula.

halospartanstrike-2.name: Ukungena ekhaya
halospartanstrike-2.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukungena ekhaya" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Strike, vula i-Operation B emkhankasweni futhi uqedele yonke imisebenzi engu-6, kusukela ku-B-1 ukuya ku-B-6. Landela umaka wenhloso yenjongo ngayinye bese uqedela umgomo wokugcina wokuvula impumelelo. Noma yisiphi isilinganiso senkanyezi sanele kulokhu kusula.

halospartanstrike-3.name: Ilungele Ukuhamba
halospartanstrike-3.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ilungele Ukuhamba" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Strike, vula i-Operation C emkhankasweni futhi uqedele yonke imisebenzi engu-6, kusukela ku-C-1 kuya ku-C-6. Landela umaka wenhloso yenjongo ngayinye bese uqedela umgomo wokugcina wokuvula impumelelo. Noma yisiphi isilinganiso senkanyezi sanele kulokhu kusula.

halospartanstrike-6.name: Ngiyisihlangu Sakho
halospartanstrike-6.description: Gcina Indlovu iphelele ngo-100% ku-Operation A, Mission 3
halospartanstrike-6.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ngiyisihlangu Sakho" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Strike, vula i-Operation A, Mission 3. Uma usungene ku-Warthog, sula umgwaqo nezinhlangothi zombili zomzila wokuphelezela ngaphambi kokuba iNdlovu ikhuphuke. Emgodleni ngamunye, hlola imigwaqo ukuze uthole ama-Grunts okuzibulala futhi uwabhubhise ukude. Gcina i-turret ikhombe kude neNdlovu ukuze kungabi nomlilo wobungani. Sebenzisa ividiyo njengesithenjwa somzila wale ngxenye yomkhankaso.

halospartanstrike-4.name: Ikhaya Limnandi
halospartanstrike-4.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ikhaya Limnandi" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Strike, vula i-Operation D emkhankasweni futhi uqedele yonke imisebenzi engu-6, kusukela ku-D-1 kuya ku-D-6. Landela umaka wenhloso yenjongo ngayinye bese uqedela umgomo wokugcina wokuvula impumelelo. Noma yisiphi isilinganiso senkanyezi sanele kulokhu kusula.

halospartanstrike-13.name: UMsebenzisi Omkhulu
halospartanstrike-13.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "UMsebenzisi Omkhulu" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Strike, ngaphambi kokwethula ohambweni, thenga izikhali, amakhono, noma izithuthukisi ngamakhredithi esikrinini sokulayisha. Qhubeka nokukhetha ukuthuthukisa okusiza ngezinkanyezi zegolide noma izinselele ze-Skull uze usebenzise amakhredithi angu-10,000 esewonke. Ividiyo ibonisa inhloso yokuvula ukuze isetshenziswe.

halospartanstrike-8.name: I-Night Knight
halospartanstrike-8.description: Ungavumeli ababukeli ukuthi bavuse noma yimaphi ama-Knights ku-Operation C, Mission 4
halospartanstrike-8.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Night Knight" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Strike, dlala i-Operation C, Mission 4. Kungosi ngayinye, vumela ama-Knights asondele phakathi nendawo ngaphambi kokubabulala ukuze ubone Ababukeli abangena ukuze babavuselele. Beka kuqala Izibukeli futhi ugweme ukushiya imizimba ye-Knight ngaphandle kwesikrini. Bamba lokhu ngengosi yokugcina. Sebenzisa ividiyo njengesithenjwa somzila wale ngxenye yomkhankaso.

halospartanstrike-5.name: Azikho Iziphetho Ezixegayo
halospartanstrike-5.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Azikho Iziphetho Ezixegayo" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Strike, vula i-Operation E emkhankasweni futhi uqedele yonke imisebenzi engu-6, kusukela ku-E-1 kuya ku-E-6. Landela umaka wenhloso yenjongo ngayinye bese uqedela umgomo wokugcina wokuvula impumelelo. Noma yisiphi isilinganiso senkanyezi sanele kulokhu kusula. Zuza igolide kuyo yonke inhloso ye-Operations A ukuya ku-D ukuze uyivule kuqala.

halospartanstrike-12.name: Impi Yaqina
halospartanstrike-12.description: Zuza zonke izinkanyezi zegolide ku-Operations A kuya ku-E
halospartanstrike-12.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Impi Yaqina" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Strike, sebenzisa ohambweni abangu-30 kokuthi Operations A kuya ku-E futhi uzuze inkanyezi Yegolide ngayinye. Hlola indondo yakho yamanje esikrinini sokusebenza. Emidlalweni ephindwayo, sebenzisa i-Score Booster futhi iqembu libulale ndawonye ukuze uthole izindondo. Ku-B-5 naku-B-6, ungakha amaphuzu amaningi kumagagasi eduze nokuphela ngaphambi kokuhamba. Ividiyo ibonisa inhloso yokuvula ukuze isetshenziswe.

halospartanstrike-15.name: I-Vidmaster Challenge A
halospartanstrike-15.description: Qedela i-Operation A, Mission 6 enogebhezi oluyimpumputhe nokuduma kwezulu olusebenzayo
halospartanstrike-15.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Vidmaster Challenge A" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Strike, nika amandla i-Blind and Thunderstorm ngaphambi kokwethula i-A-6. I-Blind isusa i-HUD yakho, ngakho layisha kabusha phakathi kwamagagasi futhi usebenzise ikhava lapho uqala ukuthatha amahithi. I-Damage Booster isiza ngokumelene nezitha ezinamandla. Qeda ngawo womabili ama-Skulls asebenzayo.

halospartanstrike-14.name: GEN2
halospartanstrike-14.description: Sebenzisa wonke Amandla Ezikhali okungenani kanye
halospartanstrike-14.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "GEN2" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Strike, sebenzisa okokufundisa ukuze uzame Ikhono Lezikhali ngalinye elitholakalayo, futhi ulandelele lawo owazisebenzisile. Hlola ukulayishwa kwemishini ukuze uthole amakhono engeziwe angathengwa ngamakhredithi. Hlomisa ikhono ngalinye elishodayo futhi ulisebenzise kumishini.

halospartanstrike-7.name: Hhayi Ukuklwebheka
halospartanstrike-7.description: Gcina i-Wraith 100% iqinile ku-Operation B, Mission 4
halospartanstrike-7.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Hhayi Ukuklwebheka" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Strike, qala i-Operation B, Mission 4 bese uthatha i-Wraith. Shisa udaka ngesango lokuqala ukuze usule izitha eziseduze ngaphambi kokubhubhisa i-generator yayo. Kwijeneretha yesibili, misa eceleni ngaphambi kokucupha igagasi elilandelayo. Shiya i-Wraith ngemuva kwekhava ngenkathi usula izindawo lapho ongakwazi khona ukubona kude ngokwanele ukuze usebenzise udaka. Sebenzisa ividiyo njengesithenjwa somzila wale ngxenye yomkhankaso.

halospartanstrike-16.name: I-Vidmaster Challenge B
halospartanstrike-16.description: Qedela i-Operation B, Mission 6 ene-Hollow and Pacifist Skulls esebenzayo
halospartanstrike-16.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Vidmaster Challenge B" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Strike, nika amandla i-Hollow ne-Pacifist ye-B-6. Sebenzisa i-Kestrel ukuze unqamule izitha ngesikhathi sokusondela futhi ulondoloze amabhomu akho ukuze uvikeleke endaweni yokufikela. Qhubeka uzungeza ikhava kuze kufike i-Pelican, njengoba ukudubula ngaphansi kwe-Pacifist kukhipha isivikelo sakho.

halospartanstrike-18.name: I-Vidmaster Challenge D
halospartanstrike-18.description: Qedela i-Operation D, Mission 6 ngeNdlala Nogebhezi Lwezikhukhula ezisebenzayo
halospartanstrike-18.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Vidmaster Challenge D" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Strike, nika amandla Indlala Nokuduma kwe-D-6. Sebenzisa izikhali kuma-rack emaphethelweni emephu ukuze umiselele ama-pickup ane-ammo ephansi njengoba kudingeka. Beka kuqala izitha eduze Nonjiniyela ngenkathi isebenza kuphothali futhi inebha yezempilo.

halospartanstrike-17.name: I-Vidmaster Challenge C
halospartanstrike-17.description: Qedela i-Operation C, i-Mission 6 ene-Black Eye ne-Pacifist Skulls esebenzayo
halospartanstrike-17.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Vidmaster Challenge C" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Strike, vula i-Black Eye ne-Pacifist ku-C-6. Sebenzisa i-melee ezitheni ezincane ukuze ubuyisele izihlangu, bese umangaza ama-Knights anamandla ngamabhomu ngaphambi kokuvala. Endaweni yokudonsa, sebenzisa amabhomu anamathelayo ngokumelene nama-Knights aqinile kanye nebhodi lapho umgomo usuphelile.

halospartanstrike-9.name: I-Beam Dance
halospartanstrike-9.description: Qedela i-Operation D, Mission 5 ngaphandle kokushaywa i-Focus Turret
halospartanstrike-9.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Beam Dance" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Strike, qala i-Operation D, Mission 5 futhi usondele ku-Focus Turret ngayinye usebenzisa ikhava. I-Teleport ngemuva kwe-turret uma iqala ukukulandela, bese usebenzisa amabhomu ukuyikhipha. Thatha amabhomu amangalisayo ngemva kokuzivikela okunesikhathi ukuze uphathe iqembu lokugcina, futhi uqedele ngaphandle kokukushaya kwe-Focus Turret. Sebenzisa ividiyo njengesithenjwa somzila wale ngxenye yomkhankaso.

halospartanstrike-10.name: Ishaneli Yami
halospartanstrike-10.description: Ungashaywa yinoma iyiphi i-Proximity Mines ku-Operation E, Mission 2
halospartanstrike-10.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ishaneli Yami" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Strike, qala i-Operation E, Mission 2 futhi ubuke izimayini ezibekwe eceleni komzila noma eziwiswe amaBrutes. Thatha i-Bubble Shield kuma-Elite ekuqaleni kwe-mission futhi uyisebenzise ngaphambi kokuba imayini iqhume. Gwema kokubili ukuqhuma nezinaliti ezizikhululayo.

halospartanstrike-19.name: I-Vidmaster Challenge E
halospartanstrike-19.description: Qedela i-Operation E, Mission 6 eneHollow and Black Eye Skulls esebenzayo
halospartanstrike-19.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Vidmaster Challenge E" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Strike, vula i-Hollow ne-Black Eye ku-E-6. Thatha i-turret eduze nasekuqaleni bese ugxila ezansi kuma-Knights ngaphambi kokuthi ayiphule. Sebenzisa amarokhethi kuma-Shade Turrets, futhi uhlukanise izitha ze-melee ukubuyisela izihlangu phakathi kwamagagasi. Gcina umlilo wakho kude ne-dropship ngesikhathi sokuzivikela kokugcina.

halospartanstrike-20.name: Ngokuphelele
halospartanstrike-20.description: Qedela wonke ama-Assault Ops Okusebenza A kuya ku-E
halospartanstrike-20.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ngokuphelele" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Strike, vula uhlu lwe-Assault Ops lwenjongo ngayinye futhi ulandelele zontathu izinjongo zemishini ngaphambi kokuthi uqale. Dlala kabusha umgomo ohlobene nesikhali, okuhlosiwe, noma indondo esohlwini lwenhloso engaqediwe. Sebenza kuzo zonke izimishini ezingama-30 ku-Operations A kuya ku-E futhi uhlole uhlu lwemishini ngayinye njengoba uhamba.

halospartanassault-11.name: Butha
halospartanassault-11.description: Zuza inkanyezi yanoma yiluphi uhlobo kumishini yokusebenza
halospartanassault-11.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Butha" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, dlala i-A-1 futhi uqedele zonke izinjongo zayo. Qhubeka uthwebula emaqenjini ezitha ukuze uthole amaphuzu futhi uqedele umkhankaso ngenkanyezi Yethusi, Isiliva, noma Yegolide. Ividiyo ibonisa inhloso yokuvula ukuze isetshenziswe.

halospartanassault-6.name: Isevisi yokuphelezela
halospartanassault-6.description: Gcina wonke ama-Wolverine eqinile ku-Operation A, Mission 3
halospartanassault-6.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Isevisi yokuphelezela" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, dlala i-A-3 futhi uhlale ngaphambi kwe-Wolverines lapho ungakwazi khona. Khipha izitha ezisondela ku-convoy ngaphambi kokuthi zingene ebangeni, futhi uqondise amabhomu kude nezimoto ezinobungane. Finyelela esiphethweni ngayo yonke i-Wolverine isaphelele. Sebenzisa ividiyo njengesithenjwa somzila wale ngxenye yomkhankaso.

halospartanassault-12.name: I-Prodigy
halospartanassault-12.description: Zuza inkanyezi yakho yokuqala eGold kumishini yokusebenza
halospartanassault-12.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Prodigy" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, dlala kabusha ileveli yangaphambi kwesikhathi efana ne-A-1 futhi wakhe isikolo sakho ngokwehlisa izitha ngamaqembu asheshayo. I-Score Booster ingakusiza ukuthi usule umkhawulo Wegolide oboniswe kumishini. Qedela izinjongo ngemuva kokufinyelela kuyo. Ividiyo ibonisa inhloso yokuvula ukuze isetshenziswe.

halospartanassault-1.name: Ukweqa
halospartanassault-1.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukweqa" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, vula i-Operation A emkhankasweni futhi uqedele yonke imisebenzi engu-5, kusukela ku-A-1 kuya ku-A-5. Landela umaka wenhloso yenjongo ngayinye bese uqedela umgomo wokugcina wokuvula impumelelo. Noma yisiphi isilinganiso senkanyezi sanele kulokhu kusula.

halospartanassault-2.name: Kuvuliwe
halospartanassault-2.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Kuvuliwe" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, vula i-Operation B emkhankasweni futhi uqedele yonke imisebenzi engu-5, kusukela ku-B-1 ukuya ku-B-5. Landela umaka wenhloso yenjongo ngayinye bese uqedela umgomo wokugcina wokuvula impumelelo. Noma yisiphi isilinganiso senkanyezi sanele kulokhu kusula.

halospartanassault-18.name: I-Skull Combo
halospartanassault-18.description: Qedela noma yimuphi umsebenzi womkhankaso ngenani eliphezulu lama-Skulls asebenzayo
halospartanassault-18.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Skull Combo" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, khetha umgomo wangaphambi kwesikhathi owazi kahle. Nika amandla zombili izikhala ze-Skull ezitholakalayo ekulayisheni, bese uqedela umgomo. Khetha ipheya ongakwazi ukuphatha imiphumela yayo ngezikhali zokuqala zalowo mkhankaso.

halospartanassault-3.name: Kuvaliwe
halospartanassault-3.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Kuvaliwe" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, vula i-Operation C emkhankasweni futhi uqedele yonke imisebenzi engu-5, kusukela ku-C-1 kuya ku-C-5. Landela umaka wenhloso yenjongo ngayinye bese uqedela umgomo wokugcina wokuvula impumelelo. Noma yisiphi isilinganiso senkanyezi sanele kulokhu kusula.

halospartanassault-4.name: Kuphunyuziwe
halospartanassault-4.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Kuphunyuziwe" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, vula i-Operation D emkhankasweni futhi uqedele yonke imisebenzi engu-5, kusukela ku-D-1 kuya ku-D-5. Landela umaka wenhloso yenjongo ngayinye bese uqedela umgomo wokugcina wokuvula impumelelo. Noma yisiphi isilinganiso senkanyezi sanele kulokhu kusula.

halospartanassault-5.name: Inqanyuliwe
halospartanassault-5.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Inqanyuliwe" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, vula i-Operation E emkhankasweni futhi uqedele yonke imisebenzi engu-5, kusukela ku-E-1 kuya ku-E-5. Landela umaka wenhloso yenjongo ngayinye bese uqedela umgomo wokugcina wokuvula impumelelo. Noma yisiphi isilinganiso senkanyezi sanele kulokhu kusula.

halospartanassault-21.name: Imivubukulo
halospartanassault-21.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Imivubukulo" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, vula i-Operation F emkhankasweni futhi uqedele yonke imisebenzi engu-5, kusukela ku-F-1 kuya ku-F-5. Landela umaka wenhloso yenjongo ngayinye bese uqedela umgomo wokugcina wokuvula impumelelo. Noma yisiphi isilinganiso senkanyezi sanele kulokhu kusula.

halospartanassault-7.name: Akukho Ukucasha
halospartanassault-7.description: Qedela umkhankaso ngaphandle kwanoma yimuphi uJakalase ovuselela isihlangu sakhe ku-Operation B, Mission 3
halospartanassault-7.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule i-"Akukho Ukucasha" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, dlala i-B-3 bese ukhumula oJakalasi eyodwa ngesikhathi. Uma usuphule isihlangu, qedela lowo Jakalase ngaphambi kokuba abe nesikhathi sokuzala kabusha. Sebenzisa ibhomu noma ubambe isihlangu ukuze ugweme impi edonsa kanzima. Sebenzisa ividiyo njengesithenjwa somzila wale ngxenye yomkhankaso.

halospartanassault-22.name: I-Silvertip
halospartanassault-22.description: Bhubhisa wonke ama-Mega Turrets ngethangi le-Grizzly ku-Operation F, Mission 2
halospartanassault-22.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Silvertip" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, ku-F-2, thatha ithangi le-Grizzly futhi ulisebenzise ukuze ubhekane negalelo lokugcina kuyo yonke i-Mega Turret. Hlala ethangini lalokho kubulala futhi ugcine ibanga lakho ngenkathi uklelisa isibhamu ngasinye. Sebenzisa ividiyo njengesithenjwa somzila wale ngxenye yomkhankaso.

halospartanassault-16.name: Isikhali Sokuzikhethela
halospartanassault-16.description: Thola ukubulala ngaso sonke isikhali esiphathwa ngesandla emkhankasweni
halospartanassault-16.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Isikhali Sokuzikhethela" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, thola okungenani ukubulala okukodwa ngesikhali ngasinye esiphathwayo emkhankasweni. Yenza uhlu lokuhlola bese weqa isikhali kuphela ngemva kokubulala. Sebenzisa izikhali zeSivumelwano ezehlisiwe eceleni kwezinketho ze-UNSC egiyeni lakho lokuqala kanye nokulayisha.

halospartanassault-10.name: Isosha lezinyawo
halospartanassault-10.description: Qedela inhloso ngaphandle kokusebenzisa noma yiziphi izimoto/ama-turrets ku-Operation E, Mission 4
halospartanassault-10.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Isosha lezinyawo" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, dlala i-E-4 ngokuphelele ngezinyawo. Sebenzisa izikhali zakho eziphathwa ngesandla namabhomu ukusula amaqembu, futhi udlule kunoma iyiphi imoto noma imiyalelo ye-turret eginqiwe. Qedela inhloso ngaphandle kokusebenzisa noma yiluphi uhlobo lwesisetshenziswa. Sebenzisa ividiyo njengesithenjwa somzila wale ngxenye yomkhankaso.

halospartanassault-17.name: Inikwe amandla yi-MJOLNIR
halospartanassault-17.description: Sebenzisa wonke amakhono kumkhankaso okungenani kanye
halospartanassault-17.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Inikwe amandla yi-MJOLNIR" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, hlomisa futhi wenze kusebenze ikhono lezikhali zomkhankaso ngamunye okungenani kanye. Shintsha phakathi kwamakhono atholakala kumishini futhi uhlole ukulayisha kwangaphambilini kwanoma yikuphi ongakusebenzisanga. Yenza kusebenze ikhono lokulwa ngaphambi kokudlulela kokulandelayo.

halospartanassault-9.name: I-Brute Force
halospartanassault-9.description: Qedela izinjongo usebenzisa kuphela i-Brute Shot, i-melee namabhomu ku-Operation D, Mission 1
halospartanassault-9.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Brute Force" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, dlala i-D-1 futhi usebenzise kuphela i-Brute Shot, i-melee, namabhomu. Londoloza imizuliswano ye-Brute Shot yamaqembu noma izinhloso ezikude futhi usebenzise i-melee ezitheni ezizimele. Hlala kulokho kuhlasela okuthathu kuze kube yilapho inhloso yokugcina isicacile. Sebenzisa ividiyo njengesithenjwa somzila wale ngxenye yomkhankaso.

halospartanassault-8.name: Bengazi Ukuthi Yini Abashayile
halospartanassault-8.description: Bulala i-convoy target ngaso sonke isibhamu esimile ku-Operation C, Mission 3
halospartanassault-8.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Bengazi Ukuthi Yini Abashayile" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, dlala i-C-3 futhi usebenzise zonke izibhamu ezimile endleleni. Endaweni ngayinye, hlala phezu kwesibhamu uze ucekele phansi okungenani umgomo owodwa ovela ku-convoy, bese uqhubekela phambili. Shiya iziqondiso ezanele ze-convoy ukuze uthole izibhamu zakamuva. Sebenzisa ividiyo njengesithenjwa somzila wale ngxenye yomkhankaso.

halospartanassault-19.name: I-Vidmaster Challenge
halospartanassault-19.description: Qedela i-Operation E, Mission 1 eneHollow and Black Eye Skulls esebenzayo
halospartanassault-19.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Vidmaster Challenge" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, vula i-Hollow ne-Black Eye ngaphambi kokuqala i-E-1. Sebenzisa i-Active Camouflage ukuze ushibilike izitha ezidlule lapho uya ePhantom. Uma udinga ukubuyisela izihlangu, melee isitha esizimele, bese ubuyela ekumbozeni ngaphambi kwempi elandelayo. Sebenzisa ividiyo njengesithenjwa somzila wale ngxenye yomkhankaso.

halospartanassault-14.name: Uhlelo lwempesheni
halospartanassault-14.description: Zuza u-25,000 XP kuwo wonke umsebenzi wakho
halospartanassault-14.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Uhlelo lwempesheni" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, qedela ohambweni bese udlala futhi lapho ungathola khona amaphuzu aphezulu ngokuthembekile. Qhubeka nokuqongelela i-XP yomsebenzi uze uthole u-25,000 usuwonke. Ibhalansi yakho yamanje ingaba ngaphansi uma usebenzisa i-XP ezintweni zokusebenza.

halospartanassault-15.name: Inkonzo Ehloniphekile
halospartanassault-15.description: Zuza zonke izindondo emkhankasweni okungenani kanye
halospartanassault-15.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Inkonzo Ehloniphekile" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, thola indondo yomkhankaso ngamunye okungenani kanye. Sebenza ngohlu lwezindondo ngohlobo, udlala kabusha ohambweni namaqembu ezitha ukuze uthole ama-multikills, impi eseduze yezindondo ze-melee kanye ne-streak, kanye nokuthunyelwa kwezimoto zezindondo eziboshelwe ezimotweni.

halospartanassault-13.description: Zuza zonke izinkanyezi zegolide kuyo yonke imisebenzi yokusebenza
halospartanassault-13.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "117" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, sebenzisa isikrini sokukhetha umgomo womkhankaso ukuze uthole noma yini engaphansi Kwegolide. Dlala kabusha lawo maleveli, uhlanganise ukubulala okusheshayo ukuze uthole izindondo futhi wengeze i-Score Booster lapho iwusizo khona. Qedela umsebenzi wokuqopha inkanyezi entsha. Sula i-Operation F kanye no-A kuye ku-E ngemfuneko yeSteam. Ividiyo ibonisa inhloso yokuvula ukuze isetshenziswe.

halospartanassault-23.name: Tour of Duty
halospartanassault-23.description: Zuza zonke izinkanyezi zegolide ku-Operation F
halospartanassault-23.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Tour of Duty" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, dlala futhi i-Operation F futhi uzuze Igolide kumishini yayo ngayinye emihlanu. Hlola impokophelo yamaphuzu ngaphambi kokuyivula ngayinye futhi usebenzise amaketanga ezindondo kanye ne-Score Booster uma umfushane. Qedela ukugijima ngakunye ukuze urekhode inkanyezi. Sebenzisa ividiyo njengesithenjwa somzila wale ngxenye yomkhankaso.

halospartanassault-24.name: I-Vidmaster Challenge 2.0
halospartanassault-24.description: Qedela i-Operation F, Mission 4 enogebhezi oluyimpumputhe nokuduma kwezulu olusebenzayo
halospartanassault-24.guideDescription:
Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Vidmaster Challenge 2.0" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, landela lezi zinyathelo.

1. Nika amandla Impumputhe Nokuduma ngaphambi kokuqala i-F-4.
2. Sebenzisa i-Active Camouflage ukuze ufinyelele ama-core cores endaweni ephansi kwesokunxele, ephansi kwesokudla, nangaphezulu kwesokudla, bese uwabhubhisa ebangeni eliphephile.
3. Ngemva komgogodla wesithathu, vula indlela esenyakatho phezu kwebhuloho elikhanyayo ukuya ekuphumeni.

halospartanassault-25.name: A ngomzamo
halospartanassault-25.description: Qedela yonke i-Operation F mission Assault Ops
halospartanassault-25.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "A ngomzamo" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, vula iphaneli ye-Assault Ops yayo yonke imisebenzi emihlanu ye-Operation F. Phinda udlale noma iyiphi inhloso ngezinjongo ezingahloliwe, uqinisekisa ukuthi ukulayisha kwakho kunesikhali esidingekayo noma ikhono ngaphambi kokwethulwa. Sebenzisa ividiyo njengesithenjwa somzila wale ngxenye yomkhankaso.

halospartanassault-20.name: Ikhredithi Eyengeziwe
halospartanassault-20.description: Qedela wonke ama-Assault Ops aqondene nomkhankaso kumkhankaso A kuya ku-E
halospartanassault-20.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ikhredithi Eyengeziwe" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, vula iphaneli ye-Assault Ops ngaphambi kwemishini ngayinye kokuthi Operations A ukuya ku-E. Phinda udlale umkhankaso ngamunye ngezinjongo ezingakaqedwa futhi usebenze kuzikhali ezisohlwini noma izindondo kuze kuqedwe wonke ama-Assault Ops ayo.

halocampaignevolved-257.name: Amaqabunga Ekwindla
halocampaignevolved-257.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Amaqabunga Ekwindla" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, dlala umgomo kusukela ekuqaleni. Sebenza phakathi komkhumbi uye ebhulohweni, thatha u-Cortana, bese ulandela indlela yokubalekela eya esikebheni sokukhulula.

halocampaignevolved-525.name: Benze Ababale
halocampaignevolved-525.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Benze Ababale" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, hlomisa isikhali esinembayo njengevolovolo noma i-Battle Rifle futhi uqedele izitha eziyi-100 ngama-headshots phakathi nomkhankaso. Gxila kumaGrunt namaJakalase angavikelekile. Hlubula izihlangu ze-Elite ngaphambi komugqa wokuqedela.

halocampaignevolved-258.name: Ukufakwa 04
halocampaignevolved-258.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukufakwa 04" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, dlala umgomo kusukela ekuqaleni. Landela isigodi ngemva kokufika futhi uphendule izingcingo zokucindezeleka zasolwandle. Sebenzisa i-Warthog phakathi kwezindawo zokuhlenga bese ulandela umaka wokugcina we-evac.

halocampaignevolved-513.name: I-cranial
halocampaignevolved-513.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-cranial" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, cosha noma iyiphi i-Skull efihliwe. Ukuze uthole ukulandwa kusenesikhathi, qala i-Pillar of Autumn bese ulandela ividiyo uye ku-Speed ​​Limit. Lalela isiqephu sayo somsindo, bese usebenzisa i-Interact uma ufika kuyo.

halocampaignevolved-524.name: Isilungisi sezimangalo
halocampaignevolved-524.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Isilungisi sezimangalo" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, layisha Umthwalo Onzima e-Rally Point Delta ukuze uthole umzila osindayo wemoto. Khomba ezingxenyeni zemoto ezivelile futhi uqhubeke udubula izingcezu zize zihlukane. Udinga izingxenye ezingu-50, ngakho-ke qondisa izingxenye ezihlukene esikhundleni sokubulala imoto kuphela.

halocampaignevolved-259.name: Ukulindela Ukungena
halocampaignevolved-259.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukulindela Ukungena" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, dlala umgomo kusukela ekuqaleni. Sebenzisa isibhamu se-sniper ukuze usule izitha ezizungeze i-gravity lift, bese ugibela umkhumbi futhi uphelezele uKapteni Keyes lapho ekhishwa.

halocampaignevolved-260.name: Bee Amashumi Amathathu
halocampaignevolved-260.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Bee Amashumi Amathathu" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, dlala umgomo kusukela ekuqaleni. Vikela ulwandle, sebenzisa isiteshi sokuvikela ukuze uvule indawo, bese ufika kuMdwebi wamabalazwe bese ubuyela phezulu ukuze ukhishwe.

halocampaignevolved-263.name: Lezi Zinto Zingumlando Wakho
halocampaignevolved-263.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Lezi Zinto Zingumlando Wakho" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, dlala umgomo kusukela ekuqaleni. Ngena exhaphozini ungene esikhungweni, bese ulwa nendlela yakho yokubuyela emuva futhi ulandele omaka bokuphuma.

halocampaignevolved-262.name: Lawula u-Alt Susa
halocampaignevolved-262.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Lawula u-Alt Susa" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, dlala umgomo kusukela ekuqaleni. Sebenza emhosheni oneqhwa namabhuloho e-Forerunner. Sebenzisa ikhava ezimotweni, bese weqa indlela yokugcina eya ku-Control Room.

halocampaignevolved-523.name: Kususwe izikhali
halocampaignevolved-523.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Kususwe izikhali" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, layisha umsebenzi onzima weSikhukhula njengeLabhulali. Khomba ezingalweni Zamafomu Empi bese udubula izitho ngazinye, bese uphinda eqenjini elilandelayo. Umgomo izingxenye ezinqanyuliwe eziyi-100, ngakho-ke gxila ezithweni ngaphambi kokuqeda isitha ngasinye.

halocampaignevolved-264.name: I-Protocol ilawula isenzo
halocampaignevolved-264.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Protocol ilawula isenzo" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, dlala umgomo kusukela ekuqaleni. Landela i-Monitor, ubambe eduze kwekhava eminyango ekhiyiwe, futhi usebenzise isibhamu ngokumelene noZamcolo oseduze ngaphambi kokukhipha Inkomba.

halocampaignevolved-533.name: Lokho Ukuhamba Kwami
halocampaignevolved-533.description: Ku-Assault ku-Control Room fika ku-Banshee ngaphambi kwama-Elite.
halocampaignevolved-533.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Lokho Ukuhamba Kwami" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, ku-Assault ku-Control Room, thola i-Banshee epakiwe eduze kwebhuloho bese ugijimela isihlalo somshayeli ngokushesha nje lapho umzila uvuleka. Sprint udlule ezinye izitha ukuze ukwazi ukuyigibela ngaphambi kokuthi i-Elite ingene. Uma i-Elite isuka kuqala, zama futhi ukuhlangana.

halocampaignevolved-265.name: Inkinga Ekabili
halocampaignevolved-265.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Inkinga Ekabili" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, dlala umgomo kusukela ekuqaleni. Sebenzisa i-Banshee ukuze ufinyelele i-pulse generator ngayinye. Sula izitha endaweni ngayinye yokufikela ngaphambi kokuphuma.

halocampaignevolved-521.name: I-Plate Tectonics
halocampaignevolved-521.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Plate Tectonics" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, layisha uMdwebi Webalazwe Othule e-Rally Point Charlie ukuze uthole i-Hunter. Vumela u-Hunter azibophezele ekuhlaseleni, agweme eceleni, bese udubula ipuleti lezikhali emhlane walo lize liphuka. Phinda uze uphule amapuleti angu-25.

halocampaignevolved-266.name: Imiyalo kaKapteni
halocampaignevolved-266.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Imiyalo kaKapteni" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, dlala umgomo kusukela ekuqaleni. Sebenza endaweni yokuphahlazeka bese ubuyela emkhunjini. Finyelela kuKaputeni bese ulandela izimpawu zokuphuma ukuze ubaleke.

halocampaignevolved-520.name: Igesi Elibi
halocampaignevolved-520.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Igesi Elibi" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, sebenzisa i-Grunt-heavy ukuhlangabezana futhi uzungeze iqembu ngalinye ukuze ukwazi ukubona amathangi e-methane emhlane wabo. Khomba ithangi futhi uqiniseke ukuthi liyaphuka ngaphambi kokudlulela kuthagethi elandelayo. Phinda uze ucekele phansi ojosaka abayi-100.

halocampaignevolved-268.name: Ngaphambi Kokuwa
halocampaignevolved-268.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ngaphambi Kokuwa" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, dlala umgomo kusukela ekuqaleni. Landela u-Johnson emkhunjini we-Covenant futhi usule igumbi ngalinye ngaphambi kokudlulela kumaka wenhloso elandelayo.

halocampaignevolved-269.name: Inkampani yeTiger
halocampaignevolved-269.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Inkampani yeTiger" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, dlala umgomo kusukela ekuqaleni. Sebenza ngokulondoloza ufinyelele ekuhlosweni kweSivumelwano. Sebenzisa ikhava ezungeze ukuhlangana kuka-Hunter futhi ulandele umzila omakiwe oya ekukhishweni.

halocampaignevolved-267.name: Uthuli & Echoes Kwavela
halocampaignevolved-267.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Uthuli & Echoes Kwavela" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, dlala umgomo kusukela ekuqaleni. Finyelela egumbini lenjini futhi ucekele phansi ama-reactors avele, bese uthatha i-Warthog uye endaweni yokukhipha ngaphambi kokuthi isibali sikhathi siphele.

halocampaignevolved-270.name: Isikhala Somuntu Siqu
halocampaignevolved-270.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Isikhala Somuntu Siqu" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, dlala umgomo kusukela ekuqaleni. Landela izinjongo ngomkhumbi bese udlula endaweni yokuphanyeka. Qedela ukulandelana kokuphunyuka kuSerafi.

halocampaignevolved-271.name: I-Greenhorn
halocampaignevolved-271.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Greenhorn" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, khetha okuthi Kulula bese uqedela umkhankaso. Qala ku-Pillar of Autumn futhi udlale kuze kube sekugcineni. Uma usebenzisa i-Mission Select ukuze uhlanze, hlola ubunzima bakho obuqediwe kumishini ngayinye.

halocampaignevolved-272.name: Ukuzalwa kweSpartan
halocampaignevolved-272.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukuzalwa kweSpartan" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, khetha Okuvamile bese uqedela umkhankaso. Qala ku-Pillar of Autumn futhi udlale kuze kube sekugcineni. Uma usebenzisa i-Mission Select ukuze uhlanze, hlola ubunzima bakho obuqediwe kumishini ngayinye.

halocampaignevolved-276.name: Hlanza Hlanza
halocampaignevolved-276.description: Thola zonke izingebhezi namatheminali ku-Pillar of Autumn.
halocampaignevolved-276.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Hlanza Hlanza" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, layisha i-Pillar of Autumn futhi uqoqe Umkhawulo Wejubane, Ukhulisiwe, Nokhakhayi Lombono, bese uqinisekisa ukuthi wenze kusebenze Isikhumulo se-"Approach". Qala ekuqaleni ukuze ukwazi ukuhlola amagumbi okuqala ngaphambi kokudlulela ebhulohweni. Ividiyo iqala ogebhezini lokuqala.

halocampaignevolved-535.name: Hlanza Ithanga
halocampaignevolved-535.description: Ku-The Maw qedela ukugijima kwe-warthog ngaphandle kokukhishwa ngenkani emotweni yakho.
halocampaignevolved-535.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Hlanza Ithanga" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, qala i-The Maw kusukela ekuqaleni futhi ufinyelele ekubalekeni kwe-Warthog okunesikhathi. Yehlisa ijubane ngaphambi kokugxuma kanye nokujika okuqinile, gwedla imfucumfucu, futhi uqedele ngaphandle kokuphenyisisa i-Warthog noma ukujikijelwa ngaphandle. Ividiyo ibonisa umugqa wokushayela. Ukuqala ngqo endaweni yokubalekela ngeke kulunge.

halocampaignevolved-279.name: Umcebo Ongcwatshiwe
halocampaignevolved-279.description: Thola zonke izingebhezi namatheminali ku-Silent Cartographer.
halocampaignevolved-279.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Umcebo Ongcwatshiwe" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, layisha i-The Silent Cartographer futhi uqoqe i-Bandana, Acrophobia, ne-Hip Fire Skulls, bese uqinisekisa ukuthi wenze kusebenze Isikhumulo se-"Status Update". Buka i-cue yomsindo we-Skull njengoba usondela endaweni ngayinye yokucasha, bese usebenzisa i-Interact ukuze uyithathe. Yenza kusebenze Itheminali ngaphambi kokuqeda umkhankaso.

halocampaignevolved-514.name: Ukwenza Umgexo
halocampaignevolved-514.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule "Ukwenza Umgexo" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, qoqa izingebhezi ezihlukene ezingu-22. Qala ngemishini embalwa yokuqala ngokulandelana bese ubheka i-Mission Select ukuze ubone ukuthi yiziphi izingebhezi ezisadinga ukuqoqwa. Landela ividiyo ngokomgomo ukugwema ukususa indawo kabili.

halocampaignevolved-273.name: Amaqhawe Awasoze Afa
halocampaignevolved-273.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Amaqhawe Awasoze Afa" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, khetha Iqhawe bese uqedela umkhankaso. Setha Ukusetha Ngaphambilini Kwesilungisi kokuthi Lutho futhi uvale i-Bandana ne-Acrophobia ngaphambi kokudlala. Sebenzisa ikhava ukuze ushaje izihlangu zakho futhi ugcine isikhali esinembayo sitholakala ukuze uqedele izitha ngemva kokuhlubula izihlangu zazo.

halocampaignevolved-277.name: Ukusesha Kuphumelele
halocampaignevolved-277.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ukusesha Kuphumelele" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, layisha i-Halo futhi uqoqe I-Grunt Funeral, Give & Take, ne-Floor Is Lava Skulls, bese uqinisekisa ukuthi wenze kusebenze Isikhumulo se-"Forgotten". Bheka okuthi Ukhohliwe ngaphambi kokushiya indawo yokuvula, bese ulandela izitobhi ezintathu ze-Skull kuvidiyo njengoba uthuthukela esigodini.

halocampaignevolved-280.name: Ifakwe eqhweni
halocampaignevolved-280.description: Thola zonke izingebhezi namatheminali ku-Assault ku-Control Room.
halocampaignevolved-280.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ifakwe eqhweni" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, layisha i-Assault ku-Control Room futhi uqoqe I-IWHBYD, Angry, and Cowbell Skulls, bese uqinisekisa ukuthi wenze kusebenze Itheminali ethi "Tangent I". Buka i-cue yomsindo we-Skull njengoba usondela endaweni ngayinye yokucasha, bese usebenzisa i-Interact ukuze uyithathe. Yenza kusebenze Itheminali ngaphambi kokuqeda umkhankaso.

halocampaignevolved-281.name: I-Proto Gravemind
halocampaignevolved-281.description: Thola zonke izingebhezi namatheminali ku-343 Guilty Spark.
halocampaignevolved-281.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Proto Gravemind" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, layisha i-343 Guilty Spark futhi uqoqe Inkungu, Lokho nje... Akulungile, Futhi Zibuya Izingebhezi, bese uqinisekisa ukuthi wenze kusebenze Isikhumulo se-"Tangent II". Buka i-cue yomsindo we-Skull njengoba usondela endaweni ngayinye yokucasha, bese usebenzisa i-Interact ukuze uyithathe. Yenza kusebenze Itheminali ngaphambi kokuqeda umkhankaso.

halocampaignevolved-278.name: Phangiwe
halocampaignevolved-278.description: Thola zonke izingebhezi namatheminali kokuthi Iqiniso Nokubuyisana.
halocampaignevolved-278.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Phangiwe" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, layisha Iqiniso Nokubuyisana futhi uqoqe I-Iron, Endurance Spec, kanye Nezigebhezi Zangaphandle, bese uqinisekisa ukuthi wenze kusebenze Itheminali ethi "Inquisitor". Buka i-cue yomsindo we-Skull njengoba usondela endaweni ngayinye yokucasha, bese usebenzisa i-Interact ukuze uyithathe. Yenza kusebenze Itheminali ngaphambi kokuqeda umkhankaso.

halocampaignevolved-282.name: AmaTomu Angaphelelwa Isikhathi
halocampaignevolved-282.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "AmaTomu Angaphelelwa Isikhathi" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, layisha Ilabhulali futhi uqoqe I-Tilt, Pop, kanye Nezigebhezi Zendlala, bese uqinisekisa ukuthi wenze kusebenze Isikhumulo se-"Tangent III". Buka i-cue yomsindo we-Skull njengoba usondela endaweni ngayinye yokucasha, bese usebenzisa i-Interact ukuze uyithathe. Yenza kusebenze Itheminali ngaphambi kokuqeda umkhankaso.

halocampaignevolved-283.name: Outpost Discoveries
halocampaignevolved-283.description: Thola zonke izingebhezi namatheminali kokuthi Ama-Betrayals Amabili.
halocampaignevolved-283.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Outpost Discoveries" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, layisha I-Betrayals Okubili futhi uqoqe I-Tough Luck, Iso Elimnyama, kanye Nezigebhezi Zenganekwane, bese uqinisekisa ukuthi wenze kusebenze Isikhumulo se-"Alone". Buka i-cue yomsindo we-Skull njengoba usondela endaweni ngayinye yokucasha, bese usebenzisa i-Interact ukuze uyithathe. Yenza kusebenze Itheminali ngaphambi kokuqeda umkhankaso.

halocampaignevolved-285.name: Akukho Rush
halocampaignevolved-285.description: Thola zonke izingebhezi namatheminali ku-The Maw.
halocampaignevolved-285.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Akukho Rush" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, layisha i-The Maw futhi uqoqe I-Stowed Reload, i-Boom, ne-Thunderstorm Skulls, bese uqinisekisa ukuthi wenze kusebenze Itheminali ethi "Arrival". Buka i-cue yomsindo we-Skull njengoba usondela endaweni ngayinye yokucasha, bese usebenzisa i-Interact ukuze uyithathe. Yenza kusebenze Itheminali ngaphambi kokuqeda umkhankaso.

halocampaignevolved-286.name: Izikhumbuzo
halocampaignevolved-286.description: Thola zonke izingebhezi namatheminali ku-Boarding Action.
halocampaignevolved-286.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Izikhumbuzo" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, layisha Isenzo Sokugibela futhi uqoqe Ukungasebenzi kahle, i-Johnny Ammo Seed, ne-Leadhead Skulls, bese uqinisekisa ukuthi wenze kusebenze Itheminali ethi "The Path". Buka i-cue yomsindo we-Skull njengoba usondela endaweni ngayinye yokucasha, bese usebenzisa i-Interact ukuze uyithathe. Yenza kusebenze Itheminali ngaphambi kokuqeda umkhankaso.

halocampaignevolved-287.name: I-Brute Loops
halocampaignevolved-287.description: Thola zonke izingebhezi namatheminali kugeyimu Eyingozi Kakhulu.
halocampaignevolved-287.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Brute Loops" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, layisha Igeyimu Eyingozi Kakhulu futhi uqoqe I-Temperamental, Recession, ne-Ghost Skulls, bese uqinisekisa ukuthi wenze kusebenze Isikhumulo se-"Penitent Report". I-Temperamental ithatha izinyathelo ezintathu ezihlukene. Landela zontathu izigaba kuvidiyo ngaphambi kokushiya umkhankaso.

halocampaignevolved-284.name: Okubalulekile
halocampaignevolved-284.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Okubalulekile" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, layisha okhiye bese uqoqa i-Catch, Blind, ne-Piñata Skulls, bese uqinisekisa ukuthi wenze kusebenze Isikhumulo se-"Consumed". Qala kokuthi Iqhawe noma Inganekwane Yokubamba, bese ulandela ividiyo yokulanda okunesikhathi Ukubamba ngaphambi kokuhlanza amanye amaqoqo.

halocampaignevolved-512.name: Izipho Zokuhlukana
halocampaignevolved-512.description: Thola zonke izingebhezi namatheminali ku-Heavy Burden.
halocampaignevolved-512.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Izipho Zokuhlukana" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, layisha I-Heavy Burden futhi uqoqe i-Eye Patch, i-Grunt Birthday Party, kanye Nezigebhezi Ezisebenzayo, bese uqinisekisa ukuthi wenze kusebenze Isikhumulo se-"Harmonious Clarity". Buka i-cue yomsindo we-Skull njengoba usondela endaweni ngayinye yokucasha, bese usebenzisa i-Interact ukuze uyithathe. Yenza kusebenze Itheminali ngaphambi kokuqeda umkhankaso.

halocampaignevolved-517.name: I-REMIX!
halocampaignevolved-517.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-REMIX!" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, qoqa noma yiziphi Izikhakhayi ezintathu ukuze uvule i-Campaign Remix. Khetha i-Campaign Remix kumenyu, qala i-mission kokuthi Easy, bese uyiqeda kusukela ekuqaleni. Izikhali ezixubene nesitha zingashintsha, ngakho hlola ukuthi yini ephumayo ngaphambi kokuzibophezela ekulweni ngakunye.

halocampaignevolved-274.name: Inganekwane Ephilayo
halocampaignevolved-274.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Inganekwane Ephilayo" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, khetha Inganekwane bese uqedela umkhankaso. Setha Ukusetha Ngaphambilini Kwesilungisi kokuthi Lutho futhi uvale i-Bandana ne-Acrophobia ngaphambi kokudlala. Sebenzisa ikhava ukuze ushaje izihlangu zakho futhi ugcine isikhali esinembayo sitholakala ukuze uqedele izitha ngemva kokuhlubula izihlangu zazo.

halocampaignevolved-515.name: I-Headhunter
halocampaignevolved-515.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Headhunter" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, qoqa zonke izingebhezi ezintathu kumishini ngayinye kweziyi-13 zengqikithi engu-39. Sebenzisa isahluko ngasinye sevidiyo ukuze uhlole inhloso eyodwa ngesikhathi. I-Catch Skull in Keyes idinga umgijimo Wobuqhawe noma Oyinganekwane.

halocampaignevolved-275.name: Lore Yiba Nesihe
halocampaignevolved-275.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Lore Yiba Nesihe" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, yenza kusebenze Itheminali eyodwa kumishini ngayinye kweziyi-13, okuhlanganisa nemishini emithathu ye-prequel. Sebenzisa izahluko zetheminali kuvidiyo futhi uhlanganyele nedivayisi ngayinye ngaphambi kokuthi uqhubeke.

halocampaignevolved-531.name: Lona Umkhumbi Wami Manje
halocampaignevolved-531.description: Khipha uKaputeni Keyes futhi ucuphe amasosha akhe ayisithupha aphindiselayo esibayeni sokubuka sase-Autumn.
halocampaignevolved-531.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Lona Umkhumbi Wami Manje" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, ku-Pillar of Autumn, finyelela ibhuloho futhi ukhiphe uCaptain Keyes. Ngena esibayeni sokubuka ukuze wonke amaMarine ayisithupha abeza emva kwakho akulandele. Shelelisela udlule kuwo uye lapho ophuma khona bese uvale ayisithupha ngaphakathi. Landela ividiyo ukuthi ume kuphi nokuthi uhambe nini.

halocampaignevolved-537.name: Umgxeki Wokudla
halocampaignevolved-537.description: Lalela i-Thirsty Grunt ikhuluma ngendlela yakhe yokudla.
halocampaignevolved-537.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Umgxeki Wokudla" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, eduze nasekupheleni kokuphunyuka kwe-The Maw’s Warthog, thatha indlela eseceleni eya ku-Thirsty Grunt. Shiya i-Warthog, ume eduze ngokwanele ukuze umuzwe, bese ulinda ulayini wakhe mayelana nokuthi ubekade ekudlani ngaphambi kokuba uhambe.

halocampaignevolved-516.name: Isengezo Somqoqi
halocampaignevolved-516.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Isengezo Somqoqi" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, qoqa wonke ama-Skulls angu-39 futhi wenze kusebenze zonke iziTheminali ezingu-13. Sebenza ngevidiyo umgomo owodwa ngesikhathi, ucoshe izingebhezi ezintathu futhi usebenzise Itheminali eyodwa endaweni ngayinye. Hlola izinto zokubala eziqoqiwe zemishini ukuze uthole noma yini oyigejile ngaphambi kokuqala elandelayo.

halocampaignevolved-538.name: Zonke Izihlangu, Akukho Isivuno
halocampaignevolved-538.description: Qedela noma yiliphi izinga kubunzima beHeroic noma ngaphezulu ngaphandle kokulimaza impilo.
halocampaignevolved-538.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Zonke Izihlangu, Akukho Isivuno" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, khetha ileveli emfushane njenge-Pillar of Autumn bese uqala kusukela ekuqaleni kokuthi Heroic. Lapho izitha zikhipha izihlangu zakho, buyela ekhava bese ulinda ukuthi zishajwe kabusha. Qeda ngaphandle komonakalo empilweni yakho kulo lonke izinga. Setha Ukusetha ngaphambilini Isilungisi kokuthi Lutho ngaphambi kokuqalisa.

halocampaignevolved-522.name: Isiswebhu esisha
halocampaignevolved-522.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Isiswebhu esisha" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, sondela ezimotweni zesitha ezihlezi endaweni engaphandle bese usebenzisa umyalo wokuduna ukuze uhlale esihlalweni somshayeli. Sebenzisa ikhava yebanga eliseduze ukuze uhambisane ne-Ghost, bese ugibela lapho idlula noma yehla isivinini. Phinda ukuthatha izikhathi ezingu-10.

halocampaignevolved-518.name: Shaya i-Drop
halocampaignevolved-518.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Shaya i-Drop" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, qoqa izingebhezi ezintathu, bese uqala i-Pillar of Autumn kusukela ekuqaleni kokuthi Campaign Remix kokuthi Easy. Gcina I-Modifier Preset isethwe kokuthi Lutho futhi usule igumbi ngalinye ekhavani ngaphambi kokudlulela phambili. Qeda umsebenzi ngaphandle kokufa.

halocampaignevolved-532.name: I-Map Quest
halocampaignevolved-532.description: Qedela Umdwebi Webalazwe Othule ngaphandle kokudubula, usebenzisa amabhomu, i-melee, ukufa, noma ukuqala kabusha.
halocampaignevolved-532.guideDescription:
Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Map Quest" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, landela lezi zinyathelo.

1. Qala Umdwebi Webalazwe Othule kusukela ekuqaleni kokuthi Easy Nge-Modifier Preset isethwe kokuthi Lutho.
2. Sebenzisa i-Warthog ekuhambeni futhi ugijime noma ushayele izitha ezedlule.
3. Yenza kusebenze isiteshi sokuvikela kanye noMdwebi wamabalazwe, bese ufinyelela ekukhishweni ngaphandle kokudubula, ukujikijela amabhomu, ukusebenzisa i-melee, ukufa, noma ukuqala kabusha.

halocampaignevolved-527.name: Ngisho Nolaka
halocampaignevolved-527.description: Nge-Temperamental Skull ecushiwe shaya i-Halo ngaphandle kokucasula noma ubani.
halocampaignevolved-527.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ngisho Nolaka" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, qoqa i-Temperamental ku-The Most Dangerous Game futhi uyinike amandla ngaphambi kokuqala i-Halo. Gcina isibhamu sakho namabhomu kude namasosha asemanzini kukho konke ukuhlangana nokuhlenga. Uma isitha siseduze nomuntu onobungani, beka kabusha isibhamu esicacile ngaphambi kokudubula.

halocampaignevolved-529.name: Umlilo Owongayo
halocampaignevolved-529.description: Hlomisa Indlala, Ukwehla Komnotho, kanye Nogebhezi Lwesihlahla sika-Johnny Ammo futhi unqobe umgomo ngaphandle kokuphelelwa yizinhlamvu.
halocampaignevolved-529.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Umlilo Owongayo" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, qoqa i-Famine, Recession, ne-Johnny Ammo Seed, bese unika amandla womathathu ngaphambi kokuqala i-mission emfushane kokuthi Easy. Gcina zombili izikhali zigcwele, sebenzisa ikhava ukuze uhambe eduze kwezitha, futhi ushintshe izikhali ngaphambi kokuba zome. Qeda ngokusetha ngaphambilini kwe-Modifier kokuthi Lutho.

halocampaignevolved-526.name: I-Hot Streak
halocampaignevolved-526.description: Nge-Floor Is Lava Skull evuliwe shaya umgomo ngaphandle kokugxuma noma ukufa.
halocampaignevolved-526.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I-Hot Streak" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, qoqa i-Floor Is Lava ku-Halo futhi uyinike amandla okwenza umgomo owazi kahle. Qala kokuthi Easy Nge-Modifier Preset isethwe kokuthi Lutho. Landela umzila osezingeni eliphansi, gcina okokufaka kwakho kwe-jump kungathintwa, futhi uqedele ngaphandle kokufa. Ividiyo ibonisa umzila ongayilandela.

halocampaignevolved-536.name: Jiralhanae Conservationist
halocampaignevolved-536.description: Emdlalweni Oyingozi Kakhulu ungabulali ama-Brutes ahlaselayo.
halocampaignevolved-536.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Jiralhanae Conservationist" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, Kugeyimu Eyingozi Kakhulu, gwema ukudubula endaweni yesifuba esikhazimulayo kuma-Brutes ohlela ukuyishiya ephila. Uma i-Brute iqala ukugadla, nqamula umugqa wokubona futhi uqhubeke ngaphandle kokuyibulala. Qala kusukela ekuqaleni ngokuthi I-Modifier Preset isethwe kokuthi Lutho futhi uqedele umkhankaso.

halocampaignevolved-528.name: Njengezikhathi Zakudala
halocampaignevolved-528.description: Qedela Ukukhohlisa Okubili ngomkhawulo Wejubane, I-Endurance Spec, i-Hip Fire, kanye Nezigebhezi ze-Armistice ezinikwe amandla.
halocampaignevolved-528.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Njengezikhathi Zakudala" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, qoqa i-Speed Limit, i-Endurance Spec, ne-Hip Fire, futhi uvule i-Armistice ngokuqoqa noma yiziphi izingebhezi ezintathu. Vula zozine kumenyu yogebhezi, setha Ukusethwa Ngaphambi Kwesilungisi kube Lutho, bese uqedela Ukukhaphela Okubili kusukela ekuqaleni. Sebenzisa ikhava ngaphambi kokugibela futhi ushiye ama-Banshees ejeneretha ngayinye.

halocampaignevolved-534.name: Ubude Bengalo
halocampaignevolved-534.description: Ku-343 Guilty Spark qedela isitezi sokuqala ngaphandle kokushaya.
halocampaignevolved-534.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ubude Bengalo" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, ku-343 Guilty Spark, ngena esitezi sokuqala ngaphandle kokushaywa. Sebenzisa ikhava, shiya indawo ezungeze Amafomu Okulwa Nezikhukhula, futhi uqhubeke uhamba lapho ukuphuma kuvulwa. Sebenzisa ividiyo ukuze ubone umzila oqondile odabula phansi. Zama futhi uma ukuhlasela kuxhumekile.

halocampaignevolved-519.name: Mix Master
halocampaignevolved-519.description: Qedela wonke umkhankaso oxutshwe kabusha ngaphandle kokufa.
halocampaignevolved-519.guideDescription:
Ukuze uvule okuthi "Mix Master" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, landela lezi zinyathelo.

1. Vula i-Campaign Remix ngokuqoqa noma yiziphi izingebhezi ezintathu.
2. Dlala umkhankaso oxutshwe kabusha ku-Easy kusukela kumishini yokuqala nge-Modifier Preset isethwe kokuthi Lutho.
3. Hlala ngemuva lapho amaqembu ezitha ongawazi ezala, hlola izikhali zakho phakathi nokuhlangana, futhi uqedele wonke umkhankaso ngaphandle kokufa.

halocampaignevolved-530.name: INsumansumane
halocampaignevolved-530.guideDescription:
Ukuze uvule okuthi "INsumansumane" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, landela lezi zinyathelo.

1. Qoqa ama-Skulls angu-17 adingekayo ku-LASO, bese ukhetha i-Play LASO bese uqedela umkhankaso ngokuthi I-Modifier Preset isethwe kokuthi Lutho.
2. Iso Elimnyama likwenza ube ne-melee ukuze uthole izihlangu, futhi ukufa uwedwa kuqala kabusha umkhankaso.
3. Gcina izihlangu phezulu ngaphambi kokuphokophela phambili futhi usebenzise indlela yokuhamba exhunyiwe ukuhlela ukuhlangana ngakunye.

halocampaignevolved-539.name: Kwavela Ngokugcwele
halocampaignevolved-539.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Kwavela Ngokugcwele" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, qedela indaba futhi wenze ohambweni lokuqala, qoqa wonke ama-Skulls angu-39 namatheminali angu-13, futhi usebenzele ekufezeni inselele. Londoloza i-Remix engafi nemizamo ye-LASO ngemuva kokuhlangana kwakho. Hlola uhlu lwezimpumelelo ukuze uthole noma yiziphi izinjongo zemishini ezisasele ngaphambi kokuqala ukuhlanza.
